title: Can the "Answer Independence" Claim in Conversational AI Advertising Be Verified? Construct Decomposition and the Derivation of Audit Requirements
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Can the "Answer Independence" Claim in Conversational AI Advertising Be Verified? Construct Decomposition and the Derivation of Audit Requirements
detail.abstract: When OpenAI introduced advertising into ChatGPT in 2026, it declared "Answer independence"-ads do not influence answers-as an official principle. This study takes that claim itself as the object of analysis, asking what must be measured to verify it and whether external observers can do so. Drawing on construct validity in measurement theory, we decompose "answer independence" into five sub-constructs-content invariance (C1), mention neutrality (C2), tone neutrality (C3), omission neutrality (C4), and longitudinal stability (C5)-and assess the verification conditions and external verifiability of each, building on the algorithm auditing literature. Verifiability proves asymmetric across constructs: C1 and C3 are partially verifiable, C2 is verifiable only conditional on sponsor disclosure, C4 is unverifiable in principle absent a stipulated completeness criterion, and C5 is practically unverifiable without access to training pipelines. We further observe a mismatch between the scope of the claim and the scope of its grounds: while the claim itself is broad enough to cover all five constructs, the grounds offered for it (system separation and labeling) address only the easily verifiable layer. From this matrix we derive three audit requirements-sponsor disclosure, counterfactual access, and third-party pipeline auditing-and connect them to existing institutional precedents including advertising substantiation doctrines in U.S. and Korean law, third-party measurement accreditation, and researcher data access under the EU DSA. As, to our knowledge, the first framework to decompose a platform's independence claim through a measurement-theoretic lens and systematically grade its external verifiability, this study argues that the debate over conversational AI advertising should turn not on the truth of the claim but on its verifiability.

AI.tldr: 本文以OpenAI 2026年将广告引入ChatGPT时宣称的"答案独立性"原则为分析对象，从测量理论中的构念效度出发，将其分解为五个子构念（内容不变性、提及中立性、语调中立性、遗漏中立性、纵向稳定性），系统评估每个构念的验证条件与外部可验证性，发现可验证性在构念间存在不对称性，并指出声明的范围与其依据范围不匹配，最终提出三项审计要求。
AI.research_question: 如何验证AI对话系统"答案不受广告影响"这一宣称？外部观察者能否对其进行验证？
AI.motivation: OpenAI将"答案独立性"作为官方原则提出，但该宣称本身是否可被验证尚不清楚；现有讨论多关注其真实性，而忽略了更根本的验证性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 测量理论中的构念效度（construct validity）；算法审计文献（algorithm auditing）
AI.method: 概念分解与逻辑分析：将"答案独立性"分解为五个子构念，分别评估其验证条件与外部可验证性，并结合美国、韩国法律中的广告实质化原则、第三方测量认证、欧盟DSA下的研究者数据访问等制度先例进行分析。
AI.findings: 可验证性在五个构念间不对称：内容不变性（C1）和语调中立性（C3）可部分验证；提及中立性（C2）仅在赞助商披露条件下可验证；遗漏中立性（C4）在缺乏完整性标准条件下原则上不可验证；纵向稳定性（C5）若无训练管线访问权则实际不可验证。声明的范围涵盖全部五个构念，但其依据（系统分离与标签）仅解决了易于验证的表层。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次通过测量理论视角分解平台独立性宣称，并系统性地分级评估其外部可验证性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出三项审计要求（赞助商披露、反事实访问、第三方管线审计），并与既有制度先例（美韩广告实质化原则、第三方测量认证、欧盟DSA数据访问）对接，为政策制定与监管提供操作性框架。

reference: International Journal of Production Economics, volume 147, 2014[10.1016/j.ijpe.2013.08.019]
title: Gray-market Trade with Product Information Service in Global Supply Chains
affiliations: Kobe University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Gray-market Trade with Product Information Service in Global Supply Chains

publicationDetails.detailsText: International Journal of Production Economics, volume 147, 2014[10.1016/j.ijpe.2013.08.019]

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the economic effects of a product information service when potential consumers, who are segmented by their taste, exist in gray markets. Specifically, we construct an economic model that considers a multinational firm (MNF) who expands business to a country and chooses whether to provide information service regarding product characteristics. If receiving the information, consumers in a specific segment, whose taste suits the characteristics, have positive utility from consuming the product, while those in other segments have no utility. By contrast, consumers in all segments have positive expected utility before consuming the product without information. With these settings, we demonstrate that there arises the equilibrium that the MNF provides no information service when gray-market trade, i.e., parallel trade, is allowed in the country, leading to lower consumer welfare than when it is prohibited. A primary finding in the equilibrium is that such a situation arises especially when potential consumers are less segmented. In this situation, the regulator in the country should ban the parallel imports so as to enhance consumer welfare. The result is counterintuitive and notable, because one might intuitively infer that gray-market trade is less desirable when customers are more minutely segmented and the product information service is thus more specific and necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究灰色市场（平行进口）存在时，跨国企业是否提供产品信息服务的均衡决策。发现当消费者细分程度较低时，允许平行进口会导致企业不提供信息服务，从而降低消费者福利，因此监管者应禁止平行进口以提升福利。这一结论与直觉相反。
AI.research_question: 在灰色市场存在的情况下，跨国企业是否会主动提供产品信息服务？这种选择对消费者福利有何影响？
AI.motivation: 传统直觉认为，消费者细分程度越高，产品信息服务越必要，灰色市场的危害越大。本文试图挑战这一直觉，揭示在特定条件下灰色市场反而可能抑制信息服务供给，从而损害消费者福利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者偏好细分模型、灰色市场（平行贸易）理论、信息经济学中关于产品信息服务的理论。
AI.method: 构建跨国企业与消费者的博弈模型，分析企业在允许/禁止平行进口两种情形下是否提供信息服务，比较均衡结果和消费者福利。
AI.findings: （1）当平行进口被允许时，存在企业不提供信息服务的均衡；（2）这种情况尤其发生在潜在消费者细分程度较低时；（3）在该均衡下，消费者福利低于禁止平行进口的情形；（4）监管者应禁止平行进口以提升消费者福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了灰色市场与产品信息服务之间的交互机制，修正了"消费者细分程度越高，灰色市场越有害"的传统直觉。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者提供了关于平行进口政策的决策依据：当消费者细分程度较低时，禁止平行进口反而有利于消费者福利。

title: Dual-channel Supply Chain Operations
affiliations: Kobe University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Dual-channel Supply Chain Operations
detail.abstract: The rapid development of information and communication technology has induced today's general manufacturing companies in various industries to use direct sales channels as well as indirect sales channels via distributors for their product sales to end-consumers. This combined use of the two types of sales channels is referred to as a dual-channel supply chain or simply a dual channel, and the management and operations of this process by a firm are called dual-channel supply chain operations. Reflecting the growing number of manufacturers adopting such arrangements, dual-channel supply chain operations have become a core subject in the operations management (OM) literature. In this chapter, the author provides an overview of recent studies associated with dual-channel supply chain operations, thereby identifying key topics of focus and outlining future research directions that are worthy of investigation. Consequently, the chapter shows that, given the current real-world business environment, dual-channel supply chain operations are undoubtedly an essential current and prospective research subject that will continue to command significant attention from both researchers and practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了双渠道供应链运营的研究现状，识别了关键研究主题，并提出了未来研究方向。双渠道供应链（制造商同时使用直销和分销商间接销售）已成为运营管理领域的核心课题，并将继续受到学界和业界的广泛关注。
AI.research_question: 双渠道供应链运营研究的关键主题是什么？未来值得研究的方向有哪些？
AI.motivation: 信息和通信技术的快速发展促使制造业企业同时采用直销和分销商间接销售的双渠道模式，这种模式已成为现实商业环境中的普遍现象，需要进行系统性综述以指导后续研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双渠道供应链运营理论，涵盖渠道冲突、渠道协调、定价策略、库存管理等运营管理（OM）领域的核心理论。
AI.method: 文献综述法，通过系统梳理和归纳近年来的相关研究，识别核心主题并展望未来方向。
AI.findings: 双渠道供应链运营是运营管理领域的核心且持续的研究主题；在当前商业环境下，该领域对研究者和实践者都具有重要意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了双渠道供应链运营的现有研究成果，为后续研究提供了清晰的知识地图和研究框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造业企业在双渠道模式下的运营管理实践提供了理论指导，帮助企业更好地理解和管理直销与间接销售的协同问题。

title: Power Structure and Profitability in a Three-Echelon Supply Chain Facing Stochastic Demand
affiliations: Kobe University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Power Structure and Profitability in a Three-Echelon Supply Chain Facing Stochastic Demand
detail.abstract: In this paper, we investigate how the order in which supply chain members demand their respective margins, which is often called power structure, influences their profitability in a three-echelon supply chain facing stochastic demand. We consider a typical three-echelon supply chain consisting of an upstream firm, a midstream firm, and a downstream firm. Previous supply chain models examining power structure have shown the conventional result that a supply chain member that sets a price or margin earlier generates a higher profit in a deterministic environment; that is, firms achieve higher profits in the order of the first-mover, the second-mover, and the third-mover who set margins in a three-echelon chain. Here, the first-mover, second-mover, and third-mover mean the supply chain member who sets its margin first, second, and third, respectively. Our stochastic model suggests the starkly contrasting result that the expected profit under demand uncertainty is higher in the order: (i) in a wide range of circumstances, the third-mover, the first-mover, and the second-mover who demand margins or (ii) in a narrower range of circumstances, the third-mover, the second-mover, and the first-mover. That is, the range of exogenous parameters leading to the first case is broader than that leading to the second case. The result indicates that the first-mover advantage is completely lost and, instead, the last-mover advantage always arises in a stochastic environment. Currently, power in supply chains tends to shift from upstream firms to downstream firms. However, our results warn a supply chain member in a stochastic environment that if assuming leadership to set its price or margin just because it has the power to do so, the member can ultimately harm itself and reduce its own profit.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在三层供应链面临随机需求时，成员定价顺序（权力结构）如何影响其盈利能力。与传统确定性环境下的"先动优势"结论相反，本文发现在随机环境下出现"后动优势"——第三行动者总是获得最高利润，第一行动者优势完全消失。
AI.research_question: 在面临随机需求的三层供应链中，成员定价（索取边际利润）的顺序如何影响各成员的盈利能力？
AI.motivation: 传统的供应链权力结构模型在确定性环境下得出"先动优势"的结论，即越早定价的成员利润越高。然而，现实中的供应链往往面临需求不确定性，且权力正从上游向下游转移。本文旨在检验在随机需求环境下，这一传统结论是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链权力结构理论、随机需求下的博弈论（顺序博弈）、三层供应链协调理论。
AI.method: 构建三层供应链（上游、中游、下游）的随机需求模型，分析不同定价顺序（权力结构）下各成员的期望利润，并与确定性环境下的结论进行对比。
AI.findings: （1）在随机需求环境下，传统的第一行动者优势完全消失；（2）第三行动者（最后定价者）总是获得最高期望利润，即出现"后动优势"；（3）利润排序在大多数情况下为：第三行动者 > 第一行动者 > 第二行动者；在较窄参数范围内为：第三行动者 > 第二行动者 > 第一行动者。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了确定性环境下"先动优势"的传统供应链权力结构理论，揭示了随机需求环境下"后动优势"的存在及其条件，丰富了供应链博弈理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 警告供应链成员：在不确定环境下，盲目追求定价领导权（率先设定价格或边际利润）可能适得其反，损害自身利润。为供应链权力结构设计提供了重要决策参考。

title: Visual Identity as the Neurocognitive Filter of China's Automotive Expansion From Industrial Scale to Symbolic Legitimacy

detail.title: Visual Identity as the Neurocognitive Filter of China's Automotive Expansion From Industrial Scale to Symbolic Legitimacy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests and no personal or institutional relationships that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it did not involve human participants, patients, animals, clinical intervention, or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a structural model of China’s global automotive expansion in which visual identity is not treated as a decorative terminal layer, but as Gate Zero: the neurocognitive prior through which all subsequent evidence of quality, price, technology, safety, service, and status is interpreted. Four external analyses provide the industrial, financial, market-absorption, and OEM-strategy layers of the model. The author’s prior visual-semiotic work provides the fifth and causally prior layer: the hypothesis that a brand emblem functions as a synthetic social phenotype, producing rapid affective appraisal, trust or distrust, approach or avoidance, and halo-based trait attribution before deliberate product evaluation begins. The model distinguishes physical presence from market penetration, final-customer absorption, operating-system maturity, financial conversion, and symbolic legitimacy. It argues that China has achieved genuine industrial scale and strategic supply-chain leverage, yet the conversion of that power into durable global automotive authority remains uneven. The paper proposes a falsifiable sharedmechanism hypothesis: that rapid appraisal of unfamiliar brand emblems and rapid appraisal of human faces rely on the same, or functionally equivalent, computational sequence of configural recognition, affective valence, salience assignment, trust inference, halo transfer, and behavioral disposition. An experimental program is specified to test spontaneous and preconscious effects, cross-domain neural decoding, mediation through affect and trust, and downstream effects on consideration, willingness to pay, and choice. The resulting framework recasts the decisive contest in global automotive power: industrial capacity reaches the consumer only after it passes through a visual-affective filter.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个中国汽车全球扩张的结构模型，将品牌标识（车标）视为"第零关口"——一种神经认知先验，它先于所有后续的产品评估（质量、价格、技术等）发挥作用。作者认为车标作为"合成社会表型"，在消费者进行任何理性评价之前就已触发快速的情感评估、信任判断和行为倾向。模型区分了工业规模与市场渗透、符号合法性等不同层面，并提出了一个可证伪的共同机制假说：对陌生车标的快速评估与对人脸的快速评估共享相同的计算序列。最终框架指出，工业能力必须通过视觉-情感过滤器才能到达消费者。
AI.research_question: 中国汽车品牌的视觉标识（车标）如何作为神经认知先验，影响消费者对质量、价格、技术、安全、服务和地位的后续评估，从而塑造中国在全球汽车市场的扩张路径？
AI.motivation: 尽管中国已实现工业规模与供应链优势，但在全球汽车市场转化为持久权威的过程并不均衡。作者认为传统分析忽略了视觉标识作为消费者认知的"第一道门槛"所发挥的因果作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 视觉符号学、神经认知科学（面部与标志快速评估的平行处理）、社会表型理论、光环效应理论、行为经济学中的情感启发式。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建包含工业层、财务层、市场吸收层、OEM战略层和视觉符号层的五层结构模型；并提出可证伪的实验方案（测量自发性/前意识效应、跨领域神经解码、情感与信任的中介效应、以及对考虑意愿/支付意愿/选择的向下游影响）。
AI.findings: 中国已实现真正的工业规模与战略供应链杠杆，但将这种力量转化为持久的全球汽车权威仍不均衡。品牌标识作为"合成社会表型"，在消费者进行理性产品评估前就已触发快速情感评价、信任/不信任判断和接近/回避行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将视觉标识从"装饰性终端层"重新定义为因果优先的"第零关口"神经认知先验；提出并论证车标评估与面部评估共享相同的计算序列（格式塔识别-情感效价-显著性分配-信任推理-光环转移-行为倾向）这一可证伪的共同机制假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国汽车品牌全球化战略提供了超越传统工业分析的视角：工业能力必须通过视觉-情感过滤器才能到达消费者；为品牌标识设计与跨文化适应性提供了神经认知层面的理论依据。

title: Entry Deterrence Through Credible Commitment to Transfer Pricing at Direct Cost
affiliations: Kobe University - Graduate School of Business Administration

detail.title: Entry Deterrence Through Credible Commitment to Transfer Pricing at Direct Cost
detail.abstract: This paper examines the choice between direct and absorption costing in a cost-based transfer pricing system for duopolistic firms competing with product market prices. Existing literature has shown that the adoption of an absorption costing system, which drives up the intrafirm transfer price, strategically dominates direct costing for the two firms, regardless of whether the transfer price is publicly observable, thereby constituting a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium (SPNE). However, we demonstrate that direct costing can strategically dominate absorption costing when one of the two firms is an incumbent, whereas the other is a potential entrant. Stated differently, the well-known result in the strategic cost allocation problem reverses if we consider entry threats. More specifically, we show that if the incumbent credibly commits to an observable transfer price, the upfront adoption of a direct costing system enables the incumbent to deter the entry of the potential rival in the SPNE. As a commitment device for the observable price, we consider the regulation of transfer prices that usually exists in oligopolistic network industries. We show that a regulator that pursues social welfare maximization approves direct costing but not absorption costing. Therefore, the firms and the regulator can share a mutual interest in the adoption of a direct costing system, a state thus sustained as the SPNE. This result yields managerial accounting implications for a divisionalized firm facing the threat of potential competitors entering the market in that the firm can use this accounting system to help monopolize the market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双寡头企业成本基础转让定价时，发现当存在潜在进入威胁时，直接成本法可战略性地优于吸收成本法，帮助在位企业阻止市场进入，且与社会福利目标一致。
AI.research_question: 在面临潜在进入威胁的双寡头市场中，企业应如何选择直接成本法与吸收成本法的转让定价策略？
AI.motivation: 已有文献表明吸收成本法在双寡头竞争中战略占优，但本文质疑这一结论在存在进入威胁时是否仍然成立，试图揭示成本分配策略与市场进入阻挠之间的关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论中的子博弈完美纳什均衡（SPNE）、战略成本分配理论、进入阻挠理论、转让定价监管与社会福利分析。
AI.method: 理论建模与均衡分析，比较不同成本核算体系下在位企业与潜在进入者的战略互动。
AI.findings: 当存在潜在进入者时，直接成本法可战略性地主导吸收成本法；在位企业通过承诺可观察的转让价格，采用直接成本法可阻止潜在对手进入；追求社会福利最大化的监管者会批准直接成本法而非吸收成本法，企业与监管者利益一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"吸收成本法在战略上占优"的既有结论，揭示了进入威胁如何反转成本分配策略的战略效果，拓展了战略成本分配理论的应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为面临潜在竞争的分权化企业提供了利用会计制度设计来垄断市场的管理会计启示；为网络行业中监管者审批转让定价方法提供了政策参考。

title: Achieved Knowledge versus Schooled Knowledge Degrees, Intelligence, and the Trial of Reality in the AGI Era
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Achieved Knowledge versus Schooled Knowledge Degrees, Intelligence, and the Trial of Reality in the AGI Era
detail.abstract: Modern universities have rigorous procedures for certifying schooled knowledge through coursework, examinations, supervised research, publication, peer review, and institutional progression. They lack an equally general procedure for examining achieved knowledge: knowledge embodied in a realized, durable, verifiable, attributable, and transferable achievement. School remains indispensable for formation, method, judgment, and intellectual inheritance. The problem is not schooling itself, but its near-monopoly over academic recognition. This paper proposes a parallel examination architecture for Degrees in Transformative Achievement. Candidates submit multimodal achievement records and undergo independent verification, attribution and contribution audits, knowledge extraction, ethical review, a human-contribution audit, and a multi-format Achievement Viva. Three categorical gates precede nine dimensions assessed through written reasons, networkaware contribution inquiry, and precedent-anchored judgment of level. Staged anonymity reduces status bias, while the power test postpones final examination when a candidate controls witnesses or verification. The degree grants neither a professional license nor political authority. The paper's primary contribution is the examination itself. Generative AI makes polished symbolic output easier to produce and less informative as a standalone signal of independent human capability. Under those conditions, verified and attributable achievement may become relatively more informative, although it remains vulnerable to capital, hidden labor, machine assistance, and fabricated evidence. Schooled knowledge survives academic examination; achieved knowledge must also survive the trial of reality. A university adequate to the future should be able to examine both.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现代大学拥有严格的程序认证学校教育知识，但缺乏同等程序认证“成就知识”——即通过实际、持久、可验证、可归属且可转移的成就所体现的知识。为此，作者提出了一种平行的“变革性成就学位”考试架构，包括多模态成就记录提交、独立验证、贡献审计、知识提取、伦理审查、人类贡献审计以及多格式成就答辩。论文的核心贡献即这一考试体系本身。
AI.research_question: 现代大学如何建立一套与学校教育知识认证程序并行的、能够有效认证“成就知识”（即通过实际成就体现的知识）的考试体系？
AI.motivation: 现代大学拥有严格的学校教育知识认证程序（课程、考试、监督研究、出版、同行评审等），但缺乏同等严格的程序来认证通过实际成就体现的“成就知识”。学校教育对于形成、方法、判断和知识传承不可或缺，但其在学术认可上的近乎垄断地位成为问题。生成式AI使得纯符号性产出更容易生产且作为独立人类能力的信号价值降低，因此可验证、可归属的成就信号可能变得更具信息价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成就知识（achieved knowledge）的概念——通过现实成就体现的、可验证、可归属的知识；学校教育知识（schooled knowledge）与成就知识的对比；信号理论（在AI环境下不同信号的信息价值变化）；贡献审计与知识提取方法。
AI.method: 提出并设计了一套完整的平行考试架构：候选人提交多模态成就记录，经过独立验证、归属与贡献审计、知识提取、伦理审查、人类贡献审计、多格式成就答辩。包含三个分类门和九个评估维度，采用书面理由、网络感知贡献调查和先例锚定的等级判断。采用阶段性匿名减少地位偏见，以及“权力测试”在候选人控制证人或验证时推迟最终考试。
AI.findings: 提出了一种可行的平行认证架构，能够补充现有学校教育知识认证体系。该架构承认学校教育在形成、方法、判断和知识传承中的不可或缺性，同时为实际成就知识提供认证途径。该学位不授予专业执照或政治权威。在生成式AI时代，可验证和可归属的成就信号可能比纯符号产出更具信息价值，但仍面临资本、隐性劳动、机器辅助和伪造证据的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“成就知识”作为与学校教育知识平行的知识认证范畴；构建了一套系统的、多步骤的成就知识考试架构；区分了学校教育知识认证与成就知识认证的不同逻辑和程序。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学提供了一种可操作的新型学位认证程序，使大学能够认证那些通过实际成就而非纯粹课程学习获得的知识；在AI时代为评估人类独立能力提供了新的信号机制；论文本身的设计就是其实践贡献的核心体现。

title: AI Premium
affiliations: LUISS University - Department of Economics and Finance, University of Rochester and Yale University, Yale University - Cowles Foundation

detail.title: AI Premium
detail.abstract: Using 380 trillion tokens of realized AI consumption across more than four hundred large language models from the licensed proprietary OpenRouter dataset covering approximately 2 percent of current global monthly AI token consumption, we analyze how AI affects firms, markets, and workers. Leveraging the unprecedented size, scope and granularity data, we construct the AI Factor from growth in tokens, dollars, and users, estimate firm-level AI Betas from stock return comovement, and characterize the AI Premium. First, we build a high-frequency AI factor and decompose it into salient components. Second, we show that firms whose returns covary more positively with the AI factor--high AI beta firms--earn higher subsequent returns, and the AI premium is large and heterogeneous. A value-weighted long-short strategy earns 64.1 basis points per week, and the premium is large for loadings on the intensive, frontier-oriented margin of AI consumption--closed-source models, paying and seasoned users, and long prompts--but not on casual or open-weight use. Third, the premium reaches beyond technology firms into consumer-facing and capital-heavy parts of the economy, but is absent in emerging markets, including China. Fourth, the AI exposure is more positive in nonroutine interactive work and more negative in analytical, scientific, and operations-control skills--an occupation one standard deviation higher in interaction-and-communication content has 0.36-standard-deviation higher market-implied AI exposure. Additionally, we provide early evidence of the rise of the agentic economy.

AI.tldr: 本文使用OpenRouter平台上380万亿token的AI消费数据（覆盖全球月均AI token消费的约2%），构建AI因子、估计公司层面AI贝塔并刻画AI溢价。研究发现：高AI贝塔公司获得更高后续回报（多空策略周回报64.1个基点），溢价主要来自封闭模型、付费用户等集约型前沿消费；AI暴露在非日常互动型工作中更积极，在分析/科学/操作控制型技能中更消极；溢价超越科技行业进入消费和重资本领域，但在新兴市场（含中国）不显著。
AI.research_question: AI如何影响企业、市场和劳动者？具体而言：AI因子如何构建？AI暴露是否被资产定价？AI溢价在不同模型类型、用户群体和职业中的异质性如何？
AI.motivation: 现有AI经济学研究缺乏大规模、细粒度的实际消费数据，无法系统度量AI对资产价格和劳动力市场的真实影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产定价理论（因子模型、贝塔定价）、劳动经济学（工作任务模型、技能暴露度）、AI经济学的集约与广延边际框架。
AI.method: 利用OpenRouter平台超过400个大语言模型的380万亿token消费数据，构建高频AI因子（从token、美元、用户增长三种维度），估计公司层面AI贝塔（股票收益率与AI因子的协动性），并采用投资组合排序和横截面回归检验AI溢价。
AI.findings: 1）高AI贝塔公司获得显著为正的后续超额回报，价值加权多空策略周回报64.1个基点；2）AI溢价主要来自封闭模型、付费用户、长期用户和长提示词等集约型前沿消费边际，而非开放权重模型的随意使用；3）AI暴露不限于科技企业，还延伸至消费和重资本行业，但在中国等新兴市场不显著；4）AI暴露在非日常互动型工作中为正，在分析、科学和操作控制技能中为负；5）提供了代理经济（agentic economy）兴起的早期证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用全球级实际AI消费大数据构建AI因子并系统检验AI资产定价效应，揭示了AI溢价的多维异质性（模型类型、用户类型、任务类型），将AI经济学与资产定价和劳动经济学理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供AI暴露的量化度量工具和交易策略；为企业管理者理解AI对行业和职业的差异化影响提供参考；为政策制定者评估AI在不同市场和技能群体中的分布效应提供实证依据。

title: Why Global FMCG Brands Succeed in Some Countries and Fail in Others: Cultural Adaptation and Consumer Preferences in India and South Korea: A Comparative Study of Nestlé’s Maggi and Kellanova’s Pringles
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Why Global FMCG Brands Succeed in Some Countries and Fail in Others: Cultural Adaptation and Consumer Preferences in India and South Korea: A Comparative Study of Nestlé’s Maggi and Kellanova’s Pringles
detail.abstract: This study investigates the strategic factors driving the uneven market performance of multinational fastmoving consumer goods (FMCG) brands across culturally and economically distinct regions. While existing international marketing literature extensively debates global standardization versus local adaptation, there remains a critical gap in understanding why identical brand equity yields deep market penetration in one Asian market while remaining a niche offering in another. Grounded in the theoretical framework of glocalization, this paper presents a qualitative comparative case study of Nestlé's Maggi and Kellanova's Pringles across two contrasting environments: India (an emerging, value-driven market) and South Korea (a mature, trend-driven economy). Utilizing secondary data from corporate disclosures, market research indices, and academic literature spanning up to 2026, the study evaluates four core determinants: cultural preferences, localized consumption behavior, pricing models, and packaging strategies. The findings reveal that Maggi achieved intergenerational market leadership in India through deep flavor localization ("masala" profile) and low unit pricing (LUP) models, yet faced structural barriers in South Korea due to a highly saturated domestic ramyeon market and conflicting category expectations. Conversely, Pringles established a premium, high-margin position in South Korea by aligning with urban convenience-store retail layouts and experience-oriented "kidult" marketing, but remains restricted to a niche demographic in India due to mass-market price elasticity. The study concludes that international FMCG success depends less on global brand recognition than on the structural alignment between strategic positioning and the localized consumption logic of the target market. These insights offer actionable blueprints for multinational firms executing cross-border entry strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对比雀巢美极和凯洛那可乐奇在印度和韩国市场的表现，发现国际快消品牌的成功更多取决于战略定位与目标市场本地消费逻辑的结构性契合，而非全球品牌认知度。
AI.research_question: 为什么相同的品牌资产在文化和经济截然不同的亚洲市场中，一个能实现深度渗透，另一个却只能作为小众产品？
AI.motivation: 现有国际化营销文献虽广泛讨论全球标准化与本地化之争，但缺乏对同一品牌在不同亚洲市场表现差异成因的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球本地化（Glocalization）理论框架
AI.method: 定性比较案例研究，利用企业披露、市场研究指数及学术文献的二手数据
AI.findings: 美极在印度通过深度口味本地化（玛萨拉风味）和低单价模型实现跨代际市场领导地位，但在韩国面临饱和的拉面市场和品类期望冲突；可乐奇在韩国凭借高端定位、便利店零售布局和"Kidult"体验营销取得成功，但在印度受限于大众市场价格弹性而局限于小众。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示全球本地化战略在跨亚洲市场应用中的边界条件，提出品牌成功的关键在于"结构性契合"而非单纯的标准化或本地化选择。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国快消企业提供跨市场进入策略的行动蓝图，强调定价模型、包装策略和渠道布局需与本地消费逻辑对齐。

title: The Unconstrained Variable.

detail.title: The Unconstrained Variable.

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the theoretical modeling or conclusions presented in this paper. The research was conducted strictly to advance conceptual frameworks in elite client acquisition behavior.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This manuscript is a purely conceptual and deductive mathematical contribution and does not involve empirical studies, clinical trials, or active human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was fully funded and supported by Newsorte Media. The funder provided corporate infrastructure for document production and mathematical typesetting but had no role in the design, theoretical derivations, or selection of hypotheses, which were conceived independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Standard marketing models assume buyers are constrained by budgets. At the ultra-high-net-worth threshold — defined by the Capgemini Research Institute (2025) as $30 million or more in investable assets — this constraint disappears, and with it the foundational logic of conventional acquisition theory. This paper argues that when liquid capital eliminates financial loss as a meaningful concern, decision-making reorganizes around four non-monetary risks: cognitive bandwidth, reputational standing, peer-group exclusion, and generational legacy. Simultaneously, because these individuals are saturated with high-end pitches, standard transformative marketing language fails to register. This paper develops a composite value function with logistic saturation bounding to formalise this structural migration, derives the limiting behavioural conditions as W → ∞, and proposes two empirically testable experimental designs through which the model's key parameters — including the trajectories of λ_fin(W) and λ_status(W) — can be estimated from observed UHNWI decision behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，当财富超过3000万美元（超高净值门槛）后，传统营销模型因预算约束消失而失效。决策逻辑转向四种非金钱风险（认知带宽、声誉、圈层排斥、代际传承），且标准营销语言失效。作者构建了带逻辑饱和边界的复合价值函数，推导了财富趋于无穷时的极限行为条件，并提出了两个可检验的实验设计来估计关键参数。
AI.research_question: 当流动性资本消除财务损失顾虑时，超高净值个体的决策逻辑如何重组？传统营销模型如何失效，以及如何建模这一结构性转变？
AI.motivation: 标准营销模型假设买家受预算约束，但超高净值人群（可投资资产≥3000万美元）的预算约束消失，传统获取理论的根本逻辑不再适用，亟需新的理论框架解释其决策行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复合价值函数（composite value function）与逻辑饱和边界（logistic saturation bounding）；非金钱风险四维度：认知带宽（cognitive bandwidth）、声誉（reputational standing）、圈层排斥（peer-group exclusion）、代际传承（generational legacy）
AI.method: 理论建模：构建复合价值函数，以逻辑饱和函数形式化边际价值的衰减；极限分析：推导W→∞时的极限行为条件；提出两个可检验的实验设计以估计关键参数（如λ_fin(W)和λ_status(W)的轨迹）。
AI.findings: 预算约束消失后，决策围绕四种非金钱风险重组；传统变革性营销语言因超高净值人群被高密度推销饱和而失效；财富趋于无穷时，财务风险权重趋近于零，而社会地位等非货币因素起主导作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了消费者决策理论至无预算约束极端条件；提出了非金钱风险的分类框架；将逻辑饱和函数引入营销价值建模，为超高净值细分市场提供了形式化的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务超高净值客户的营销实践提供了新指导：应放弃传统变革性营销语言，转向针对认知带宽、声誉、圈层和传承等非金钱风险的价值主张设计；提供了可操作的实验设计以校准营销策略。

title: Twenty Percent of What? The Hidden Base of Digital Tipping

detail.title: Twenty Percent of What? The Hidden Base of Digital Tipping
detail.abstract: Digital tipping screens routinely present suggested gratuity percentages without disclosing the amount or base items on which those percentages will be calculated. Depending on merchant settings and point-of-sale systems, the tip base may include taxes, discounts, service charges, or even the full amount of a split check. This Comment argues that such undisclosed tip bases can constitute deceptive practices under Section 5 of the Federal Trade Commission Act. A displayed percentage is an affirmative numerical representation because it necessarily refers to an underlying base. When that base is not properly disclosed, the resulting representation may create a misleading net impression, particularly in time-pressured checkout environments where consumers have limited ability to verify the calculation.

AI.tldr: 本文论证数字小费界面中未披露的小费基数构成《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条下的欺骗性行为，因展示的百分比必然指向未披露的基数，在时间压力下易误导消费者。
AI.research_question: 数字小费界面未披露小费计算基数是否构成欺骗性商业行为？
AI.motivation: 数字小费屏幕普遍显示建议小费百分比，却不披露该百分比计算的基础（如是否包含税费、折扣、服务费或拆分账单全额），消费者在结账时间压力下难以验证，可能被误导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦贸易委员会法第5条关于欺骗性行为的规定；"误导性总体印象"（misleading net impression）理论；肯定性数字表示理论。
AI.method: 法律评论/规范性分析（Comment形式），结合现有法规和案例进行论证。
AI.findings: 显示的百分比是肯定的数字表示，必然指向某个未披露的基数；该基数不披露时，在消费者时间压力下可能产生误导性总体印象，构成欺骗性行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"误导性总体印象"理论扩展应用于数字小费场景中的百分比表示问题；界定肯定性数字表示中的隐含基数披露义务。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构（如FTC）认定数字小费界面欺骗性提供法律分析框架；提示商家和POS系统开发商应明确披露小费计算基数，以规避法律风险。

title: Examining the Impact of AI-based Personalised Marketing on Australian Bank Customers
affiliations: , Melbourne Institute of Technology, Canterbury Institute of Management and Deakin University - Deakin Business School

detail.title: Examining the Impact of AI-based Personalised Marketing on Australian Bank Customers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: A crucial part of the research design is ethical integrity, which guarantees adherence to national and institutional research ethics regulations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The Melbourne Institute of Technology (MIT) ethics committee granted formal ethical approval for this study before any data were collected. The study adhered to the standards outlined in the Australian Code for the Responsible Conduct of Research, which encourages integrity, fairness, honesty, and respect throughout the research process.
declarations.funderStatement: NA

detail.abstract: Purpose: This study examines the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled personalised marketing on customer experience in the Australian banking sector, specifically among Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) customers. Methodology: A quantitative, cross-sectional survey was a data-gathering tool that obtained data on 151 Generation Y (aged 29-44) CBA customers in Victoria. Relative advantage, complexity, and compatibility (constructs of Diffusion of Innovation (DOI) theory) and trust are constructs measured by the use of a structured questionnaire. Analyses were conducted in descriptive statistics, reliability tests, correlation and multiple regression. Findings: Relative advantage was a positive predictor of customer experience with the best predictive value (=0.706), compatibility (=0.226) and trust (=0.175), whereas complexity had considerable negative predictive value (=-0.276). This model attributed 77.4 percent of the variance; all the hypotheses were accepted. Originality: The study addresses a gap in the Australian-specific empirical research into the topic of AI personalisation in the banking sector by implementing the DOI theory to customer perceptions, presenting new information on the determinants of AI uptake and experience. Research limitations/implications: The study is limited to the sample of Gen-Y Victorian CBA customers, i.e. 29-44 aged individuals, and therefore cannot be generalised. Future research would benefit by expanding the demographic scope and using longitudinal designs. Practical implications: Practical implications Banks must focus on practical advantages, allow consistency with customer practices, make interfaces simple to diminish complexity, and build trust based on visible practices to maximise AI-enabled customer encounters.

AI.tldr: 本研究以澳大利亚联邦银行Y世代客户为样本，基于创新扩散理论和信任，发现AI个性化营销中相对优势、兼容性和信任正向预测客户体验，复杂性负向预测，模型解释77.4%的方差。
AI.research_question: AI赋能的个性化营销如何影响澳大利亚银行业（特别是CBA客户）的客户体验？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚银行业在AI个性化营销方面的实证研究存在空白，缺乏基于创新扩散理论对客户感知的系统探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新扩散理论（DOI）中的相对优势、复杂性、兼容性三个构念，以及信任变量。
AI.method: 定量横截面调查，对151名维多利亚州CBA的Y世代（29-44岁）客户进行结构化问卷，采用描述性统计、信度检验、相关分析和多元回归分析。
AI.findings: 相对优势（β=0.706）正向预测客户体验且预测力最强，兼容性（β=0.226）和信任（β=0.175）也正向预测，复杂性（β=-0.276）显著负向预测；模型解释77.4%的方差，所有假设均被接受。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创新扩散理论应用于AI个性化营销与客户体验的关系研究，为澳大利亚银行业客户对AI采用的感知决定因素提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 银行应突出AI的实用优势、保持与客户习惯的兼容性、简化界面降低复杂性，并以可见的实践建立信任，以优化AI赋能的客户体验。

title: Does Generative AI Make Startup Ideas Alike? Evidence from Product Hunt
affiliations: and Case Western Reserve University - Weatherhead School of Management

detail.title: Does Generative AI Make Startup Ideas Alike? Evidence from Product Hunt
detail.abstract: Founders increasingly use generative AI to develop new products. Because a market's stock of distinct ideas shapes what it can build next, we ask whether generative AI broadens or narrows the ideas that founders bring to it. We study 291,314 product launches posted to Product Hunt from January 2018 to April 2026. After ChatGPT's release, launches become more concentrated around common category concepts, and the share of distinctive launches falls by more than a third, from 25% to 16%. Using an outcome-blind LLM ideation-exposure index, we find that the post-ChatGPT increase in similarity is larger in categories where general-purpose LLMs can more effectively assist product ideation. First-time teams introduce more distinctive ideas than experienced teams, but similarity rises within both groups, and holding founder composition fixed leaves the exposure gradient essentially unchanged. These findings are consistent with independent founders drawing on a common input and converging toward common category concepts. Generative AI may thus expand individual entrepreneurs' ability to develop products while narrowing the range of ideas that entrepreneurial entry supplies to the market.

AI.tldr: 创业者在生成式AI（如ChatGPT）后推出的产品创意更加趋同，独特创意比例从25%降至16%，因为大家依赖相同的AI工具导致思路收敛。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI是拓宽还是缩小了创业者带入市场的创意范围？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正被创业者广泛用于产品开发，但市场创意的多样性取决于其拥有的独特想法集合。有必要研究AI对创意多样性的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创意经济学、知识多样性理论、技术对创业创新的影响
AI.method: 分析Product Hunt上2018年1月至2026年4月的291,314个产品发布数据；构建结果无关的LLM创意暴露指数来衡量AI辅助效果。
AI.findings: ChatGPT发布后，产品发布更集中于常见类别概念，独特发布比例从25%降至16%；AI辅助能力越强的类别，创意趋同越明显；首次创业团队和新老团队均出现趋同，且创始人构成不变时趋同梯度不变。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生成式AI作为通用输入工具会导致创业者创意趋同的理论机制，拓展了技术对创业生态多样性影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒创业者、投资者和平台设计者注意AI工具可能削弱市场创意多样性，需设计机制鼓励差异化创新。

title: Dead Reckoning: Counting Your Customers Who Never Say Goodbye
affiliations: The Wharton School

detail.title: Dead Reckoning: Counting Your Customers Who Never Say Goodbye
detail.abstract: Firms in non-contractual commerce face the challenge of knowing how many customers they actually have because their customers can stop buying without ever saying they have left. Buy-Till-You-Die models address this problem by estimating each customer's probability of being alive, a quantity usually called P(alive) and used in essentially every major software tool for generating dashboards, defining churn, calculating customer equity, and valuing the enterprise. We show that this practice confounds two distinct quantities. Within the beta-geometric family of models, P(alive) is the infinite-horizon limit of an observable family of finite-horizon probabilities of repeat purchase. Every finite-horizon estimate, such as the probability of repeat purchase within 12 months, is a forecast of a verifiable event. The limit at infinite time can only be estimated by extrapolation, a customer count obtained by dead reckoning. The implied customer count is therefore only partially identified: realized returners are the lower bound, and estimation conventions determine the reported point estimate above that. The consequences are significant. In our empirical setting, on a seven-year transaction panel for 31,683 unique customers, model specifications with nearly identical observable forecasts estimate the number of "alive" customers at values ranging from 3,654 to 27,734, a difference of 7.6x. A default weighting parameter set in customer base software swings the count 42 percent. Five years of subsequent purchases further falsify the maximum-likelihood count from below. The main patterns we find can be replicated on the CDNOW benchmark, with a 2.4x spread in point estimates of the size of the customer base. Most of what practice calls miscalibration is instead a category error: summed P(alive) overshoots the realized eighteen-month returners by 2.25x, while the same model's own eighteen-month forecast errs by just 1.18x. The remedy is to report and maintain an auditable horizon count, say the number of actual repeat customers within 18 months, estimate return probabilities at a stated horizon, audit them across scoring dates and horizons, recalibrate them as customer cohorts drift, and report the total customer count, if it must be reported at all, as a confidence interval rather than a point.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示非契约交易场景下广泛使用的P(alive)指标存在概念错误，它混淆了两个不同的量：可验证的有限期复购概率与不可验证的无限期存活概率。基于贝塔-几何模型族的实证显示，不同模型规格对"存活"客户数的估计可相差7.6倍（31683位客户中从3654到27734），而一个默认参数调整就能使计数变动42%。论文建议用可审计的有限期客户数（如18个月内复购客户数）替代P(alive)，并以置信区间而非点值报告总客户数。
AI.research_question: 非契约交易中广泛使用的P(alive)（客户存活概率）指标是否存在概念混淆？这一混淆对客户数量估计有何实际影响？
AI.motivation: 非契约交易中（如零售、电商），客户可以无声无息地停止购买，企业面临"不知道实际有多少客户"的难题。BTYD模型中的P(alive)被广泛应用于商业决策，但论文作者认为该指标存在根本性的概念错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝塔-几何模型族（beta-geometric family of models）；有限期概率与无限期限界概率的区分；部分识别（partial identification）理论。
AI.method: 实证分析：使用7年交易面板数据（31,683位客户），比较不同模型规格下的P(alive)估计值；利用5年后续购买数据对最大似然估计进行证伪；在CDNOW基准数据集上复制主要发现。
AI.findings: 1. P(alive)混淆了可验证的有限期复购概率与不可验证的无限期存活概率。2. 不同模型规格对"存活"客户数估计相差7.6倍（3,654到27,734）。3. 默认权重参数调整可使计数变动42%。4. 5年后续数据证伪了最大似然估计的客户数（从下方）。5. 在CDNOW基准上复制了2.4倍的估计差异。6. 所谓的"校准偏差"本质上是类别错误：P(alive)总和高估了18个月实际回头客2.25倍，而模型自身的18个月预测误差仅为1.18倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了BTYD模型中P(alive)指标的概念混淆，区分了有限期可验证概率与无限期不可验证极限，指出客户数量是"部分识别"（partially identified）而非点估计问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出替代方案：报告可审计的有限期客户数（如18个月内复购客户数）；以置信区间而非点值报告总客户数；跨评分日期和期限审计复购概率；随客户群体漂移重新校准模型。

title: Exploring Digitalization in Facility Management: Towards a Research Agenda
affiliations: , Polytechnic University of Milan, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Students and Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Students

detail.title: Exploring Digitalization in Facility Management: Towards a Research Agenda
detail.abstract:
Background and aim. Digitalization in facility management (FM) services is an emerging phenomenon. The sector tends to prioritize the adoption of technology to address immediate concerns rather than effectively framing fundamental problems, hindering the creation of a comprehensive strategy. There is a lack of reflection on the complex relationship between digital technologies and FM services, highlighting the necessity for new conceptualizations to address implementation challenges. Our paper aims to identify categories that facilitate research and knowledge exchange between academia and industry to enhance the understanding of digitalization and its strategies within FM.

Methods. We conducted workshops with academics and industry representatives focusing on (i) classification and conceptualization of digital technology applications in FM, (ii) the effects of digital technologies in FM, and (iii) standardization and scaling up digital solutions within organizations and the industry.

Results. The article advances understanding of digital technologies' potential for use in FM. (i) We classify digitalization based on business development, technology, and value chain perspectives. (ii) We identify technology considerations, such as incentives, return on investment, and efficiency, as well as barriers, including collaboration, contextual factors, and cultural challenges. Human-centric solutions are proposed to address these barriers. (iii) We discuss standardization challenges, including SME perspectives, ISO fragmentation, cybersecurity, data management, software integration, and path dependence.

Practical implications. Conceptualizations co-created by industry and academia contribute to the establishment of a relevant research agenda and the facilitation of digital technology implementation. Type of paper. Research (short) Keywords.

AI.tldr: 本文通过学术界与产业界的合作研讨会，对设施管理（FM）服务中的数字化进行了分类与概念化，识别了技术应用的考虑因素与障碍，并讨论了标准化挑战，旨在促进研究与实践的知识交流。
AI.research_question: 如何通过分类与概念化来更好地理解设施管理服务中的数字化及其策略？
AI.motivation: 设施管理领域倾向于优先采用技术解决眼前问题，缺乏对数字化与FM服务之间复杂关系的深入反思，需要新的概念化框架来应对实施挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化分类框架（基于业务发展、技术和价值链视角）；技术采纳与障碍理论；标准化与路径依赖理论。
AI.method: 与学术界和行业代表共同举办研讨会，聚焦于（i）数字化技术应用的分类与概念化，（ii）数字化技术的影响，（iii）标准化与规模化解决方案。
AI.findings: （1）从业务发展、技术和价值链三个视角对数字化进行分类；（2）识别了技术考虑因素（激励、投资回报率、效率）和障碍（协作、情境因素、文化挑战），并提出以人为中心的解决方案；（3）讨论了标准化挑战，包括中小企业视角、ISO碎片化、网络安全、数据管理、软件集成和路径依赖。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合业务、技术与价值链视角的数字化分类框架，丰富了FM领域数字化理论；识别了技术采纳中的人本因素与结构性障碍。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术界与产业界共同制定相关研究议程提供了概念工具；为FM企业实施数字化技术提供了障碍识别与应对策略参考。

title: Do Product Market Reforms Work? Assessing Regulatory Changes Impacting Competition
affiliations: Norwich Business School, University of East Anglia and University of East Anglia (UEA) - School of Economics

detail.title: Do Product Market Reforms Work? Assessing Regulatory Changes Impacting Competition

declarations.funderStatement: Royal Economic Society funding was received

detail.abstract: We create a new dataset that characterizes studies of product market reforms implemented from 1932 to 2011. We examine the size and origins of differences in estimated impacts based on an OECD classification scheme for potentially competitive restrictions of regulation. The median impact from switching to a pro-competitive environment is a 19 per cent price decline. Competition-restricting regulations that are directed at specific societal objectives, such as health, safety, education, the environment, and financial stability, have lower price increases than the price declines from regulatory changes creating greater competition. The findings support the view that special interests obtain large benefits from favorable regulation. These findings can help policymakers when balancing the effects of competition-enhancing regulatory reform against other societal objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了1932-2011年产品市场改革的新数据集，发现转向促进竞争环境的政策可使价格平均下降19%，且针对特定社会目标（如健康、安全等）的限制竞争法规带来的价格上涨幅度，小于促进竞争监管改革带来的价格下降幅度。
AI.research_question: 产品市场改革的竞争效应大小及其来源是什么？不同监管类型的价格影响有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对产品市场改革影响的系统量化分析，尤其是对不同类型监管（竞争限制 vs. 社会目标导向）的价格效应差异缺乏理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争理论、监管经济学、特殊利益集团理论
AI.method: 构建1932-2011年产品市场改革新数据集；基于OECD分类方案对潜在竞争限制性监管进行分类；比较不同监管改革的价格效应。
AI.findings: 转向促进竞争环境的中位数价格下降为19%；针对特定社会目标（健康、安全、教育、环境、金融稳定）的限制竞争法规导致的价格上涨幅度，小于促进竞争改革带来的价格下降幅度；特殊利益集团从有利监管中获得巨大收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统量化了产品市场改革的价格效应；区分了不同类型监管对价格的不同影响；为特殊利益集团理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在权衡促进竞争的监管改革与其他社会目标时提供了实证依据。

title: Stylized Facts for the Circular Economy - A Knowledge Synthesis

detail.abstract:
We present a first iteration of stylized facts for the circular economy (CE) as a way to synthesize the knowledge compiled into interesting, relevant, and empirically grounded general statements. This compilation is the result of a collaborative review, synthesis, and stylization effort on CE knowledge. It makes the existing CE literature digestible to a variety of audiences while also highlighting strengths and weaknesses of research and implementation to-date. 

Each stylized fact is self-contained, using the established technical language of the field. It is accompanied by a statement of evidence, which links to the relevant literature compiled by the authors of the individual facts and multiple internal reviewers from the author team. The stylized facts presented here explore five critical dimensions of the CE: 1. Stock-flow-service nexus and stock growth; 2. Material cycles and R strategies; 3. Global supply chains and environmental impacts; 4. Economic and social challenges and opportunities, including CE business models; and 5. Policy and regulation. We group all facts into these five categories. Neither the list of topics nor the list of facts is exhaustive.

The facts and arguments presented here can serve as the synthesized empirical foundation that can be translated into different forms of science communication, such as teaching material, video lectures, animations, infographics, policy briefings, and more. Such materials could be used across scientific communities, practitioners, and the wider public. By presenting a concise, system-wide perspective, the stylized facts aim to improve understanding of what the CE is, what it can deliver, and where its fundamental limits lie, thereby supporting  more informed decision-making and dialogue across research, policy and practice communities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过协作评审和综合，首次系统性地提炼出关于循环经济（CE）的一组"风格化事实"，涵盖五个关键维度（存量-流量-服务关系、物质循环与R策略、全球供应链与环境影响、经济与社会挑战及机遇、政策与监管），旨在为学术界、实践者和公众提供简明、系统且基于证据的CE知识综合基础。
AI.research_question: 如何将循环经济领域现有的分散知识综合、提炼为一系列有趣、相关且具有经验基础的"风格化事实"，以促进不同受众对CE的理解和应用？
AI.motivation: 现有CE文献庞杂且分散，缺乏一种简洁、系统且经验驱动的知识综合形式，难以被不同受众（学术、实践、政策与公众）消化和利用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济（CE）理论体系；风格化事实（Stylized Facts）作为知识综合与传播的方法论框架。
AI.method: 协作式文献评审、综合与风格化处理（Collaborative review, synthesis, and stylization），由多位作者及内部审稿人基于既有文献编译事实，并为每个事实提供证据声明和文献链接。
AI.findings: 提出了涵盖五个关键维度的循环经济风格化事实体系：1）存量-流量-服务关系与存量增长；2）物质循环与R策略；3）全球供应链与环境影响；4）经济与社会挑战及机遇（含CE商业模式）；5）政策与监管。这些事实可作为经验基础，转化为教学材料、视频、动画、信息图、政策简报等多种科学传播形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将循环经济领域的零散学术知识系统性地提炼为"风格化事实"，为CE理论研究提供了结构化、可验证的经验综合基础，明确了CE的概念边界、潜力与根本局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者、从业者、政策制定者和公众提供了一种易于理解、基于证据的CE全景式视角，支持更明智的决策和跨领域对话；该事实体系可直接转化为多种形式的教育和传播材料。

title: Implementing Generative AI for Proactive Network Performance Monitoring, Anomaly Detection, and Solution Provisioning
affiliations: Softility

detail.title: Implementing Generative AI for Proactive Network Performance Monitoring, Anomaly Detection, and Solution Provisioning
detail.abstract: The increasing complexity of modern cyberphysical environments, driven by 5G and IoT-enabled networks, necessitates intelligent and proactive approaches for network performance monitoring, anomaly detection, and automated response provisioning. Traditional reactive systems are often inadequate for timely threat identification and mitigation. This paper proposes a generative AI-driven framework that integrates Variational Autoencoders (VAE), Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN), TimeGAN, and Diffusion models to learn complex network traffic distributions and detect anomalies in real time. The framework is evaluated using CICIDS2017, UNSW-NB15, and synthetic datasets with rigorous preprocessing, feature engineering, and SMOTEbased class balancing. Experimental results show that TimeGAN achieves superior performance with accuracy up to 0.9887 and F1-score of 0.9618 on CICIDS2017 and 0.9626 on UNSW-NB15, along with low false positive rates and efficient detection latency. The proposed system also incorporates proactive risk prediction and zero-day attack detection, enhancing early warning capabilities. Overall, the framework demonstrates high robustness, scalability, and effectiveness for next-generation intelligent cybersecurity systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于生成式AI（结合VAE、GAN、TimeGAN和扩散模型）的框架，用于实时网络异常检测。在多个数据集上，TimeGAN表现最佳，准确率达0.9887，F1分数达0.9626，并能实现主动风险预测和零日攻击检测。
AI.research_question: 如何利用生成式AI模型构建一个能够实时检测网络异常、主动预测风险并识别零日攻击的智能网络安全框架？
AI.motivation: 5G和物联网环境日益复杂，传统被动式反应系统无法及时识别和缓解网络威胁，亟需主动、智能的网络监控与异常检测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变分自编码器（VAE）、生成对抗网络（GAN）、TimeGAN、扩散模型（Diffusion Models）等生成式AI模型，用于学习复杂网络流量分布。
AI.method: 提出生成式AI驱动框架；使用CICIDS2017、UNSW-NB15和合成数据集进行实验；包含预处理、特征工程、SMOTE类平衡处理；对比VAE、GAN、TimeGAN、扩散模型性能。
AI.findings: TimeGAN在CICIDS2017上准确率达0.9887、F1分数0.9618；在UNSW-NB15上F1分数0.9626；具有低误报率和高效检测延迟；框架具备主动风险预测和零日攻击检测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地比较了四种主流生成式AI模型（VAE、GAN、TimeGAN、扩散模型）在网络异常检测中的性能；验证了TimeGAN在处理时序网络流量数据中的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个高鲁棒性、可扩展的下一代智能网络安全系统框架；实现了主动风险预测和零日攻击检测，增强了早期预警能力；适用于5G和物联网环境下的实时网络安全防护。

title: Deterministic Policy Enforcement for Healthcare RAG: A Runtime Control Pattern for Privacy, Access, and Auditability
