AI.tldr: 本研究利用埃塞俄比亚2021年全国代表性卫生机构数据，构建了综合应急准备指数（CERI），评估了产科和新生儿紧急护理准备情况，发现全国平均CERI为57.4（加权），存在显著地区差异（阿姆哈拉地区最高62.5，亚的斯亚贝巴最低27.8）和中等程度不平等（基尼系数0.374）。综合医院准备度最高（89.1），中型诊所最低（5.6），公立机构（78.5）远高于私营机构（10.5）。提供者可用性和催产素可用性与CERI正相关。
AI.research_question: 埃塞俄比亚卫生机构在产科和新生儿紧急护理方面的综合准备度如何？其全国分布、地理变异、不平等程度以及相关的机构层面因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管埃塞俄比亚在孕产妇和新生儿健康方面投入了大量资金并扩大了紧急产科服务，但机构准备度方面的持续差距仍然限制了生命救助服务的提供。以往研究主要关注服务可用性或个别准备度组成部分，缺乏对多维紧急准备度及其地理变异性的综合评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合应急准备指数（CERI）构建基于结构方程模型，运用潜在变量方法整合紧急产科和新生儿护理所需的基本药物、设备和临床指南。空间分析基于贝叶斯分层空间回归模型，采用随机偏微分方程方法结合集成嵌套拉普拉斯近似。
AI.method: 基于2021年埃塞俄比亚服务提供评估中776家卫生机构的全国代表性横截面数据，使用结构方程模型构建潜在综合应急准备指数（CERI），采用空间自相关分析和贝叶斯分层空间回归模型（SPDE-INLA方法）评估机构特征与应急准备度之间的关联。
AI.findings: 全国加权平均CERI为57.4（SE 2.6），地区差异显著（从亚的斯亚贝巴的27.8到阿姆哈拉的62.5），全国不平等程度中等（基尼系数0.374）。综合医院准备度最高（89.1），中型诊所最低（5.6），政府机构（78.5）高于私营机构（10.5）。提供者可用性和催产素可用性与CERI正相关，中型诊所与较低CERI相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多维指标综合为单一潜在指数（CERI），填补了以往研究仅关注单一准备度组成部分的空白，为评估卫生系统应急准备能力提供了更全面的测量框架。同时，运用贝叶斯空间模型揭示了地理变异性和空间依赖结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了埃塞俄比亚产科和新生儿紧急护理准备度的显著不平等和地理差异，为政策制定者优化资源配置提供了依据。识别了提供者可用性和催产素可用性等可干预的关键因素，以及中型诊所和私营机构等需要重点支持的薄弱环节。

title: Climate-Sensitive Energy Poverty during the European Energy Crisis: Heating-Price Shocks, Pre-Crisis Trajectories and Regional Heating Demand
affiliations: Cracow University of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Climate-Sensitive Energy Poverty during the European Energy Crisis: Heating-Price Shocks, Pre-Crisis Trajectories and Regional Heating Demand
detail.abstract: This paper examines why the European energy crisis produced different energy-poverty outcomes across countries and regions. We argue that the social consequences of heating-price shocks depend on two factors: pre-existing vulnerability and climate-related heating needs. Using an annual panel of 24 European countries over 2007–2024 and complementary NUTS-2 regional data, we combine country-specific pre-crisis energy-poverty trends, heating-energy price shocks, and heating degree days.The results show that energy poverty rose above the path implied by pre-crisis trends during 2021–2024. These deviations were larger in countries with less favourable pre-crisis trajectories. Heating-energy price shocks were also more strongly associated with energy poverty in countries with higher structural heating demand. This relationship is weaker when prices are measured using a broad energy-price index rather than a heating-specific index. At the regional level, colder-than-usual NUTS-2 regions tended to report higher energy poverty within the same country and year.The findings show that energy-price shocks do not translate uniformly into household hardship. Their effects depend on inherited vulnerability and the heating needs under which households experience them. Energy-poverty monitoring and crisis preparedness should therefore account for pre-crisis trajectories, heating-specific prices, and regional differences in heating demand.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧洲能源危机如何在不同国家和区域产生不同的能源贫困结果。作者认为，供暖价格冲击的社会后果取决于两个因素：既有的脆弱性和与气候相关的供暖需求。基于2007-2024年24个欧洲国家的面板数据及NUTS-2区域数据，研究发现能源贫困在2021-2024年间显著高于危机前趋势，这种偏离在危机前轨迹不利的国家更大；供暖价格冲击与能源贫困的关联在供暖需求高的国家更强；在区域层面，同一年同一国家内比往常更冷的地区能源贫困更高。
AI.research_question: 欧洲能源危机为何在不同国家和区域产生了不同的能源贫困结果？供暖价格冲击的社会后果如何受到既有脆弱性和气候供暖需求的影响？
AI.motivation: 欧洲能源危机对不同国家和地区造成了不同程度的能源贫困，但现有研究缺乏对异质性结果的系统解释。作者试图从结构性脆弱性和气候供暖需求两个维度，解释为什么同样的价格冲击会产生不同的社会后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 能源贫困的路径依赖理论：危机前能源贫困轨迹反映了结构性脆弱性；2) 供暖需求理论：气候条件（供暖度日数）决定了家庭对供暖能源的基本需求，进而影响价格冲击的传导强度。
AI.method: 采用2007-2024年24个欧洲国家的年度面板数据，辅以NUTS-2区域层面的数据。将危机前各国能源贫困趋势、供暖能源价格冲击和供暖度日数结合起来进行回归分析。
AI.findings: 1) 2021-2024年间能源贫困显著高于危机前趋势所预示的水平；2) 危机前轨迹越不利的国家，能源贫困偏离越大；3) 供暖价格冲击与能源贫困的关联在供暖需求高的国家更强；4) 使用宽泛能源价格指数（非供暖专项指数）时，这种关系更弱；5) 区域层面，同一年同一国家内，比往常更冷的地区能源贫困更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了能源价格冲击转化为家庭困难的非均匀传导机制，强调了既有脆弱性和气候供暖需求的调节作用，区分了宽泛能源价格与供暖专项价格的不同效应，为能源贫困的异质性研究提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为能源贫困监测和危机应对提供政策启示：应关注危机前轨迹、使用供暖专项价格指标、考虑区域供暖需求差异，而非仅依赖宽泛能源价格指数。

title: Mixed-Frequency Forecasting of Monthly Electricity Demand: A Regime-Aware Framework​
affiliations: Tianjin University, College of Management and Economics and China Center for Social Computing and Analytics and Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS)

detail.title: Mixed-Frequency Forecasting of Monthly Electricity Demand: A Regime-Aware Framework​
detail.abstract: Abstract ：Accurate monthly electricity demand forecasting is challenged by the changing of economic prosperity, production behaviors and weather conditions. Multi-benchmark tests revealed that forecasting failures cluster synchronously across models, occurring during three exogenous states: moving holiday shifts, acute climate anomalies, and cross-industry transmission under extreme tail conditions. To address this, utilizing high-dimensional mixed-frequency data from a province in China, we propose REDS (Regime-aware Elastic Dynamic Scheme), a framework integrating variable selection, non-linear state extraction, and multi-scale inter-industry network learning to dynamically model regime shifts and cross-sectoral transmission. Empirical results show that REDS could not only improve overall forecasting accuracy but also suppresses the clustered propagation of forecasting failures during extreme regimes. This study offers a mechanism-driven framework for managing regional energy uncertainties and enhancing grid resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REDS（Regime-aware Elastic Dynamic Scheme）框架，通过整合变量选择、非线性状态提取和多尺度产业间网络学习，动态建模体制转换和跨部门传导，有效提升了月度电力需求预测精度，并抑制了极端状态下预测失败的集群传播。
AI.research_question: 如何应对经济景气、生产行为和天气条件变化带来的月度电力需求预测挑战，特别是预测失败在多种模型中同步集群发生的极端状态问题？
AI.motivation: 月度电力需求预测常因经济景气变化、生产行为调整和天气条件波动而失准。多基准测试发现，预测失败会在三种外生状态（移动假期偏移、严重气候异常、极端尾部条件下的跨行业传导）下跨模型同步集群发生，亟需一种能够动态识别体制转换并抑制预测失败传播的机制驱动型框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体制转换（Regime-switching）理论、高维混合频率数据整合、非线性状态提取、多尺度产业间网络学习。
AI.method: 利用中国某省份的高维混合频率数据，构建REDS（Regime-aware Elastic Dynamic Scheme）框架，该框架整合了变量选择、非线性状态提取和多尺度产业间网络学习，以动态建模体制转换和跨部门传导效应。
AI.findings: REDS不仅提升了整体预测精度，还能有效抑制极端体制下预测失败的集群传播。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个融合体制感知、弹性动态建模和跨行业网络学习的预测框架，为处理高维混合频率数据中的体制转换问题提供了新思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理区域能源不确定性、增强电网韧性提供了一个机制驱动型的实用预测方案。

title: Sovereign AI without Models: Weaponized Interdependence at the Cognitive Layer
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Sovereign AI without Models: Weaponized Interdependence at the Cognitive Layer
detail.abstract: States that host none of the frontier artificial intelligence laboratories increasingly frame their predicament as a loss of sovereignty and prescribe ownership-of models, compute, and data-as its remedy. The article argues that this framing misconstrues both the problem and the available strategies. Extending Farrell and Newman's theory of weaponized interdependence, it identifies a new hub type: the capability-gradient hub, whose centrality derives from a compounding technological lead rather than network topology, and whose panopticon observes intentions rather than transactions. The United States' Genesis Mission is read as hub formation, binding frontier cognition to the American scientific estate; the June 2026 suspension of two frontier models-cognition halted while compute ran on-demonstrates that the cognitive layer is separately weaponizable. Scope conditions are specified against the open-weight diffusion objection. Japan, weakest at the cognitive layer yet holding lower-stratum chokepoints, exemplifies the recommended strategy: managed interdependence with named terms.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了"无前沿AI实验室国家"将问题框定为"主权丧失"并以拥有模型、算力和数据作为解决方案的观点，认为这误解了问题本质。作者扩展了Farrell和Newman的"武器化相互依存"理论，提出"能力梯度枢纽"这一新枢纽类型——其核心地位源于技术领先而非网络拓扑，其全景监狱监视的是意图而非交易。文章将美国的"创世纪使命"解读为枢纽形成过程，将前沿认知绑定至美国科学体系；2026年6月两大前沿模型被暂停（认知停止而算力继续运行）则证明认知层可被单独武器化。针对开放权重扩散的反对意见，文章明确了适用条件。日本因在认知层最弱但拥有下游瓶颈，被推荐采取"有命名的管理型相互依存"策略。
AI.research_question: 无前沿AI实验室的国家如何理解并应对人工智能领域的主权困境？现有"所有权"解决方案为何有缺陷？
AI.motivation: 越来越多国家将自身缺乏前沿AI实验室的处境视为主权丧失，并主张通过拥有模型、算力和数据来恢复主权。这种框架既误判了问题本质，也忽视了可行的战略选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Farrell和Newman的"武器化相互依存"理论，提出"能力梯度枢纽"概念——区别于传统网络拓扑枢纽，其权力源于持续的技术领先优势；并引入"认知层"可被单独武器化的分析维度。
AI.method: 理论建构与案例研究：分析美国"创世纪使命"（枢纽形成）、2026年6月两大前沿模型暂停（认知层武器化）、日本案例（下游瓶颈持有者的应对策略）。
AI.findings: 1. "能力梯度枢纽"是一种新的权力枢纽类型，其权力来源是技术领先而非网络位置；2. 认知层（而非仅算力层）可被单独武器化；3. 开放权重扩散并不构成充分的反驳，需明确scope conditions；4. 像日本这样在认知层最弱但拥有下游瓶颈的国家，应采取"有命名的管理型相互依存"策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 对"武器化相互依存"理论的重要扩展：引入"能力梯度枢纽"概念，补充了枢纽类型的理论谱系；提出认知层可被单独武器化，丰富了数字技术地缘政治的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为缺乏前沿AI实验室的国家提供了更准确的战略诊断框架：应避免"所有权"幻觉，转而关注在认知层、算力层、数据层中自身所掌握的特定瓶颈（如日本的下游优势），并采取"有命名的管理型相互依存"策略。

title: The Enduring Value Of Holding Ourselves To Our Enduring Values: A Reflection Honoring The OECD’s Guidelines For Multinational Enterprises On Responsible Business Conduct
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School

detail.title: The Enduring Value Of Holding Ourselves To Our Enduring Values: A Reflection Honoring The OECD’s Guidelines For Multinational Enterprises On Responsible Business Conduct
detail.abstract: This lecture was given at the 50th Anniversary OECD Global Forum on Responsible Business Conduct.  In keeping with the occasion, the lecture underscores the importance of remembering our long-held principles at a time when they are under threat.  Since their adoption in 1976, the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises on Responsible Business Conduct have articulated — with long-standing, bipartisan support by the United States — the principles of responsible business conduct that best facilitate sustainable economic development and support democracy.  The Guidelines encourage multinational enterprises to seek profit by selling safe, useful products and services while respecting the legitimate expectations of all affected by their conduct, including workers (direct and in their supply chain), consumers, communities of operation, and the environment we all depend upon.  The Guidelines encourage competition on the basis of quality and innovation, in a marketplace governed by the rule of law, and discourage corruption and kleptocracy that undermines economic progress and democracy.  Importantly, the Guidelines require corporations to recognize their duty to better the lives of the people most indispensable to corporate success — their workers — by paying living wages, giving them safe and dignified working conditions, and listening to their voices.  It may seem hypocritical to commemorate the Guidelines when so many corporations and governments seem to be turning away from these animating principles.  But there is something worse than hypocrisy; that is losing sight of the principles that allow the many to hold the powerful accountable for the duties they owe to the many.  The Guidelines thus stand as a valuable expression of the widely shared, durable values of the most democratic and market-oriented societies on Earth and valuable benchmarks against which to measure the conduct of not just multinational enterprises, but government leaders.  This lecture thus urges OECD governments and the global business community to try to live up to the Guidelines and advances several ideas that the OECD could embrace to make progress toward that goal during this dangerous and uncertain time.

AI.tldr: 本文是在OECD《跨国企业负责任商业行为准则》发布50周年纪念论坛上的演讲，强调在准则面临威胁的当下，必须坚守这一体现民主与市场社会核心价值观的重要文件，并呼吁OECD各国政府和全球商界努力践行准则。
AI.research_question: 在OECD跨国企业准则面临威胁的当下，如何重新确认和践行该准则所倡导的负责任商业行为原则？
AI.motivation: 许多企业和政府正在背离OECD准则确立的负责任商业行为原则，值此50周年之际，有必要重申这些原则的重要性，并防止社会丧失对"让强者对弱者负责"这一核心理念的坚守。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负责任商业行为理论、民主与市场经济价值观、利益相关方理论（包括工人、消费者、社区和环境）、法治与企业责任框架。
AI.method: 纪念演讲/评论性文章，结合历史回顾、原则阐述和现实呼吁。
AI.findings: OECD准则自1976年以来一直是表达民主和市场导向社会持久价值观的重要文件，是衡量跨国企业和政府领导者行为的宝贵基准；当前准则虽面临威胁，但放弃原则比虚伪更危险。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新确认了负责任商业行为准则与民主制度、可持续经济发展之间的理论关联；强调了工人权益（生活工资、安全尊严的工作条件、倾听工人声音）在负责任商业行为中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 呼吁OECD各国政府和全球商界在当前危险不确定时期努力践行准则；提出了OECD可以采纳的具体行动思路以推动准则落实。

detail.title: Sovereign AI without Models: Weaponized Interdependence at the Cognitive Layer
detail.abstract: States that host none of the frontier artificial intelligence laboratories increasingly frame their predicament as a loss of sovereignty and prescribe ownership-of models, compute, and data-as its remedy. The article argues that this framing misconstrues both the problem and the available strategies. Extending Farrell and Newman's theory of weaponized interdependence, it identifies a new hub type: the capability-gradient hub, whose centrality derives from a compounding technological lead rather than network topology, and whose panopticon observes intentions rather than transactions. AI.tldr: 本文批判了非前沿AI实验室所在国家将"失去主权"归咎于缺乏AI模型、算力与数据所有权的叙事，提出这是一种误解。作者扩展了Farrell和Newman的"武器化相互依赖"理论，识别出一种新的枢纽类型——"能力梯度枢纽"——其核心地位源于技术领先的累积效应而非网络拓扑结构。美国"创世纪任务"被视为这种枢纽的形成；2026年6月两个前沿模型被暂停（认知层暂停而算力层继续运行）证明认知层可被单独武器化。文章还限定了开放权重扩散的边界条件，并推荐日本（认知层最弱但拥有下层瓶颈）采取"有条件的相互依赖"策略。
AI.research_question: 非前沿AI实验室所在国家如何错误地将AI技术差距框架化为"主权丧失"问题，以及何种理论框架能更准确地解释当前AI地缘政治格局中的权力不对称？
AI.motivation: 许多国家将缺乏AI前沿模型所有权视为主权威胁并寻求自给自足，作者认为这种认知是错误的，需要提出更准确的理论框架来理解AI领域的权力结构与应对策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 扩展Farrell和Newman的"武器化相互依赖"理论；提出"能力梯度枢纽"概念（区别于传统网络拓扑枢纽）；认知层与算力层的分离概念。
AI.method: 理论扩展与概念分析；案例研究（美国"创世纪任务"、2026年6月前沿模型暂停事件）；边界条件分析（开放权重扩散）；比较分析（日本案例）。
AI.findings: 1) "能力梯度枢纽"是一种新型枢纽，其权力源于技术领先的累积而非网络节点位置；2) 认知层可被单独武器化（算力运行而认知暂停）；3) 开放权重扩散并不能完全破除这种权力不对称；4) 拥有下层瓶颈的国家（如日本）应采取"有条件的相互依赖"而非追求自给自足。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了"武器化相互依赖"理论，新增"能力梯度枢纽"类型；区分了认知层与算力层的可分离武器化逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非前沿AI国家提供了替代"主权叙事"的战略思路：放弃不切实际的自主追求，转而利用自身在下层瓶颈（如算力基础设施）中的优势，采取有条件的相互依赖策略。

title: Knowledge Management Support Policies and Practices for Policymaking in the Islamic Consultative Assembly
affiliations: Imam Hossein University, Imam Hossein University and Imam Hossein University

detail.title: Knowledge Management Support Policies and Practices for Policymaking in the Islamic Consultative Assembly
detail.abstract: In parliamentary settings, the quality of policymaking depends on the extent to which accumulated knowledge, evidence, and experience are accessible and effectively utilized. Despite the importance of this issue, there is no comprehensive understanding of the knowledge management support policies and practices employed in the policymaking process of the Islamic Consultative Assembly of Iran. Accordingly, the present study aimed to identify the policies and practices through which knowledge management supports policymaking in the Islamic Consultative Assembly of Iran. This applied study adopted a qualitative approach and was conducted using Glaserian grounded theory. Data were collected through 27 semi-structured interviews with current and former members of parliament, experts from the Islamic Parliament Research Center, parliamentary committee experts, parliamentary staff, and university faculty members. The data were analyzed through constant comparison, open coding, and theoretical coding. The findings indicated that knowledge management support for policymaking requires the establishment of policies and practices in the areas of knowledge governance, policy memory, enhancement of knowledge trustworthiness, knowledge translation and packaging, expert networking, integration of knowledge resources, and institutional learning. The results suggest that the principal challenge facing the parliament is not a shortage of information, but rather the absence of institutional mechanisms for transforming fragmented knowledge into knowledge that can be used in decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用格拉泽扎根理论方法，通过27次半结构化访谈，识别出伊朗伊斯兰议会中知识管理支持政策制定的七项关键政策与实践领域：知识治理、政策记忆、知识可信度提升、知识翻译与包装、专家网络构建、知识资源整合及制度学习。研究发现议会面临的主要挑战不是信息匮乏，而是缺乏将碎片化知识转化为可用于决策的知识的制度机制。
AI.research_question: 伊朗伊斯兰议会在政策制定过程中采用了哪些知识管理支持政策与实践？
AI.motivation: 政策制定质量依赖于知识、证据和经验的可及性与有效利用，但目前对伊朗伊斯兰议会中知识管理如何支持政策制定缺乏全面理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 格拉泽扎根理论（Glaserian grounded theory）
AI.method: 应用型定性研究，采用格拉泽扎根理论方法。通过27次半结构化访谈收集数据，访谈对象包括现任及前任议员、伊斯兰议会研究中心专家、议会委员会专家、议会工作人员及大学教职人员。数据分析采用持续比较法、开放式编码和理论编码。
AI.findings: 知识管理支持政策制定需要在七个领域建立政策与实践：知识治理、政策记忆、知识可信度提升、知识翻译与包装、专家网络构建、知识资源整合及制度学习。议会面临的核心挑战是缺乏将碎片化知识转化为可用于决策知识的制度机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统识别了议会情境下知识管理支持政策制定的关键维度，揭示了碎片化知识与可决策知识之间转化的制度障碍，拓展了知识管理理论在立法机构中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊朗伊斯兰议会及其他类似立法机构提供了建立知识管理支持体系的实践框架，指出了知识治理、制度学习和知识整合等具体可操作的政策方向。

title: Regime Failure and Workaround Formation: A Theory of Economic Transition

detail.title: Regime Failure and Workaround Formation: A Theory of Economic Transition
detail.abstract: This paper develops a theory of economic transition in which regimes persist while they remain the least-maintenance viable architecture under resource constraints. A regime is defined not as a date range, ideology, or policy label, but as a stabilising architecture that absorbs systemic stress at tolerable maintenance cost. The central mechanism is stabiliser-transmitter reversal: the anchor that once reduced volatility eventually becomes the channel through which stress is transmitted. Agents exposed to that transmission adopt costly workarounds. If adoption generates network benefits and raises systemic capacity, a workaround can become a viable architecture before the incumbent anchor fully collapses. Transition occurs when that workaround becomes the least-maintenance viable architecture available to the system manager. The model generates four main results: inefficient regime persistence, endogenous transition through workaround scaling, under-adoption relative to the social optimum, and a delayinformation tradeoff. Higher adoption frictions delay transition, but observed adoption under high friction is more informative about the domain of the future regime because costly adoption screens low-quality domains. The paper also defines a breakdown region in which no architecture is viable under the prevailing resource envelope, distinguishes transition from breakdown, and states the comparative statics implied by the model under explicit single-crossing and survivallikelihood-ratio conditions. A short application to technology-regime precursors illustrates the model but is explicitly separated from empirical proof.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个经济转型理论，将体制定义为在资源约束下以最低维护成本吸收系统性压力的稳定架构。核心机制是稳定器-传输器反转：原本降低波动的锚点最终成为压力传输通道，受影响的代理人采用昂贵变通方案，当变通方案成为系统管理者可用的最低维护可行架构时，转型发生。模型得出四个主要结果：低效体制持续、内生转型、低于社会最优的采纳率、以及延迟-信息权衡。
AI.research_question: 经济体制如何从一种稳定架构转型为另一种？转型何时发生、为何可能延迟或低效？
AI.motivation: 传统经济转型理论多将体制视为日期范围或政策标签，缺乏对转型内生机制的形式化理解。本文希望提供一个将体制视为稳定架构的微观基础理论，解释体制为何持续存在以及如何内生转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 稳定器-传输器反转机制、网络效应下的变通方案采纳、最低维护可行架构原则、单交叉与生存似然比条件。
AI.method: 理论建模，形式化分析，包括比较静态分析和信息经济学推理。
AI.findings: （1）低效体制持续：即使体制已不再高效，仍因维护成本优势而存续；（2）内生转型：变通方案通过网络效应规模化，成为新的最低维护架构；（3）社会性采纳不足：代理人采纳变通方案的水平低于社会最优；（4）延迟-信息权衡：高采纳摩擦延迟转型，但使观察到的采纳行为对未来体制领域更具信息量。
AI.theory_contributions: 将体制重新定义为稳定架构，提出稳定器-传输器反转机制作为转型的核心驱动力，形式化区分转型与崩溃，揭示延迟-信息权衡这一新的理论洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解体制转型的时序、识别体制崩溃的前兆信号、设计促进转型的干预措施提供理论框架；特别指出高摩擦环境中的采纳行为可能包含更多关于未来体制的信息。

title: Protection Against Air Pollution in International and EU Environmental Law
affiliations: NATIONAL KAPODISTRIAN UNIVERSITY OF ATHENS

detail.title: Protection Against Air Pollution in International and EU Environmental Law
detail.abstract: The study examines the legal framework for addressing air pollution at both international and EU levels. It explores major multilateral environmental agreements, such as the Geneva Convention on Long-Range Transboundary Air Pollution and the Montreal Protocol, alongside the EU Directive 2008/50/EC on air quality. The analysis focuses on principles of prevention and restoration, while assessing the relationship between air pollution law and climate change law. The study highlights legislative contributions to reducing pollutant emissions, case law on air quality management, and progress toward cleaner air. Recommendations include enhancing cooperation and promoting innovative measures.

AI.tldr: 本文从国际法和欧盟法两个层面系统分析了空气污染治理的法律框架，重点探讨了《日内瓦远距离越境空气污染公约》《蒙特利尔议定书》及欧盟2008/50/EC指令等关键法律文件，并提出加强合作与创新措施的建议。
AI.research_question: 国际与欧盟层面空气污染治理的法律框架如何构建？空气污染法与气候变化法之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 空气污染是全球性环境挑战，现有法律框架分散且复杂，亟需系统性梳理国际与欧盟层面的法律制度，明确预防与恢复原则的适用，并厘清空气污染法与气候变化法之间的互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预防原则、恢复原则；国际环境法框架（多边环境协定）；欧盟环境法框架
AI.method: 法律文本分析；案例分析法；比较法研究
AI.findings: （1）国际和欧盟层面已形成以预防和恢复原则为核心的空气污染法律框架；（2）空气污染法与气候变化法之间存在交叉与协同关系；（3）相关立法在减少污染物排放方面取得了一定成效；（4）案例法在空气质量管理中发挥了重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了国际与欧盟空气污染法律框架，阐明了预防与恢复原则在其中的具体适用，并厘清了空气污染法与气候变化法的理论关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了加强国际合作、推动创新治理措施的具体建议，有助于进一步完善空气污染治理的法律实践。

title: Cross-National Diversity and Environmental Sustainability: Global Evidence and Organizational Mechanisms for Achieving the SDGs
affiliations: Singapore Management University, Chulalongkorn University and

detail.title: Cross-National Diversity and Environmental Sustainability: Global Evidence and Organizational Mechanisms for Achieving the SDGs
detail.abstract: This study investigates how cross-national diversity within top management teams (TMTs) influences corporate environmental sustainability. Drawing on a large and globally representative panel dataset of 3,798 publicly listed firms across 81 countries over an 18-year period, we employ a multi-method empirical strategy that integrates fixed effects panel regressions, a Difference-inDifferences (DiD) design, and an Instrumental Variables (IV) approach to address endogeneity and strengthen causal inference. We find that greater TMT cross-national diversity is significantly associated with improved environmental performance, as evidenced by lower carbon emissions and reduced carbon intensity. Our analysis further demonstrates two key organizational mechanisms that contribute to this relationship: (1) increased adoption of sustainable operations and responsible supply chain practices, and (2) stronger institutionalization of environmental priorities via sustainability-oriented governance structures. These findings underscore the strategic importance of leadership diversity in advancing environmental responsiveness and offer insights for firms and policymakers committed to achieving SDG 13 (Climate Action), SDG 12 (Responsible Consumption and Production), and SDG 16 (Peace, Justice, and Strong Institutions).

AI.tldr: 本研究利用全球81个国家3,798家上市公司18年的面板数据，发现高管团队（TMT）的跨国多样性显著提升了企业环境绩效（降低碳排放和碳强度），其机制是通过促进可持续运营与供应链实践，以及建立可持续发展导向的治理结构。
AI.research_question: 高管团队跨国多样性如何影响企业环境可持续性？
AI.motivation: 在全球化背景下，企业面临日益严峻的环境可持续性挑战，但高层管理团队的跨国多样性（国籍多样性）对环境绩效的影响尚缺乏系统的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 上层梯队理论（Upper Echelons Theory）、资源依赖理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 固定效应面板回归、双重差分（DiD）设计、工具变量（IV）法；样本涵盖81个国家3,798家上市公司，时间跨度18年。
AI.findings: TMT跨国多样性与企业环境绩效正相关，具体表现为更低的碳排放和碳强度。两个组织机制：（1）增加可持续运营和负责任供应链实践；（2）通过可持续导向的治理结构强化环境优先事项的制度化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将上层梯队理论扩展到跨国多样性维度，揭示了TMT国籍构成影响企业环境战略的因果机制，丰富了多样性治理与环境可持续性的交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业全球化背景下高管团队组建提供战略指引，强调跨国多样性对环境绩效的战略价值；为政策制定者推动SDG 12、13、16提供实证依据。

title: The Rise of Green Regions: Do Leaders Matter?
affiliations: ,  and Syracuse University

detail.title: The Rise of Green Regions: Do Leaders Matter?
detail.abstract: The paper studies the emergence of environmental policies and green places, where regional governments are strategic actors in the green transition. We build a tractable quantitative spatial general equilibrium model in which regions with heterogeneous sizes, income, and environmental awareness compete to attract users of sustainable transport modes through environmental subsidies. We show that environmental awareness interacts with regional size to generate asymmetric policy adoption. Early adopters reshape the diffusion process: regions with large populations or high awareness emerge as green leaders that stimulate subsequent adoption through interregional competition. Once fully green, however, these leaders slow the transition of follower regions. An empirical application to French regions shows that completing the green transition requires a large increase in environmental expenditure, from negligible observed levels to about 13% of existing local tax revenues. It also reveals asymmetric leadership spillovers: early entrants not only accelerate adoption but also raise environmental policy in other regions, while early green transitions mainly delay convergence with limited effects on policy intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个量化空间一般均衡模型，研究区域政府在绿色转型中作为战略行动者如何通过环境补贴竞争，发现区域规模与环境意识相互作用产生非对称政策采纳，早期采纳者会重塑扩散过程，但完全绿色后会减缓追随者的转型。
AI.research_question: 区域政府在绿色转型中如何通过环境补贴竞争，以及区域规模和环境意识如何影响环境政策的采纳与扩散？
AI.motivation: 现实中区域政府在绿色转型中扮演关键角色，但其战略互动如何影响环境政策的采纳和绿色空间的形成尚不明确，尤其是区域异质性（规模、收入、环境意识）的作用未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量化空间一般均衡模型，结合区域竞争理论、政策扩散理论，以及环境经济学中的非对称采纳机制。
AI.method: 构建可处理的量化空间一般均衡模型，并进行法国区域的实证应用分析。
AI.findings: 1) 环境意识与区域规模相互作用产生非对称政策采纳；2) 早期采纳者（人口多或意识高的区域）成为绿色领导者，通过区域间竞争刺激后续采纳；3) 一旦完全绿色，领导者会减缓追随者的转型；4) 完成绿色转型需要环境支出从当前可忽略水平增至地方税收的约13%；5) 早期进入者既加速采纳也提高其他区域的环境政策强度，而早期完全绿色主要延迟收敛且对政策强度影响有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 将区域战略互动与空间异质性纳入绿色转型分析，揭示了绿色领导者的双重角色（早期促进、后期抑制），丰富了政策扩散理论和环境联邦主义文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为区域政府设计环境补贴政策提供参考，量化了法国完成绿色转型所需的财政投入规模，并揭示了早期绿色领导者对区域间政策收敛的影响机制。

title: The Moderating Role of Financial Development in the Human Capital-Growth Nexus: Evidence from Middle Income Countries
affiliations: Zhongnan University of Economics and Law

detail.title: The Moderating Role of Financial Development in the Human Capital-Growth Nexus: Evidence from Middle Income Countries
detail.abstract: This study investigates the moderating role of financial development in the relationship between human capital and economic growth in middle-income countries. Using panel data from the World Development Indicators (WDI), the study employs Ordinary Least Squares (OLS), Fixed Effects (FE), Random Effects (RE), Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), and MEDSEM analysis. Human capital is measured through a PCA-based Human Capital Index (HCI) and the World Bank Human Capital Development Index (HCD), while financial development is proxied by domestic credit to the private sector. The findings reveal that both human capital and financial development positively and significantly influence economic growth. The interaction term between human capital and financial development is also positive and significant, indicating that financial development strengthens the growth-enhancing effect of human capital. Furthermore, mediation analysis shows that financial development partially transmits the impact of human capital on economic growth. The study concludes that human capital and financial development are complementary drivers of economic growth and recommends simultaneous investment in education and financial sector development to achieve sustainable economic growth in middleincome countries.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了中等收入国家中金融发展在人力资本与经济增长关系中的调节作用。基于面板数据，采用OLS、FE、RE、SEM和MEDSEM等多种方法分析发现：人力资本和金融发展均显著促进经济增长，且金融发展正向调节人力资本的增长效应，同时部分中介了人力资本对经济增长的传导作用。
AI.research_question: 在中等收入国家中，金融发展如何调节人力资本与经济增长之间的关系？金融发展是否中介了人力资本对经济增长的影响？
AI.motivation: 中等收入国家面临如何实现可持续经济增长的挑战，人力资本和金融发展被认为是关键因素，但两者之间的交互作用机制尚未充分探索，特别是金融发展在人力资本-增长关系中的调节与中介作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论（Becker, Schultz等）；金融发展与经济增长理论（Schumpeter, Levine等）；金融发展调节人力资本增长的互补性假设。
AI.method: 面板数据分析，采用OLS、固定效应（FE）、随机效应（RE）、结构方程模型（SEM）和MEDSEM方法。人力资本使用PCA构建的人力资本指数（HCI）和世界银行人力资本发展指数（HCD）衡量；金融发展以对私营部门的国内信贷作为代理变量。
AI.findings: （1）人力资本和金融发展均正向显著影响经济增长；（2）人力资本与金融发展的交互项正向显著，表明金融发展强化了人力资本对经济增长的促进作用；（3）中介分析表明金融发展部分传导了人力资本对经济增长的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了金融发展在人力资本-增长关系中的双重角色——既是调节变量（增强效应），又是中介变量（传导效应），拓展了人力资本理论与金融发展理论的整合视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议中等收入国家应同步推进教育投资（人力资本积累）和金融部门发展，以实现可持续经济增长，为政策制定者提供了明确的投资协同方向。

title: Examining the Mediation and Moderation Effects of Human Development and Financial Market Depth in the Education-Health-Sustainability Nexus: Evidence from Germany
affiliations: Jahangirnagar University

detail.title: Examining the Mediation and Moderation Effects of Human Development and Financial Market Depth in the Education-Health-Sustainability Nexus: Evidence from Germany

AI.tldr: 本研究利用德国1995-2025年372个月度观测数据，发现人类发展指数（HDI）在社会支出与可持续发展之间发挥中介作用，金融市场深度（SMD）则调节教育支出的HDI效应。健康支出对HDI有显著正向影响，而教育支出的影响在SMD达到GDP 45-50%时才显著。
AI.research_question: 社会支出如何通过HDI的中介作用和金融市场深度的调节作用影响德国的可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多采用线性财政模型分析社会支出与可持续发展的关系，忽视了金融结构对社会回报的非对称性影响机制，且缺乏高频月度数据的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重中介-调节框架（dual-layered mediation–moderation framework），基于Hayes (2022)和Aiken & West (1991)的交互效应构建方法。
AI.method: 采用OLS回归（Newey–West HAC标准误，滞后12期），偏差校正加速（BCa）自助法（5000次重抽样）验证间接效应，简单斜率分析（±1 SD）检验调节效应，并包含动态LDV和Granger因果稳健性检验。
AI.findings: (1) HDI是可持续发展的主导驱动因素（β=169.52, p<0.001）；(2) 健康支出显著正向驱动HDI（α₂=0.0239, p<0.001），且中介路径显著（BCa 95% CI: [3.408, 4.755]）；(3) 教育支出的HDI效应取决于金融市场深度（阈值约为GDP的45-50%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了月度高频证据（N=372），证明金融结构不对称地调节教育和健康支出的社会回报，超越了传统线性财政模型的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于社会支出配置的阈值条件：健康支出在任何金融深度下均有效，而教育支出仅在金融市场达到一定深度（GDP的45-50%）时才能有效提升HDI和可持续发展。

title: Keeping the House in the Family: Non-Market Transfers and the Supply of American Homes
affiliations: University of Cincinnati

detail.title: Keeping the House in the Family: Non-Market Transfers and the Supply of American Homes
detail.abstract: A large share of American homes change hands without a market. Using 144 million deed records covering the universe of recorded residential transfers from 2007 to 2023, this paper provides the first national deeds-based accounting of intra-family housing transfers. After stripping out trust retitling and same-person co-owner changes, families moved nearly 20 million homes between relatives over this period -- one family transfer for every 3.6 market sales -- almost always at a recorded price of zero. These transfers are not a staging step toward sale: three in five family transferred homes have not sold on the open market a decade later. A simple model shows that when heirs inherit a below-market property-tax assessment along with the house, as permitted by California's Propositions 13, 58, and 193, families keep homes that the market values more. California's Proposition 19, which abruptly ended assessment inheritance for non-occupant heirs in February 2021, provides a natural experiment to examine the effect of this tax wedge on family transfers. Family transfers surged 31% above counterfactual in the four months before the effective date and then fell to a new, persistently lower level: a donor-weighted synthetic control reveals a 2022-2023 decline of 33%, which decreases to 26% after adjusting for the elderly population. Net of California's own market-sale slump, the missing flow is roughly 58,000 deeds per year. The homes that exited the family channel have not yet surfaced as estate sales, indicating deferred successions rather than immediate listings. Our results suggest that family transfers are not outside the housing market but are one of its allocation mechanisms and property-tax rules can shift scarce homes from price-based matching to lineage-based retention.

AI.tldr: 本文利用1.44亿份 deed 记录，首次对美国2007-2023年间家庭内部房屋转让进行全国性核算，发现近2000万套房屋在亲属间转移（每3.6笔市场交易对应1笔家庭转让），且大多以零价格记录。加州的 Proposition 19 自然实验表明，财产税规则会显著影响家庭转让行为，使房屋从市场定价分配转向基于血缘的保留。
AI.research_question: 美国家庭内部房屋转让的规模有多大？财产税规则如何影响家庭转让行为以及住房市场的分配机制？
AI.motivation: 大量美国房屋通过非市场方式（家庭内部转让）交易，但此前缺乏全国性的系统核算；理解家庭转让的规模及其对住房市场的影响，对于评估财产税政策对住房分配效率的作用至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房分配的双重机制理论：市场价格匹配 vs. 血缘关系保留；税收楔子（tax wedge）对家庭转让决策的影响；Proposition 19 自然实验框架
AI.method: 基于1.44亿份 deed 记录的全样本核算；合成控制法（donor-weighted synthetic control）；自然实验分析（Proposition 19 前后对比）；反事实推断
AI.findings: 1）2007-2023年间美国家庭转让近2000万套，其中3/5在十年内未进入公开市场；2）Proposition 19 生效前家庭转让激增31%，生效后永久性下降33%（调整后26%）；3）加州每年约5.8万份 deed 从家庭渠道消失，但未转化为即时市场挂牌，而是延迟继承。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出家庭转让是住房市场的重要分配机制而非独立于市场之外；揭示财产税规则如何影响房屋从市场定价匹配转向血缘关系保留；拓展了税收楔子理论在住房非市场交易领域的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估财产税改革对住房市场流动性的影响提供实证依据；提示 Proposition 19 虽削减了家庭转让但并未立即增加市场供给，而是造成了代际传承的延迟；为理解住房可负担性问题提供新的制度视角。

title: Remittance Dependency and Agricultural Stagnation in Nepal: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of 75 Districts

detail.title: Remittance Dependency and Agricultural Stagnation in Nepal: A Cross-Sectional Analysis of 75 Districts
detail.abstract: Nepal receives remittances equivalent to over 25% of GDP, yet agricultural productivity has stagnated across much of the country. This study examines whether migration-intensive districts are associated with below-average agricultural yields, using district-level cross-sectional data linking CBS Nepal 2021 Census migration indicators with MoALD 2022/23 cereal yield data across all 75 districts. We construct two composite indicesthe Remittance Dependency Index (RDI) and Remittance Vulnerability Index (RVI)using Principal Component Analysis on CBS microdata. Cross-sectional OLS regression finds RDI positively associated (β=0.019, p=0.004) and RVI negatively associated (β=-0.025, p=0.010) with cereal yield, controlling for literacy (R²=0.204). Variance Inflation Factor analysis reveals severe multicollinearity for poverty rate (VIF=894), which is excluded from the preferred specification. Moran's I on OLS residuals is 0.511 (p=0.001), confirming significant spatial dependence. Spatial lag (ρ=0.823, p<0.001, AIC=123.2) and spatial error (λ=0.849, p<0.001, AIC=122.1) models, estimated on the complete 75-district sample, confirm that geographic proximity dominates yield outcomes. After spatial correction, RDI remains significant (SLM: p=0.010; SEM: p=0.010) while RVI attenuates to insignificance (SLM: p=0.177; SEM: p=0.904), indicating that the structural vulnerability signal is largely geographic in origin. A four-quadrant paradox taxonomy classifies 11 core Paradox Zone districts with robustness confirmed across threshold specifications and border district exclusion. All findings are associations; panel data with within-district variation over time would be required for causal identification.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用尼泊尔75个地区的截面数据，发现汇款依赖度与谷物产量正相关，而汇款脆弱性与产量负相关，但空间计量模型表明，空间邻近性主导了产量结果，脆弱性信号主要源于地理因素。研究还识别出11个核心"悖论区"地区。
AI.research_question: 尼泊尔汇款密集地区是否与低于平均水平的农业产量相关？汇款依赖与汇款脆弱性如何影响农业生产力？
AI.motivation: 尼泊尔接收的汇款超过GDP的25%，但农业生产力却在多数地区停滞不前。这一矛盾现象促使作者探究汇款与农业产出之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇款依赖指数（RDI）、汇款脆弱性指数（RVI）、空间依赖理论、悖论区分类框架。
AI.method: 基于尼泊尔75个地区的截面数据，使用主成分分析（PCA）构建RDI和RVI，采用OLS回归、空间滞后模型（SLM）和空间误差模型（SEM），以及方差膨胀因子（VIF）分析和Moran's I空间自相关检验。
AI.findings: OLS中RDI与谷物产量正相关，RVI负相关；但空间模型显示地理邻近性主导产量结果，且RVI在空间校正后不再显著。识别出11个核心"悖论区"地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了汇款依赖与汇款脆弱性两个概念，揭示了汇款对农业产出的非线性影响机制，并引入空间依赖理论解释地理因素的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼泊尔及其他汇款密集型发展中国家的农业政策制定提供参考，提示政策应关注汇款脆弱性而非仅汇款依赖，并需考虑空间溢出效应。

title: Fundamentals in Management Causal Discussions
affiliations: Australian National University (ANU) - Research School of Finance, Actuarial Studies and Applied Statistics

detail.title: Fundamentals in Management Causal Discussions
detail.abstract: We propose a novel framework of extracting fundamental characteristics from textual data based on causal sentence structures. Preserving the causal relationship by separately extracting topics from cause and effect parts of sentences result in improved information processing compared to simple topic analyses. Peer firms identified from this causality-based topic analysis show strong return comovement both at the monthly level and around earnings announcements. Returns of smaller firms, more central firms, firms with higher market beta and idiosyncratic volatility can be predicted by their peers' returns. Fundamental news seems to travel more from bigger firms to their smaller, less transparent peers with simpler operations, and from earlier announcers to their later announcing peers. Evidence supports the efficacy of considering causal sentence structures in extracting information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果句结构从文本数据中提取基本面特征的新框架，通过分别提取句子因果部分的话题来保留因果关系，相比简单话题分析能更好处理信息。基于此方法识别的同行公司在月度层面和财报公告前后均表现出强收益联动，且小公司、核心公司、高市场贝塔和高特质波动公司的收益可被同行收益预测。基本面信息似乎更多从大公司流向规模更小、透明度更低、运营更简单的同行，以及从提前公告者流向延迟公告者。研究证据支持了在信息提取中考虑因果句结构的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何利用文本数据中的因果句结构来识别同行公司，以及这种基于因果关系的同行识别能否解释股票收益的联动性和可预测性？
AI.motivation: 传统话题分析忽略文本中的因果关系，导致信息提取不完整，本文旨在利用因果句结构改进同行公司识别，并验证其在金融市场中的信息传递作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因果句结构提取、话题建模、同行公司识别、收益联动与信息传递理论
AI.method: 从文本中提取因果句结构，分别对原因部分和结果部分进行话题建模，基于话题相似度识别同行公司，并利用回归分析检验收益联动性和可预测性。
AI.findings: 基于因果句的同行识别比简单话题分析更强地解释收益联动；小公司、核心公司、高贝塔和高特质波动公司的收益可被同行预测；信息从大公司向小公司、从提前公告者向延迟公告者传递。
AI.theory_contributions: 将因果句结构引入文本信息提取和金融同行识别领域，丰富了信息传递和收益联动理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和监管机构提供了一种基于因果句结构识别同行公司、预测收益和监控信息流动的新工具。

title: Relative Income Misperceptions: Cross-Country Patterns in Europe
affiliations: European Union - JRC-Ispra, European Commision,  and Scuola Superiore Sant'Anna di Pisa

detail.title: Relative Income Misperceptions: Cross-Country Patterns in Europe
detail.abstract: We study voters' relative income misperceptions among over 19,000 respondents across all 27 countries of the European Union. To our knowledge, ours is the largest such study to date. We document that voter income misperceptions are widespread and share key characteristics across EU countries, with most respondents misperceiving their relative income by more than one decile. The pattern reflects a "middle class bias," with more (less) affluent respondents more often displaying a negative (positive) bias. Further, average misperceptions are negative in all EU countries. At the country level, average misperceptions decrease with GDP per capita. At the individual level, older, more educated and urban residents exhibit less bias. We further implement a randomized information treatment informing respondents of their household's actual relative income. While our results indicate that misperceptions exist and exhibit similar patterns and correlations across the EU, the treatment effects are more dispersed. In some countries, people who learn they are wealthier than previously thought decrease their demand for redistribution, while in others they do not change or want more redistribution.

AI.tldr: 基于欧盟27国19,000多名受访者的大规模调查，研究发现选民对自身相对收入的认知普遍存在偏差，呈现“中产阶级偏见”模式，且各国平均认知偏差均为负值。随机信息干预实验表明，纠正误解对再分配偏好的影响在国家间存在显著异质性。
AI.research_question: 选民对自身相对收入的认知偏差程度如何？这种偏差在不同国家间呈现怎样的模式和规律？纠正认知偏差如何影响选民对再分配政策的偏好？
AI.motivation: 收入感知偏差可能影响选民对再分配政策的态度，但此前研究样本规模有限且跨国比较不足。本研究通过大规模跨国调查，系统考察收入认知偏差的模式及其对政策偏好的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对收入认知理论、中产阶级偏见假说、再分配偏好理论
AI.method: 对欧盟27国19,000多名受访者进行大规模调查，测量相对收入认知偏差；实施随机信息干预实验，告知受访者家庭实际相对收入位置，检验认知纠正对再分配偏好的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 收入认知偏差在欧盟各国普遍存在，多数受访者偏差超过一个十分位；2. 呈现“中产阶级偏见”：高收入者倾向于低估收入（负偏），低收入者倾向于高估（正偏）；3. 所有欧盟国家平均认知偏差均为负值；4. 国家层面，人均GDP越高，平均偏差越小；5. 个体层面，年长、高学历、城市居民偏差较小；6. 信息干预效应存在显著的跨国异质性，部分国家中得知自己更富有的受访者减少再分配需求，部分国家则无变化或反而增加需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次基于覆盖全部欧盟27国的大规模调查，系统证实了收入认知偏差的普遍性和“中产阶级偏见”模式，揭示了偏差在不同制度环境下的共性和差异，为理解认知偏差的跨国结构性特征提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供启示：收入认知偏差的纠正并不必然导致再分配偏好趋于一致，政策沟通需考虑各国制度环境和公众认知特征的异质性；不同社会群体的认知偏差差异提示针对性的信息干预策略可能更有效。

reference: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, forthcoming
title: Inflation and Corporate Credit Risk: Global Evidence
affiliations: The University of Sydney - Discipline of Finance, University of Sydney Business School and

detail.title: Inflation and Corporate Credit Risk: Global Evidence

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis, forthcoming

detail.abstract: We provide novel international evidence that inflation is positively associated with corporate credit risk on average. A one-standard-deviation increase in inflation is associated with a 21 basis-point increase in next-year CDS spreads. Importantly, this relationship is convex: it is negative or weak at low inflation levels, but is much more positive in high-inflation environments. The positive relation between inflation and credit risk is stronger for firms with greater refinancing vulnerability and more rigid operating cash flows, and in countries with more inflation-responsive monetary regimes and weaker institutional environments. Our findings are consistent with opposing roles for debt rigidity and operating rigidity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用国际数据发现通胀与企业信用风险整体呈正相关，且这种关系是凸性的——低通胀时较弱或为负，高通胀时显著为正。通胀通过债务刚性（再融资脆弱性）和经营刚性（现金流刚性）两条渠道影响信用风险，且受货币政策和制度环境影响。
AI.research_question: 通货膨胀如何影响企业的信用风险？这种影响在不同通胀水平下是否呈现非线性特征？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对通胀与信用风险的关系缺乏一致结论，且多为单一国家研究。本文旨在利用跨国数据系统性地检验通胀对信用风险的影响及其非线性特征和传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 债务刚性效应（通胀通过影响再融资成本增加信用风险）与经营刚性效应（通胀对现金流的影响取决于企业经营成本刚性）的相互抵消或强化。
AI.method: 利用跨国面板数据，以CDS利差衡量企业信用风险，采用回归分析检验通胀与信用风险的关系及其非线性特征，并进行异质性分析。
AI.findings: 1）通胀与信用风险整体正相关；2）关系呈凸性，低通胀时负向或微弱，高通胀时显著为正；3）再融资脆弱性高、经营现金流刚性强、货币政策对通胀敏感以及制度环境较弱的国家中，正相关更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了通胀影响信用风险的非线性特征，整合了债务刚性与经营刚性两种理论机制，为理解通胀-信用风险关系提供了统一分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和企业管理者提供了通胀环境下信用风险评估的参考依据，尤其是在高通胀时期需关注再融资风险和现金流刚性。

title:
Why Automation Stalls:
A Dual-Layer Theory of AI Deployment Constraints
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
Why Automation Stalls:
A Dual-Layer Theory of AI Deployment Constraints

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares the following: - No financial relationships with AI companies, regulatory bodies, or organizations whose interests could be affected by this research - No consulting arrangements or advisory board positions that would create conflicts of interest - Research conducted independently without external funding pressures
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no specific grant from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding agency.

detail.abstract: Why does AI automation systematically fall short of its technically feasible potential? This paper develops a dual-layer theory of AI deployment constraints to explain the deployment gap — the persistent discrepancy between what is technically achievable and what is actually deployed at production scale. Drawing on Massenkoff and McCrory's (2026) finding that AI's observed task coverage remains a fraction of its theoretical feasibility, and McKinsey's (2025) documentation that only 6% of AI-adopting organizations qualify as high performers with meaningful EBIT impact, we argue that this gap reflects two structurally distinct layers of constraint. At the market layer, we formalize two legal-political distortions absent from standard factor-cost comparisons: the Zero Rights Defense Discount (ZRDD), which depresses effective labor cost below the nominal wage through rightsenforcement failures; and the Accountability Liability Premium (ALP), which inflates effective AI deployment cost above the nominal price through the near-total absence of AI legal personhood. Together, these produce a dual wedge rendering nominally viable substitution economically irrational under current institutional configurations. G At the organizational layer, we develop Deployment Boundary Theory (DBT), extending Cohen and Levinthal's (1990) absorptive capacity framework with three non-substitutable constraints — accountability (R), coordination (C), and dynamic maintenance (D). Critically, the R constraint is exogenously determined by legal institutions rather than internal organizational learning, and may rise rather than fall as deployment scales. We formally define the deployment gap  as the set of task–organization pairs that are nominally substitution-advantaged but institutionally blocked, and derive three testable predictions: the Legal Channel Hypothesis, the Competitive Externality Hypothesis, and the Non-Monotonic Labor Protection Hypothesis. Empirical identification strategies exploiting the phased implementation of the EU AI Act (2026–2028) are proposed for each.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了AI部署约束的双层理论，从市场层面（法律-政治扭曲导致的成本楔子）和组织层面（基于责任、协调和动态维护三大不可替代约束的部署边界理论）解释AI自动化为何在技术上可行却无法大规模部署。
AI.research_question: 为什么AI自动化系统性地未能达到其技术上可行的潜力？即AI部署差距——技术可行性与实际生产规模部署之间的持续差异——的根本原因是什么？
AI.motivation: Massenkoff & McCrory (2026)发现AI实际任务覆盖率仅为理论可行性的很小一部分；McKinsey (2025)指出仅6%的AI采用组织属于具有显著EBIT影响的高绩效者。现有标准要素成本比较无法解释这一差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: (1) 市场层：零权利防御折扣（ZRDD）和问责溢价（ALP）构成的双重楔子理论；(2) 组织层：部署边界理论（DBT），拓展了Cohen & Levinthal (1990)的吸收能力框架，引入责任（R）、协调（C）和动态维护（D）三个不可替代约束。
AI.method: 理论构建与形式化建模，提出三个可检验假设（法律渠道假说、竞争外部性假说、非单调劳动保护假说），并利用欧盟AI法案（2026-2028）分阶段实施作为实证识别策略。
AI.findings: 部署差距可定义为名义上具有替代优势但制度上受阻的任务-组织对的集合。关键发现：R约束由法律制度外生决定而非组织内部学习，且可能随部署规模扩大而上升而非下降。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 首次从双层约束视角系统解释AI部署差距；(2) 将法律制度因素纳入AI经济部署分析，提出ZRDD和ALP两个新概念；(3) 拓展吸收能力理论，提出责任约束外生性及非单调性的重要修正。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 解释了为何单纯的技术进步不足以推动AI大规模部署；(2) 揭示了法律制度改革（如AI法人地位）对缩小部署差距的关键作用；(3) 为政策制定者提供了欧盟AI法案效果评估的实证策略。

title: Export Taxes and Cross-Sector Spillovers

detail.title: Export Taxes and Cross-Sector Spillovers
detail.abstract:
This paper studies optimal export taxation in a multi-sector open economy when the government faces constraints on the set of feasible policy instruments. While existing models typically assume that export taxes can be imposed in all sectors, this paper considers a constrained environment in which the government can tax exports in only one sector.

In this setting, the optimal export tax generally deviates from the standard inverse foreign import demand elasticity benchmark. The reason is that export taxation in a single sector induces labor reallocation toward untaxed sectors, generating general-equilibrium spillovers in wages and export prices across sectors. As a result, the government faces a trade-off between the direct terms-of-trade gain from the higher export price in the taxed sector and indirect terms-of-trade effects due to export price changes in other sectors.

The paper characterizes the constrained-optimal export tax in closed form and shows that it depends not only on the foreign import demand elasticity, but also on the strength of cross-sector spillovers induced by labor mobility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了当政府只能对单一部门征收出口税时，最优出口税如何偏离传统的逆外国进口需求弹性基准，并受到跨部门劳动力流动带来的一般均衡溢出效应的影响。
AI.research_question: 在政策工具受限（仅能对一个部门征收出口税）的多部门开放经济中，最优出口税如何确定？
AI.motivation: 传统模型假设政府可以对所有部门征收出口税，但现实中政策工具常常受到限制。本文旨在填补这一理论与现实之间的差距。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多部门开放经济的一般均衡模型，引入劳动力跨部门流动和贸易条件效应，分析单一部门出口税下的最优税收决策。
AI.method: 构建理论模型，推导出封闭形式的最优出口税表达式，并通过比较静态分析揭示关键参数的影响。
AI.findings: （1）最优出口税偏离标准逆弹性公式；（2）税收导致劳动力向未征税部门重新配置，产生工资和出口价格的跨部门溢出；（3）最优税率取决于外国进口需求弹性和劳动力流动性强度之间的权衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政策工具约束引入最优出口税理论，揭示了跨部门一般均衡溢出效应的重要性，扩展了贸易政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者在有限政策工具下设计最优贸易政策提供了理论指导，尤其适用于发展中国家或制度约束较强的经济体。

title: U.S. Treasury Investors Are Long in AI
affiliations: London Business School, Stanford Graduate School of Business and Stanford Graduate School of Business

detail.title: U.S. Treasury Investors Are Long in AI
detail.abstract: The U.S. federal government's tax revenue is highly sensitive to long-run productivity growth but its mandatory spending commitments are not. As a result, U.S. Treasury investors have acquired a long position in AI. Using the CBO's 30-year budget projections, elasticities, and interest rate pass-through estimates, we find that 0.1 pps. of extra productivity growth raises the fundamental value of U.S. Treasurys by $1.19 trillion (3.7% of the market value), implying a 63 basis point decline in nominal Treasury yields. A larger 0.5 pps. acceleration raises the fundamental value by $5.7 trillion (17.8% of the market value).

AI.tldr: 美国国债投资者因联邦税收对生产率增长高度敏感而强制性支出不敏感，实际上持有了人工智能的“多头头寸”。研究发现，生产率增长每提高0.1个百分点，美国国债基本面价值增加1.19万亿美元（占市值的3.7%），名义收益率下降63个基点。
AI.research_question: 美国长期生产率增长如何影响美国国债的基本面价值和名义收益率？
AI.motivation: 美国联邦政府税收对长期生产率增长高度敏感，但强制性支出承诺不敏感，这意味着生产率变化会显著影响财政可持续性和国债价值。研究旨在量化这一影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于CBO 30年预算预测、弹性分析和利率传导估计，构建生产率增长→财政收入变化→国债基本面价值的传导机制。
AI.method: 使用美国国会预算办公室（CBO）的30年预算预测数据，结合弹性分析和利率传导估计进行数值模拟。
AI.findings: (1) 生产率增长每提高0.1个百分点，美国国债基本面价值增加1.19万亿美元（占市值的3.7%），名义收益率下降63个基点。(2) 生产率增长提高0.5个百分点，国债价值增加5.7万亿美元（占市值的17.8%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了生产率增长通过财政渠道影响无风险资产定价的机制，将技术变革（AI）与主权债券估值联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国债投资者提供了量化生产率冲击对投资组合价值影响的分析框架；为政策制定者理解AI驱动的生产率增长对财政可持续性的影响提供了参考。

title: Stereotypes in the Machine: Gender and Racial Bias in LLM-Generated Financial Advice
affiliations: , Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - School of Business, University of Macau and Lingnan University

detail.title: Stereotypes in the Machine: Gender and Racial Bias in LLM-Generated Financial Advice
detail.abstract: We conduct a large-scale controlled experiment of large language models (LLMs) acting as financial advisors. We find that LLMs systematically recommend lower equity allocations to female and Asian clients compared to otherwise identical White males. This bias persists and even intensifies for financially sophisticated clients, and the recommended portfolios are less efficientrejecting rational statistical discrimination in favor of stereotyping. While higher model intelligence mitigates these biases, model scale, standard safety alignment, and explicit debiasing prompts prove ineffective. Our results suggest that without advanced reasoning capabilities, AI advisors risk institutionalizing wealth disparities by projecting demographic stereotypes onto investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模受控实验发现，LLM作为金融顾问时，会系统性地向女性及亚裔客户推荐比白男更低的股权配置比例，且该偏差无法通过统计歧视解释，而是源于刻板印象；模型智能水平提升可缓解偏差，但模型规模、安全对齐和显式去偏提示均无效。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型作为金融顾问时，是否会基于客户的性别和种族产生系统性偏差？
AI.motivation: AI金融顾问的广泛应用可能加剧财富不平等，需检验LLM是否在投资建议中表现出人口统计学偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计歧视理论 vs. 刻板印象理论
AI.method: 大规模受控实验，设置不同性别（男/女）和种族（白/亚裔）的客户画像，对比LLM给出的股权配置建议。
AI.findings: 1. LLM系统性地向女性和亚裔推荐更低股权配置；2. 金融素养更高的客户偏差更大；3. 推荐组合效率更低，拒绝统计歧视解释，支持刻板印象假说；4. 模型智能（推理能力）可缓解偏差，但规模、安全对齐、去偏提示无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实验区分了统计歧视与刻板印象两种偏差机制，证实LLM的偏差更符合后者。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示AI金融顾问可能固化种族与性别财富差距，并指出当前安全对齐和去偏技术的局限性，强调提升推理能力的重要性。

title: The Market Disciplinary Effect of Asset Write-off: Theory and Empirical Evidence from Goodwill Impairment
affiliations: Harbin Institute of Technology (shenzhen), National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN) and

detail.title: The Market Disciplinary Effect of Asset Write-off: Theory and Empirical Evidence from Goodwill Impairment
detail.abstract: We study the effect of subsequent write-off tests on myopic managers' investment decisions. Write-off tests discipline overinvestment when the likelihood of adverse events is high, but can otherwise cause more severe underinvestment. Hence, tightening impairment stringency improves firm value when the likelihood of adverse events is high, but destroys firm value when that likelihood is low. With intermediate levels of likelihood, firm value is hump-shaped in impairment stringency. To test the theory, we exploit an increase in goodwill impairment stringency following goodwill-related restatements by peer firms audited by the same auditor office, and we adopt a stacked difference-indifferences design to control for any generic effects of peer restatements. Firms facing more stringent goodwill impairment reduce M&As relative to other types of investment, as well as in absolute amounts. The valuation of treated firms improves only during periods of high recession expectations or when facing high distress risk.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了后续减值测试对短视管理者投资决策的影响。当不利事件可能性高时，减值测试抑制过度投资；否则可能导致更严重的投资不足。因此，收紧减值标准在高可能性下提升公司价值，在低可能性下破坏价值。中等可能性时，公司价值与减值标准呈倒U型关系。实证利用同行公司商誉重述带来的减值标准收紧，采用堆叠双重差分法，发现面临更严格商誉减值的公司减少并购活动，且仅在衰退预期高或困境风险高时估值改善。
AI.research_question: 后续减值测试如何影响短视管理者的投资决策？
AI.motivation: 探究减值测试（如商誉减值）对管理者投资行为的双重影响——既能抑制过度投资，也可能加剧投资不足，以及这种影响如何随外部条件变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 短视管理者投资决策理论、减值测试的双刃剑效应（抑制过度投资 vs. 加剧投资不足）、公司价值与减值标准间的倒U型关系。
AI.method: 理论建模+实证检验。利用同行公司商誉重述带来的外生冲击（同一审计事务所审计的同行），采用堆叠双重差分法（stacked DiD）控制同行重述的通用效应。
AI.findings: 1) 减值测试在不利事件可能性高时抑制过度投资，否则加剧投资不足；2) 收紧减值标准在高可能性时提升公司价值，低可能性时破坏价值；3) 中等可能性时，公司价值与减值标准呈倒U型；4) 面临更严格商誉减值的公司减少并购（相对及绝对）；5) 估值改善仅发生在高衰退预期或高困境风险时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了减值测试对管理者投资决策的非线性影响，丰富了短视行为、减值会计准则经济后果的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构制定减值标准提供参考：需考虑经济环境（如衰退预期、困境风险），避免一刀切政策损害公司价值。

title: From Policy to Practice: African Practitioners' Perspectives on Benefit-Sharing Governance in the Age of DSI, AI, and the Bilateral-Multilateral Crossroads
affiliations: , Environment Protection Authority, Environment Protection Authority, Ministry of the Environment, Nature Protection and Sustainable Development and Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development

detail.title: From Policy to Practice: African Practitioners' Perspectives on Benefit-Sharing Governance in the Age of DSI, AI, and the Bilateral-Multilateral Crossroads

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest and Funding Statement Bupe R.
