The authors declare no financial or personal relationships beyond those stated here that could be perceived to influence the work reported in this paper.

keywords: Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS); Nagoya Protocol; Genetic Resources; Equitable Benefit-Sharing; Indigenous Peoples and Local Communities (IPLCs); Traditional Knowledge; Science Equity; Biodiversity Governance; Digital Sequence Information (DSI); Bioprospecting

detail.abstract: Global governance of digital sequence information (DSI) has concentrated almost exclusively on publicly accessible repositories, leaving a commercially significant share of genetic data generated within private, proprietary biodiscovery platforms largely outside multilateral benefit-sharing frameworks. Drawing on over two decades of practitioner experience in Nagoya Protocol implementation, the DSI Multilateral Mechanism, and bilateral Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS) negotiations across Africa, this commentary argues that bilateral ABS agreements remain one of the key mechanisms providing the legal specificity and enforceability needed to govern biodiversity genetic resources (GR) and DSI, and to maintain a direct economic relationship between resource users and providers. Using case evidence from Basecamp Research's operational ABS partnerships across more than 30 countries, together with national implementation experience in Malawi and Cameroon, we show that bilateral frameworks generate accountability and sustained investment that multilateral, voluntary mechanisms structurally lack. We address the principal counterargument to this position that benefit-sharing obligations impede emergency research and show that post-pandemic reforms reinforce rather than undermine the case for benefit-sharing. We further examine the governance challenge posed by AI-driven biodiscovery, where provenance-linked training data offers a model for extending ABS compliance into algorithmic and AI-derived value chains. We conclude that bilateral and multilateral mechanisms are complementary rather than competing architectures, and that operationalising Article 10 of the Nagoya Protocol, alongside mandatory DSI provenance tracking, offers a practical path to closing the governance gap under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. We position Africa not as a passive subject of DSI governance debates but as an active architect of the equitable frameworks needed for a sustainable global bioeconomy. Executive Summary Bilateral Access and Benefit-Sharing (ABS) agreements under the Nagoya Protocol remain a vital mechanism for the fair and equitable use of genetic resources and associated digital sequence information (DSI), particularly in commercial research contexts and for privately held DSI databases. While multilateral mechanisms are being proposed to manage publicly accessible DSI, they remove the direct economic relationship between User and Provider and therefore cannot fully substitute for the flexibility and contextual specificity offered by well-designed bilateral arrangements. Implementing equitable ABS requires building sovereign capability, not merely enacting legal frameworks (Dutfield, 2011); capacity-building through technology transfer, intellectual property, and academic collaboration is the foundational engine of a sustainable bioeconomy, not a charitable add-on (Nnadozie et al., 2017). Drawing on over two decades of practitioner experience including the facilitation of bilateral arrangements and service within the Nagoya Protocol and the Global Biodiversity Framework, this paper presents evidence from Basecamp Research's private, public, and community commercial research collaborations across Africa and beyond. Real-world examples from East, Central, and Southern Africa demonstrate that tailored bilateral agreements provide the most robust protection for local communities, protected areas, and academic institutions, ensuring that benefit-sharing obligations remain legally enforceable throughout the commercial research value chain. Africa is not merely a provider of genetic resources; it is an active architect of equitable biodiversity governance, developing practical ABS solutions that the global policy community urgently needs to learn from.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，双边ABS协议是遗传资源和数字序列信息商业治理的关键机制，能提供多边机制缺乏的法律确定性和可执行性，并以非洲为案例展示其在实际运营中的有效性。
AI.research_question: 在公私并存的数字序列信息治理格局下，双边与多边惠益分享机制如何互补共存，并有效治理商业研究与AI驱动的生物发现中的遗传资源与DSI使用？
AI.motivation: 当前全球DSI治理几乎只关注公共存储库，大量商业性遗传数据游离于多边惠益分享框架之外，形成了治理空白；且政策辩论中忽视了非洲作为制度设计者的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 名古屋议定书框架下的双边ABS机制、多边DSI机制、AI驱动生物发现的治理链条、国家主权能力建设理论。
AI.method: 基于20余年名古屋议定书执行实践经验，结合Basecamp Research在30多个国家的双边ABS合作案例，以及马拉维和喀麦隆的国家执行经验进行案例分析与论证。
AI.findings: 双边ABS协议在法律确定性和可执行性上优于多边自愿机制；后疫情改革强化而非削弱惠益分享义务；AI驱动的生物发现可通过溯源训练数据延伸ABS合规；非洲是公平治理框架的积极构建者。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出双边与多边机制是互补而非竞争架构；论证名古屋议定书第10条与强制性DSI溯源的双轨路径是弥合治理差距的可行方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了可在商业研究价值链中保持法律可执行性的具体ABS实践模式；强调非洲经验对全球生物多样性治理的借鉴意义。

title: Longer stays, not more calls: rainfall-linked at-berth CO₂ at a Brazilian port
affiliations: Federal University of Maranhão, Federal University of Maranhão, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Longer stays, not more calls: rainfall-linked at-berth CO₂ at a Brazilian port
detail.abstract: This study estimates auxiliary-engine CO₂ emissions during hotelling at Porto do Itaqui, Brazil, using 6,029 vessel calls from 2020 to 2025, and evaluates Onshore Power Supply (OPS). A simplified activity-based inventory was combined with logarithmic mean Divisia index decomposition and precipitation regressions. Emissions increased from 13.4 kt to 17.6 kt (+31.4%; +11.3% from the post-pandemic 2021 baseline). Longer berth times explained 44.6% of the increase, vessel power 25.1%, and additional calls 20.0%. Liquid bulk accounted for 68.6% of emissions, and Berths 104, 106, and 108 concentrated approximately 63%. A 5 mm/day rainfall increase was associated with 3.4–5.2% longer dry-bulk stays; the evidence is associative, and OPS could avoid an estimated 134–199 t CO₂ per year linked to these delays. Under full uptake, OPS could reduce auxiliary-engine CO₂ by 84.2% (73.9–91.3% across grid factors), a technical ceiling that excludes auxiliary boilers and supports phased berth electrification.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2020-2025年巴西伊塔基港6,029次船舶停靠数据，估算辅助引擎在港口停泊期间的CO₂排放并评估岸电供应（OPS）的减排潜力。排放量从13.4 kt增至17.6 kt（+31.4%），其中停泊时间延长贡献44.6%，船舶功率贡献25.1%。OPS全面使用可减少84.2%的辅助引擎CO₂排放。
AI.research_question: 巴西伊塔基港船舶停泊期间辅助引擎CO₂排放量如何变化？岸电供应（OPS）的减排潜力有多大？
AI.motivation: 港口船舶停泊期间的排放是航运业碳减排的重要环节，但缺乏针对发展中国家港口的长时序实证研究和OPS减排效果量化评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于活动的排放清单法、对数平均迪氏指数分解法（LMDI）、降水回归分析
AI.method: 采用简化的活动基础排放清单，结合对数平均迪氏指数分解（归因分析）和降水回归模型，分析2020-2025年6,029次船舶停靠数据。
AI.findings: 1) 排放量从13.4 kt增至17.6 kt（+31.4%）；2) 停泊时间延长（44.6%）、船舶功率（25.1%）、停靠次数（20.0%）是主要驱动因素；3) 液体散货占68.6%，三个主要泊位集中约63%排放；4) 日降水增加5 mm与干散货停留时间延长3.4-5.2%相关；5) 全面OPS可减少84.2%辅助引擎CO₂排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 将LMDI分解方法应用于港口停泊排放的驱动因素分析，揭示了停泊时间而非停靠次数是排放增长的主因；建立了降水与停泊时间的关联机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为伊塔基港及类似发展中国家的港口提供了分泊位、分货种的排放清单和OPS减排量化评估，支持分阶段泊位电气化决策；量化了天气因素对排放的影响。

title: Healthcare's AI Trap

detail.title: Healthcare's AI Trap

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is affiliated with Mochi Health, a telehealth company, and holds no equity in it. This paper is a conceptual and theoretical contribution that uses no company data and does not concern any company product. The author is aware of no conflict of interest bearing on the argument.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical paper involving no human subjects, patient data, or clinical intervention.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external, grant, or institutional funding.

detail.abstract: In clinical care the routine cases do double duty: under a flat fee they are the profitable cases that cross-subsidize complex care, and they are the cases on which junior clinicians become senior ones. AI automates them first, severing both supports at once. On the financing side, an AI-native entrant that serves only the routine "cream" raises the average cost of the patients left behind above the flat fee and the pool unravels (Einav and Finkelstein, 2011; Faulhaber, 1975), before AI can treat the complex patients it abandons. We solve the skimming game from primitives: the over-skimming wedge carries a business-stealing term that mere fewness cannot remove, so efficiency is restored by vertical integration of the cream with the tail, with risk adjustment (Glazer and McGuire, 2000) as the price-side cure. On the workforce side, automating the routine cases starves the pipeline that produces specialists; because expertise takes a decade to build and the option of keeping it alive is never priced, the loss can be irreversible (Arrow and Fisher, 1974), and supervision and training compete for the same seniors, giving a tipping point between a healthy steady state and a low-capacity trap. The two externalities share the same cases but are not the same problem: integrating the cream with the tail removes the financing externality and trains enough seniors to replace a provider's own retirements, yet no market structure prices the option value of training above replacement, which spills across firms, so transfers and administered prices alone do not address both margins and a separate training instrument is needed. What is specific to medicine is that the cases AI takes first are at once the money that funds hard care and the making of the people who provide it.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了AI在临床护理中优先自动化常规病例，同时切断了两个关键支撑：常规病例在按固定收费模式下是盈利的，用于交叉补贴复杂护理；同时是初级医生成长为高级医生的训练平台。论文从博弈论出发，分析了"撇奶油"（只服务盈利常规病例）导致的风险池瓦解、以及训练管道枯竭带来的不可逆损失，并提出纵向整合与风险调整作为融资侧解决方案，同时指出需要独立于转移支付的训练工具来应对人力资本外部性。
AI.research_question: AI自动化常规临床病例如何同时破坏医疗服务的融资交叉补贴机制和临床人才培养管道？是否存在同时解决两个外部性的市场或政策方案？
AI.motivation: AI在医疗中的优先应用领域是常规病例，但这些病例同时承担着两个关键功能：盈利以补贴复杂病例、以及培养初级医生。现有文献分别讨论风险选择（Einav & Finkelstein, 2011）和不可逆损失（Arrow & Fisher, 1974），但未将两者联系起来。本文揭示AI同时切断这两个支撑的独特机制，填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险选择与市场瓦解（Einav & Finkelstein, 2011; Faulhaber, 1975）；"撇奶油"博弈论模型；纵向整合理论；风险调整机制（Glazer & McGuire, 2000）；不可逆性与准期权价值理论（Arrow & Fisher, 1974）；人力资本外部性理论
AI.method: 理论模型：从基本要素出发构建"撇奶油"博弈模型，推导过度撇奶油（over-skimming wedge）包含商业窃取（business-stealing）项，分析纵向整合与风险调整的效率恢复条件；同时建立人力资本积累的稳态与临界点模型，分析训练管道的外部性。
AI.findings: 1. 过度的"撇奶油"楔子包含商业窃取项，仅靠市场少数参与者无法消除，纵向整合（将盈利常规病例与非盈利复杂病例整合）和风险调整（价格端矫正）可恢复效率。2. 常规病例自动化导致训练管道枯竭，专业人才培养需十年周期，且维持训练能力的期权价值从未被定价，损失可能不可逆。3. 监督与培训争夺同一批资深医生资源，存在健康稳态与低能力陷阱之间的临界点。4. 两个外部性共享同一组病例，但并非同一问题：纵向整合可解决融资外部性并培养足够替代退休的医生，但没有任何市场结构能为超出替代水平的培训期权价值定价，该价值跨企业溢出，因此转移支付和管理价格无法同时解决两个问题，需要独立的培训工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次将AI自动化的"撇奶油"效应与临床人才培养管道的外部性纳入统一分析框架。2. 揭示了过度的撇奶油中存在商业窃取项，扩展了经典风险选择理论。3. 区分了融资外部性和培训外部性两个维度，证明了它们虽然共享同一组病例但机制不同，需要不同的政策工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 指出单纯的市场纵向整合或风险调整无法同时解决AI导致的两个外部性问题。2. 提出需要独立的培训工具（如培训补贴、教学医院专项支持等）来维持临床人才培养。3. 为医疗AI监管政策提供了理论依据：必须同时考虑融资可持续性和人力资本可持续性。

title: Executivism and the Parallel State

detail.title: Executivism and the Parallel State
detail.abstract: Rebuilding democratic accountability after Trump requires more than reversing executive orders or rehiring dismissed officials. The second Trump administration exploited two long-running developments: the concentration of policy authority in the presidency and the migration of public functions to the intermediary class. I call the first executivism and the second the parallel state. Together they supply concentrated command and a privately operated implementation network that a personalist president can reward, redirect, or exclude. By sorting contracts, grants, data access, and public interfaces toward compliant actors, the presidency can embed a coalition in relationships costly for successors to unwind. Digital systems deepen this dependence when government cannot move, understand, or reproduce systems it formally owns. I assess such dependence through recoverability and legibility. I conclude with reforms to the civil service, procurement, Congress, judicial doctrine, and public technical capacity, sequenced to preserve service delivery while rebuilding public capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了特朗普第二任期通过“行政主义”（权力集中于总统）和“平行国家”（公共职能向中间阶层转移）两种机制，深度嵌入对后续政府难以逆转的政治联盟，并提出通过文官制度、采购、国会、司法和公共技术能力等系列改革来重建民主问责制。
AI.research_question: 如何在后特朗普时代重建民主问责制？特朗普第二任期如何通过行政权力集中和公共职能外包来固化政治联盟，从而对后续政府形成制度性制约？
AI.motivation: 特朗普第二任期对民主问责制的损害远超出简单的行政命令撤销或官员重新任命所能修复，现有研究未能充分揭示其通过行政权力集中和公共职能中间化来嵌入政治联盟的深层机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行政主义（Executivism）：政策权威向总统职位集中的长期趋势；平行国家（Parallel State）：公共职能向中间阶层（intermediary class）转移的现象；可恢复性（Recoverability）与可读性（Legibility）作为评估数字化依赖程度的概念工具。
AI.method: 概念分析与理论构建：通过提出“行政主义”和“平行国家”两个核心概念，分析特朗普第二任期如何利用这两种趋势来固化政治联盟，并运用“可恢复性”和“可读性”维度评估数字系统造成的依赖程度，最后提出系统性改革方案。
AI.findings: 特朗普第二任期通过行政主义获得集中指挥权，通过平行国家构建私营化执行网络；总统通过筛选合同、拨款、数据访问和公共接口使其偏向顺从的行为者，从而嵌入一个对后继者而言代价高昂的政治联盟；数字系统加剧了这种依赖——政府无法迁移、理解或复制其正式拥有的系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“行政主义”和“平行国家”两个原创性概念，揭示了当代民主政治中行政权力集中与公共职能外包之间的协同效应；引入“可恢复性”和“可读性”作为评估数字治理依赖的新分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一套涵盖文官制度、政府采购、国会监督、司法学说和公共技术能力等领域的系统性改革方案，并按照保障服务交付与重建公共能力的先后顺序进行排序，具有直接的政策操作性。

title: Housing Regulation and Neighborhood Sorting across the United States

detail.title: Housing Regulation and Neighborhood Sorting across the United States
detail.abstract: In this paper, I consider the effect of minimum lot size regulation on welfare and urban structure. I construct a general equilibrium model in which households of heterogeneous incomes choose cities and neighborhoods, value affluent neighbors, and are burdened differently by regulation. The model explains two salient facts about residential income sorting: household incomes decline with residential density within cities, and this gradient is steeper in more productive cities. I provide causal evidence in support. A counterfactual deregulation exercise shows significant and progressive welfare gains for households (exceeding $2000 per household per year) that offset the losses to landowners. The exercise also reveals two surprising results. First, any productivity gains that occur from the expansion of productive cities are largely nullified by the out-migration of affluent households who prefer regulated neighborhoods. Second, deregulation does not exacerbate the neighborhood choice externality arising from the demand for affluent neighbors. These results suggest that the most important consequence of deregulating housing markets is an increase in housing affordability. Other counterfactual exercises underscore the lack of incentives for cities to unilaterally deregulate and show a significant opportunity for improved spatial targeting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建一般均衡模型，研究最低地块面积管制对福利和城市结构的影响，发现放松管制能带来显著且累进的福利改善（每户每年超2000美元），且不会加剧邻里选择外部性，但城市单边放松管制的激励不足。
AI.research_question: 最低地块面积管制如何影响福利和城市结构？
AI.motivation: 解释两个突出事实：家庭收入随城市内居住密度下降而递减，且这种梯度在生产率更高的城市更陡峭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡模型，其中异质性收入家庭选择城市和 neighborhoods，偏好富裕邻居，且受管制影响不同。
AI.method: 构建一般均衡模型 + 因果识别证据 + 反事实放松管制模拟
AI.findings: 1. 放松管制带来显著且累进的福利改善（每户每年超2000美元），抵消土地所有者损失；2. 生产率城市的扩张收益被外迁的富裕家庭抵消；3. 放松管制不会加剧邻里选择外部性；4. 城市缺乏单边放松管制的激励；5. 空间定位存在显著的改进机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 将收入异质性、邻里偏好与管制负担引入空间一般均衡框架，揭示放松管制对福利分配和城市结构的影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 放松住房市场管制最重要的结果是提高住房可负担性；城市单边放松管制激励不足，存在空间政策改进机会。

title: The Fiscal Cost of Heat Exposure: Evidence from Medicaid Spending
affiliations: University of Central Oklahoma - Department of Economics and

detail.title: The Fiscal Cost of Heat Exposure: Evidence from Medicaid Spending
detail.abstract: This paper examines the effects of short-run heat exposure on Medicaid spending. We link monthly Medicaid payments, patients, and claim lines across U.S. ZIP Codes from 2018 through 2024 to daily maximum temperatures. Identification comes from within-ZIP Code variation across months of the same season and year in the number of hot days, relative to each ZIP Code's usual calendarmonth pattern. Population-weighted fixed-effects estimates show that an additional day above 80°F increases monthly Medicaid payments by 0.25 percent, with effects reaching about 1.9 percent for days above 100°F. The increase operates primarily at the extensive margin through more patients and claims. Effects are 30 to 60 percent larger in poorer ZIP Codes and in areas with larger Black, young-child, and older-adult populations. Illustrative projections based on scenarios of continued global warming imply $2.1 billion to $2.7 billion in additional annual Medicaid spending by mid-century.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了短期高温暴露对Medicaid（美国医疗补助计划）支出的影响，发现每增加一天超过80°F的天气，月度Medicaid支付增加0.25%，超过100°F时增加约1.9%，且贫困地区和特定人群受影响更大，预计到本世纪中叶全球变暖将导致每年增加21-27亿美元支出。
AI.research_question: 短期高温暴露如何影响美国Medicaid医疗支出？
AI.motivation: 气候变化导致极端高温事件频发，但短期高温暴露对公共医疗支出（尤其是针对低收入群体的Medicaid）的影响尚缺乏系统性的定量证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用美国2018-2024年ZIP编码层面的月度Medicaid支付数据与每日最高气温数据，通过固定效应模型识别短期高温冲击对医疗支出的因果效应。
AI.method: 采用ZIP编码内部的月度固定效应模型，控制同一季节和年份的月内变化，利用各ZIP编码相对于其历史月度模式的热天数变异进行识别，并进行了人口加权估计。
AI.findings: 1) 每增加一天超过80°F的天气，月度Medicaid支付增加0.25%；超过100°F时增加约1.9%。2) 效应主要通过广延边际（更多患者和索赔）体现。3) 贫困ZIP编码区域及黑人、幼儿、老年人口比例较高的地区，效应高出30-60%。4) 预测到本世纪中叶，全球变暖将导致年度Medicaid支出增加21-27亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用高分辨率（ZIP编码-月）面板数据系统量化短期高温对公共医疗支出的因果效应，揭示了热暴露的健康经济成本在弱势群体中的异质性分布。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候政策制定者提供了高温健康成本的直接货币化估计，有助于评估气候变化的经济影响，并为Medicaid预算规划和热浪应对资源配置提供依据。

title: When Rights Become Access: Abortion Reform and Missing Girls in Nepal
affiliations: Binghamton University and Binghamton University

detail.title: When Rights Become Access: Abortion Reform and Missing Girls in Nepal
detail.abstract: Reforms that expand reproductive rights change behavior only when they change effective access. We study Nepal, which legalized abortion in 2002 to reduce unsafe procedures, and ask when and where legal access affected the sex composition of births in a society with son preference. We combine quasirandom variation in firstborn sex with the staged rollout of abortion services and predetermined connectivity to city services in a triple-difference design. The rollout separates two margins. During the initial first-trimester rollout, later-birth hazards declined where services were reachable, but the male- and female-birth responses were not statistically distinguishable, and the sex composition of births did not change. Once access expanded to include second-trimester services, medication abortion, and midlevel providers, the annual probability of a female birth fell while male births did not decline. Nationally, the probability of a female birth fell by 0.49 percentage points, and the female share of later births in firstborn-girl families fell by 2.83 percentage points. The responses were concentrated within two hours of a city. Within this radius, the female birth probability and the female share declined by 1.30 and 6.52 percentage points, respectively. Back-of-the-envelope calculation maps the national composition estimate to an annual flow equivalent of about 11,900 missing girls at birth, or 1.91 percent of all births.

AI.tldr: 尼泊尔2002年堕胎合法化后，只有当服务可及性真正改善时，才会改变生育行为。研究发现，在产前性别鉴定技术可及且二胎及以上堕胎服务扩展后，女性出生概率显著下降，特别是在距城市两小时车程范围内，每年约有11,900名"失踪女婴"。
AI.research_question: 堕胎合法化改革在什么条件下会改变生育行为的性别构成？
AI.motivation: 探讨在性别偏好社会中，法律改革如何通过改变实际服务可及性而非仅仅法律条文来影响生育结果，填补"法律权利"与"有效可及"之间差距的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三重差分识别策略，利用头胎性别的准随机变异、堕胎服务分阶段推广以及到城市服务的可及性差异。
AI.method: 三重差分设计（triple-difference），结合头胎性别准随机变异、堕胎服务分阶段推广（首期 vs 扩展期）和到城市服务的既定连通性。
AI.findings: （1）首期（仅前三个月）推广时，服务可及地区后续生育率下降，但男女婴差异不显著；（2）扩展到中期堕胎、药物流产和中级服务提供者后，女婴出生概率下降而男婴未减少；（3）全国范围女婴出生概率下降0.49个百分点，头胎为女的家庭后续生育中女婴比例下降2.83个百分点；（4）效应集中在距城市2小时范围内，该范围内女婴概率下降1.30个百分点，女婴比例下降6.52个百分点；（5）相当于每年约11,900名女婴"缺失"（占出生总数的1.91%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了法律改革影响行为的关键条件——实际服务可及性（而非法律条文本身），并区分了堕胎合法化的两种边际效应：仅减少生育 vs. 结合性别选择减少女婴。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家生殖权利改革的政策设计提供实证依据，提示政策制定者需关注服务可及性的时间和空间维度，以及产前性别鉴定技术对性别平等的潜在负面影响。

title: Factors Influencing the Utilization of Malaria Prevention and Case Management Services among Vulnerable Populations in Four Health Districts of Cameroon (Mokolo, Maroua 3, Doumé and Mifi): A Mixed-Methods Study
affiliations: Impact Santé Afrique (ISA),, Impact Santé Afrique (ISA),, Government of Cameroon - Ministry of Public Health Cameroon and

detail.title: Factors Influencing the Utilization of Malaria Prevention and Case Management Services among Vulnerable Populations in Four Health Districts of Cameroon (Mokolo, Maroua 3, Doumé and Mifi): A Mixed-Methods Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare no financial or personal relationships with other people or organizations that could inappropriately influence this work. There are no conflicts of interest to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was obtained from the National Ethics Committee for Human Health Research of Cameroon (CNERSH), reference N° 2024/03/1653/CE/CNERSH/SP. All participants provided written or documented oral informed consent prior to enrolment. Participation was voluntary, and participants were informed of their right to withdraw at any time without consequence.
declarations.funderStatement: Expertise France, within the "Equité Accès Palu" project.

detail.abstract:
Background: Malaria remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in Cameroon, with a disproportionate burden on vulnerable populations. Despite the implementation of free interventions — long-lasting insecticidal nets (LLINs) and intermittent preventive treatment in pregnancy (IPTp) — service utilization remains insufficient in certain contexts.

Methods: A convergent mixed-methods study was conducted from January to June 2024 in four health districts (Mokolo, Maroua 3, Doumé, Mifi) across three regions of Cameroon. The quantitative component included 633 vulnerable individuals (pregnant/breastfeeding women, caregivers of children under five, internally displaced persons, refugees, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities) selected through stratified sampling. Data were collected using the Malaria Behaviour Survey and analyzed by multivariable logistic regression. The qualitative component combined 12 focus group discussions and 16 in-depth interviews, analyzed using thematic analysis (Braun & Clarke).

Findings: Four independent determinants were identified in multivariable analysis. Health district was the strongest predictor of IPTp knowledge: residents of Mokolo were 20 times less likely to have adequate knowledge than those in Mifi (aOR = 0·05; 95% CI: 0·008–0·30). The 35–44 age group was associated with: a more favourable attitude towards IPTp (aOR = 5·79; 95% CI: 1·30–25·74), while widowhood was unfavorably associated (aOR = 0·037; 95% CI: 0·003–0·51). Women paradoxically showed less adherence to gender-equitable values than men (aOR = 0·07; 95% CI: 0·009–0·56). Secondary education or above was associated with a less favourable attitude towards LLINs (aOR = 0·11; 95% CI: 0·02–0·68). Qualitative data revealed a three-step care-seeking pathway (self-medication, traditional medicine, delayed formal care) and four categories of barriers: financial, geographical, sociocultural, and service quality-related.

Interpretation: Utilization of malaria services is driven more by contextual and relational factors than by individual characteristics. Interventions should be territorialized, target specific social vulnerabilities (widowhood, gender) and incorporate gender-transformative approaches to improve equitable access to care.

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合方法研究喀麦隆四个卫生区的疟疾服务利用情况，发现卫生区、年龄、婚姻状况、性别和教育水平是独立影响因素，建议采取地区化、针对特定社会脆弱群体和性别变革的干预措施。
AI.research_question: 喀麦隆弱势群体（孕妇/哺乳期妇女、五岁以下儿童照护者、境内流离失所者、难民、土著人群、残疾人）使用免费疟疾干预措施（长效杀虫蚊帐和妊娠期间歇性预防治疗）的影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 疟疾在喀麦隆仍是发病和死亡的主要原因，尽管实施了免费干预措施，但在某些情境下服务利用率仍然不足，需要探究背后的决定因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确提及特定理论框架，但研究隐含了健康行为的社会决定因素理论和求医行为理论（定性部分揭示了三步求医路径）。
AI.method: 2024年1-6月在三个地区四个卫生区（Mokolo、Maroua 3、Doumé、Mifi）开展收敛式混合方法研究。定量部分：633名弱势个体分层抽样，采用疟疾行为调查问卷，多变量逻辑回归分析。定性部分：12场焦点小组讨论+16次深度访谈，Braun & Clarke主题分析法。
AI.findings: 四个独立决定因素：卫生区（最强预测因子，Mokolo居民对IPTp知识充分的可能性比Mifi低20倍）；年龄（35-44岁对IPTp态度更积极）；婚姻状况（寡妇更消极）；性别（女性对性别平等价值观的认同度低于男性）；教育水平（中学以上对LLINs态度更消极）。定性发现：三步求医路径（自我药疗→传统医学→延迟正规医疗）和四类障碍（财务、地理、社会文化、服务质量）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了疟疾服务利用主要受情境和关系因素驱动，而非个体特征，丰富了健康服务利用的社会决定因素理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议干预措施应地区化（针对不同卫生区特点）、针对特定社会脆弱群体（寡妇、性别不平等）并纳入性别变革方法，以改善公平获得医疗服务的机会。

title: Commodity Price Uncertainty and Macroeconomic Dynamics
affiliations: Institute for Advanced Studies, Institute for Advanced Studies (IHS) and Institute for Advanced Studies (IHS)

detail.title: Commodity Price Uncertainty and Macroeconomic Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper constructs and analyzes a new measure of industrial metal price uncertainty, the metal uncertainty index (MUI), following and extending the methodology of Jurado et al. (2015), which defines uncertainty as the unpredictable component of future outcomes. The index is constructed from spot and futures prices of five industrial metals-copper, aluminium, nickel, zinc, and lead-together with a broad set of macroeconomic, financial, and commodity-market variables that characterize developments in the global metal sector. We conduct a range of empirical analyses for industrial production, equity markets, metal prices, and the real effective exchange rate of the US dollar, including impulse response functions and forecasting exercises for the global economy, the United States, and the euro area. To account for potential nonlinearities, we employ a threshold vector autoregressive (TVAR) model that distinguishes between low-and high-metal-uncertainty regimes. In addition, we incorporate alternative uncertainty measures, including financial uncertainty and  geopolitical risk, to complement the role of metal-specific uncertainty. The impulse response analysis reveals that the effects of metal uncertainty shocks are strongly regime dependent. Specifically, the magnitude, persistence, and, in the case of stock markets, even the direction of responses differ across low- and high-metal-uncertainty regimes, with the effects generally being more pronounced during periods of elevated metal uncertainty. The only notable exception is the real effective exchange rate of the US dollar, whose response is stronger in the low-uncertainty regime. More broadly, the responses to shocks in MUI differ from those associated with financial uncertainty suggesting that the two indices capture distinct underlying sources of uncertainty. We further evaluate the forecasting performance of models incorporating the MUI alongside other uncertainty measures under both linear and nonlinear specifications. The results show that models including the MUI frequently outperform competing alternatives, particularly for the global economy, across a range of forecast horizons and evaluation criteria. Moreover, TVAR models often rank among the best-performing specifications, underscoring the importance of accounting for regime-dependent dynamics in forecasting macro-financial variables. Overall, the findings indicate that metal uncertainty contains valuable information, enhancing both our understanding of macro-financial transmission mechanisms and the accuracy of forecasts, particularly when nonlinearities are explicitly incorporated.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了工业金属价格不确定性指数（MUI），发现金属不确定性冲击的影响具有显著的体制依赖性，在高不确定性时期影响更为显著，且MUI对全球经济预测有重要增量信息。
AI.research_question: 工业金属价格不确定性如何影响宏观经济、金融市场及汇率？其影响是否具有非线性特征？
AI.motivation: 工业金属是全球经济的重要投入品，其价格波动带来的不确定性对宏观经济和金融市场的影响缺乏系统性量化研究，现有不确定性指标（如金融不确定性、地缘政治风险）未专门聚焦金属领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不确定性定义（Jurado et al., 2015：不确定性是未来结果中不可预测的部分）；阈值向量自回归（TVAR）模型（刻画低/高不确定性体制下的非线性响应）。
AI.method: 借鉴Jurado et al. (2015)的方法，利用五种工业金属的现货和期货价格，结合宏观经济、金融和大宗商品市场变量构建MUI；使用脉冲响应分析和预测绩效评估；采用TVAR模型刻画体制依赖的非线性效应。
AI.findings: （1）金属不确定性冲击的影响具有显著的体制依赖性，高不确定性时期影响更大、更持久，股市方向甚至相反；（2）美元实际有效汇率的响应在低不确定性体制下更强；（3）MUI与金融不确定性捕捉的是不同的不确定性来源；（4）纳入MUI的模型（尤其是TVAR设定）在预测全球经济方面优于竞争模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统构建专门的工业金属不确定性指数，揭示了金属不确定性冲击的非线性体制依赖特征，区分了金属不确定性与金融不确定性的不同经济影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了监测工业金属不确定性的量化工具，有助于在高低不确定性环境下制定差异化决策；MUI可提高全球经济与金融变量的预测准确性。

title: Gangnam Style Investment: Smart Finance of Rich-Neighborhood Investors
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, College of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) and College of Business, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST)

detail.title: Gangnam Style Investment: Smart Finance of Rich-Neighborhood Investors
detail.abstract: Using a unique dataset of trading accounts from a major securities company in South Korea, this paper shows individual investors from Gangnam District, the most affluent neighborhood in Seoul, effectively respond to the market shock and outperform their peers. Individual investors in Gangnam intensively buy stocks when prices plunge and strategically realize profits as markets rebound demonstrating superior market timing ability. Moreover, they tend to retain stocks bought at market lows while selling holdings of pre-shock purchases, leading to a portfolio restructuring during the recovery phase. We also find that Gangnam investors exhibit high similarity in investment capital flows and portfolio composition, implying the existence of a well-developed local information-sharing network within the community. The results remain consistent after controlling for individual investor characteristics including asset size and investment experience. Our findings suggest that investors in rich neighborhoods exhibit distinct investment behavior driven by advantages in information access and sharing.

AI.tldr: 利用韩国江南区（首尔最富裕社区）个体投资者的独特交易数据，研究发现该区域投资者展现出卓越的市场择时能力：暴跌时买入、反弹时获利，并存在本地信息共享网络。其投资行为优势源于信息获取与分享渠道的差异。
AI.research_question: 富裕社区（江南区）的个体投资者是否比非富裕社区的投资者表现出更优的投资行为？这种优势的来源是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献多关注机构投资者或普通个体投资者的行为偏差，但对富裕社区个体投资者的异质性行为研究不足。本文利用韩国独特的地理分区数据，探究社会经济地位（社区富裕程度）如何影响个体投资者的市场反应能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息优势理论、本地偏好理论、社会网络与信息共享理论、行为金融学中的市场择时能力
AI.method: 使用韩国某证券公司个体投资者的独特交易数据集，采用实证分析方法，对比江南区与非江南区投资者的交易行为，控制资产规模和投资经验等个体特征因素。
AI.findings: 1) 江南区投资者在市场暴跌时积极买入，反弹时获利了结，展现卓越市场择时能力；2) 反弹期间进行投资组合重组（保留低价买入的股票，卖出危机前持有的股票）；3) 江南区投资者资金流向和投资组合构成高度相似，暗示存在本地信息共享网络；4) 控制资产规模和经验后结果依然稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 拓展了行为金融学中个体投资者异质性的研究，揭示了社会经济地位（社区层面）对投资行为的影响；2) 为信息优势理论提供了微观证据，证明本地信息共享网络是富裕社区投资者优势的来源之一；3) 丰富了关于市场择时能力的研究，表明个体投资者（特定群体）也能具备类似机构的择时能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 对监管机构：提示信息不平等可能加剧财富分化，需关注不同社区间的信息获取差距；2) 对投资者：说明社交网络和信息共享对投资绩效的重要性；3) 对金融机构：可针对不同社区投资者特征提供差异化服务。

title: The Role of Trading Network in China's Corporate Bond Market
affiliations: Guanghua School of Management, Peking University and Nankai University

detail.title: The Role of Trading Network in China's Corporate Bond Market
detail.abstract: We document how a regulatory intervention on trading networks reshaped trading behavior, liquidity, and bond pricing in China's interbank corporate bond market. Using a proprietary dataset covering all transactions of non-financial corporate bonds, we analyze the effects of an exogenous regulatory shock in April 2013 that disrupted preestablished trading relationships. Our findings show that institutions more exposed to regulated accounts experienced a sharp contraction in trading activity following the intervention. Relative to less exposed institutions, they exhibited significantly lower same-day trade offsetting, reduced inventory holdings, and declines in trading volume. Sell-side prices declined more than buy-side prices, consistent with forced liquidation under liquidity pressure. Finally, we show that institutions trading less concentrated bonds adapted more effectively by re-routing trades toward alternative counterparties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2013年4月中国银行间公司债市场交易网络监管干预如何重塑交易行为、流动性和债券定价，发现受监管影响更大的机构交易活动显著收缩，并面临流动性压力下的被迫清算。
AI.research_question: 监管干预如何影响交易网络中的交易行为、流动性和债券定价？
AI.motivation: 利用中国公司债市场2013年4月的外生监管冲击，该冲击破坏了预先建立的交易关系，从而识别交易网络对市场质量的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易网络理论、流动性压力与被迫清算、关系型交易与市场适应机制。
AI.method: 使用覆盖所有非金融公司债交易的专有数据集，通过比较受监管账户敞口不同的机构在监管干预前后的交易行为变化进行分析。
AI.findings: 受监管影响更大的机构交易活动急剧收缩；同日交易冲销降低、库存持有减少、交易量下降；卖方价格下降幅度大于买方价格，表明流动性压力下的被迫清算；交易集中度较低的机构能更有效地通过转向替代交易对手来适应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为交易网络监管干预如何影响市场微观结构和定价提供了因果证据，揭示了关系型交易中断的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构设计交易网络干预政策提供了参考，提示需关注流动性压力和机构适应能力对市场稳定性的影响。

title: Do Firms Do Good Only When Watched? Media Exposure, ESG Ratings, and Reputational Herding
affiliations: Seoul National University

detail.title: Do Firms Do Good Only When Watched? Media Exposure, ESG Ratings, and Reputational Herding
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether ESG-related media exposure affects how publicly disclosed ESG information is reflected in external ESG ratings. Using S&P 500 firms from 2011 to 2023, we combine Refinitiv ESG ratings, ESG-related news coverage, and AI-generated ESG scores from 10-K filings. We find that greater media exposure is associated with shorter observed lags in the relation between 10-K-based ESG measures and external ratings: recent disclosures matter more in high-media firms, while longer lags persist in low-media firms, especially in the environmental and social pillars. We further show that high-media firms exhibit stronger adjustment toward peer benchmarks, consistent with reputational herding. Taken together, this paper highlights media’s role in shaping the external recognition of ESG disclosures and firms’ incentives to adjust toward peer benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了ESG相关的媒体曝光如何影响公开披露的ESG信息在外部ESG评级中的反映速度。研究发现，媒体曝光度高的公司，其10-K文件中的ESG信息能更快地反映在外部评级中，且更倾向于向同行基准调整，呈现出声誉驱动的羊群效应。
AI.research_question: ESG相关的媒体曝光如何影响公开披露的ESG信息在外部ESG评级中的反映速度和调整模式？
AI.motivation: 现有文献较少关注媒体作为信息中介在ESG信息披露与外部评级之间的调节作用，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息中介理论、声誉羊群效应、信号传递理论
AI.method: 以2011-2023年S&P 500公司为样本，结合Refinitiv ESG评级、ESG相关新闻覆盖以及基于AI从10-K文件中提取的ESG评分，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 媒体曝光度高的公司，10-K披露的ESG信息能更快反映在外部评级中（滞后更短）；高媒体曝光公司更倾向于向同行基准调整（声誉驱动型羊群效应）；该效应在环境和社会维度上尤为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了媒体作为信息中介在ESG信息传导中的加速作用，拓展了ESG评级形成机制的理论边界；为声誉羊群效应提供了新的经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对管理层而言，媒体关注会加速外部市场对ESG披露的反应，激励企业主动对标同行；对投资者和评级机构而言，媒体曝光是影响ESG评级时空动态的重要因素。

title: "Jurisdictional Havens": The Geography of Indigenous Identity in Mexico
affiliations: and

detail.title: "Jurisdictional Havens": The Geography of Indigenous Identity in Mexico

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: We argue that subjects living in "jurisdictional havens"-areas where rulers face competition from other rulers due to overlapping jurisdictions-enjoy prerogatives unavailable to those outside them. We employ this mechanism to explain the geographic distribution of Indigenous identity in Mexico today. Using a grid-cell design and the location of colonial authorities between 1520 and 1820, we find that the overlapping domains of royal and religious authorities exhibit, since 1800, more Indigenous pueblos, higher rates of Indigenous language use, Indigenous last names, and communal land tenure than comparable non-haven areas. To address endogeneity, we compare within-grid localities, conduct placebo tests based on historical relocations of authorities' headquarters, and match on observables. Additional evidence from colonial-era lawsuits, office valuations, and the eventual location of subnational borders is consistent with greater inter-ruler competition in havens. Taken together, our findings show how certain institutional configurations, and not just geography, create bargaining spaces for subaltern populations to capitalize on.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在殖民时期因管辖权重叠而形成的"司法避风港"地区，当代墨西哥原住民身份（语言、姓氏、土地制度）保存更为完整。其机制在于不同统治者之间的竞争为原住民创造了议价空间。
AI.research_question: 历史上管辖权重叠的地区（司法避风港）如何影响当代原住民身份的分布？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常关注地理因素对原住民文化保存的影响，但忽略了制度因素，特别是统治者之间竞争如何为边缘群体创造议价空间。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法避风港理论：当不同统治者（如王室与宗教当局）的管辖权在同一地域重叠时，统治者之间产生竞争，被统治者可以利用这种竞争获得特权或保留自主权。
AI.method: 使用1520-1820年殖民时期皇家与宗教当局位置的网格单元设计（grid-cell design），结合历史诉讼、官职估值等辅助证据，并通过内部比较、安慰剂检验和匹配方法处理内生性问题。
AI.findings: 管辖权重叠区域自1800年以来拥有更多原住民村庄、更高的原住民语言使用率、更多原住民姓氏以及更多 communal land tenure（共有土地制度）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"司法避风港"机制，将制度竞争理论延伸到边缘群体议价能力的研究，补充了单纯地理决定论的解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示特定制度配置（而非仅地理因素）能够为弱势群体创造保留文化身份的制度空间，对理解原住民权利保护具有政策启示。

title: Four Claims Tested on One Landscape: A Self-Falsification Study in Topological Data Analysis
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Four Claims Tested on One Landscape: A Self-Falsification Study in Topological Data Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a named inventor on United States provisional patent applications concerning topological methods related to those discussed in this article. The disclosure is made in the interest of transparency; the analysis rests on publicly available datasets and openly documented procedures.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: none

detail.abstract: This article takes four claims from the author's own prior work on topological degradation metrics, tests each against a control on a single real substrate, and reports that three of the four do not survive. The substrate is a fire-prone landscape in the Sierra de Ancares, northwestern Spain, for which a published 100-member random forest ignition ensemble and a static predictor stack are available, and for which ERA5-Land reanalysis supplies the meteorology from which two established fire indices are computed. The first claim, that one-dimensional persistent features are near the detection threshold on this landscape, was an artifact of a truncated download: the complete ensemble puts H1 prevalence at seventeen percent rather than three. The second claim, that zero-dimensional persistence declines monotonically along a spatial ignition gradient at a rank correlation of unity, is close to tautological, because the gradient variable is the node count rescaled and total persistence scales with node count; normalized, the relationship reverses. The third claim, that a negative Latent Yield indicates intrinsic sub-random structure, fails because the sign of that quantity inverts between two defensible null models, as companion work demonstrates on two independent citation benchmarks. The fourth claim, that the magnitude of a negative Latent Yield measures a property of the system, fails outright: a two-by-two control shows the negative reading persists when the attribute autocorrelation is destroyed, when the spatial embedding is destroyed, and when both are, establishing that the quantity reports the difference between a nearest-neighbour graph and its degree-preserving rewiring rather than anything about the landscape. What survives is a single result, and it survives precisely because it depends on none of the machinery that failed: on a network whose node set is held fixed at 389, total zero-dimensional persistence tracks dead fuel moisture across the fire season at a rank correlation of 0.964 with p equal to 0.00045, and is flat against ignition probability across one hundred ensemble members. This article is a companion to a methodological treatment of construction, null, and autocorrelation sensitivity, and supplies the empirical case that the treatment argues in the abstract.

AI.tldr: 本文对作者先前关于拓扑退化度量的四项主张进行了实证检验，发现其中三项无法成立（数据截断伪像、同义反复、无效基准模型），仅有一项稳健结果存活：固定节点网络的总零维持久性能够高度相关地追踪死燃料湿度变化，而与点火概率无关。
AI.research_question: 作者先前提出的四项拓扑退化度量主张在真实景观数据上是否成立？
AI.motivation: 检验先前工作中关于拓扑退化度量的四项核心主张的稳健性，揭示其是否因数据问题、逻辑缺陷或方法问题而失效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拓扑数据分析（TDA）中的持久性同调理论，尤其是零维（H0）和一维（H1）持久性特征。
AI.method: 采用西班牙西北部Sierra de Ancares火险景观的真实数据，使用随机森林点火集成（100个成员）、ERA5-Land再分析气象数据、两个成熟火险指数，通过四组对照检验（截断数据对照、归一化对照、两个可辩护零模型对照、2×2属性/空间自相关破坏对照）。
AI.findings: 1. H1持久性接近检测阈值是数据截断伪像（完整数据下为17%而非3%）；2. H0持久性与空间点火梯度的完美秩相关近乎同义反复（归一化后关系反转）；3. 负Latent Yield指示亚随机结构的说法在两个零模型下符号反转而失败；4. 负Latent Yield的绝对值度量系统属性的说法在2×2对照中完全失败（自相关和空间嵌入破坏后负值仍存在）。仅存一个稳健结果：固定389节点网络的总零维持久性与死燃料湿度秩相关0.964（p=0.00045），与点火概率无关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了拓扑退化度量在实证应用中常见的三类陷阱：数据完整性问题（截断伪像）、度量定义的逻辑循环（同义反复）、以及零模型选择敏感性（符号反转）。为拓扑数据分析在景观生态学中的应用提供了严谨的方法论警示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为火险景观研究提供了具体实证指导：固定节点网络的零维持久性可作为死燃料湿度追踪的有效指标；警示研究者在使用拓扑退化度量时需进行完整数据检验、归一化验证和多零模型对照。

title: Diagnostic Thresholds, Written Consent Requirements, and the Utilization of Scarce Organs
affiliations: and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - University of California, San Diego

detail.title: Diagnostic Thresholds, Written Consent Requirements, and the Utilization of Scarce Organs
detail.abstract:
This paper explores how diagnostic thresholds and a written consent requirement affect decision making between patients and transplant surgeons regarding the use of deceased donor kidneys. Combining administrative data on the universe of organ donors and transplant recipients in the United States, we show that age-based discontinuities within the Expanded Criteria Donor system (ECD), which was in place from late 2002 to late 2014, led to 4.0 and 5.4 percentage point differences in the rates at which otherwise indistinguishable kidneys were discarded. A discontinuity within the subsequent presentation of the Kidney Donor Profile Index (KDPI) led to a 2.6 percentage point difference. We present evidence that diagnostic thresholds have nuanced effects on decision making and information acquisition; procurement biopsy rates, for example, rose substantially at the ECD system’s age-based discontinuities. We further show that written consent requirements triggered within the ECD and KDPI labeling systems substantially reduced the number of potential recipients to whom kidneys were offered prior to being discarded. This channel can explain the majority of the increased rate at which “High-KDPI” kidneys are discarded under the current system.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了诊断阈值（如ECD系统的年龄阈值和KDPI系统的评分阈值）以及书面知情同意要求如何影响患者与移植医生之间关于使用 deceased donor kidneys 的决策，发现阈值导致原本无区别的肾脏丢弃率出现显著差异，而同意要求则大幅减少了肾脏被提供给潜在受体的机会。
AI.research_question: 诊断阈值和书面知情同意要求如何影响患者与移植医生之间关于使用 deceased donor kidneys 的决策？
AI.motivation: 探究在器官移植系统中，诊断阈值（如年龄边界和KDPI评分）以及书面同意程序是否以及如何扭曲了医患双方的决策行为，并导致本可使用的肾脏被不合理地丢弃。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学中的标签效应（labeling effects）、决策阈值与信息获取理论；框架效应（framing effects）与同意要求对决策行为的影响。
AI.method: 利用美国器官捐赠者和移植受者的行政大数据，采用断点回归设计（RDD），分析ECD系统（2002-2014）和KDPI系统下的年龄/评分阈值附近的肾脏丢弃率差异。
AI.findings: （1）ECD系统的年龄阈值导致原本无区别的肾脏丢弃率差异达4.0和5.4个百分点；（2）KDPI系统的评分阈值导致2.6个百分点的丢弃率差异；（3）诊断阈值还影响了信息获取行为，如阈值附近活检率显著上升；（4）书面知情同意要求大幅减少了肾脏被提供给潜在受体的机会，这一渠道可以解释当前系统下高KDPI肾脏被丢弃的大部分原因。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了诊断阈值在医疗决策中的"标签效应"不仅直接影响决策结果，还间接影响信息获取行为（如活检率）；并首次量化了书面同意要求的"摩擦效应"在器官分配系统中的重要作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为器官分配政策制定者提供了实证依据，说明减少诊断阈值带来的标签效应和简化同意程序可能有助于降低肾脏丢弃率，提高器官利用率。

title: The Contingency of Persistence: Construction, Null, and Autocorrelation Sensitivity in Topological Inference on Relational Data
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Contingency of Persistence: Construction, Null, and Autocorrelation Sensitivity in Topological Inference on Relational Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a named inventor on United States provisional patent applications concerning topological methods related to those discussed in this article. The disclosure is made in the interest of transparency; the analysis rests on publicly available datasets and openly documented procedures.
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: none.

detail.abstract: A persistence diagram, and any scalar derived from it, is routinely treated as a property of the data it summarizes. That treatment is unsafe. A persistence-derived summary is not a property of a relational system alone. It is a property of a tuple: the system, the construction by which a filtered complex is built from it, the null model against which structure or excess is judged, and the spatial or graph autocorrelation of the filtration values. This article demonstrates three dependency axes on real substrates spanning spatial and non-spatial, physical and social domains. On a groundwater depletion surface, four defensible pipeline constructions move the analysis from no signal to strong signal, and on a citation graph, four filtration constructions move total zero-dimensional persistence across a factor of thirty. On a fixed citation graph, a persistence-derived reserve metric changes sign between a degree-preserving null and an Erdos-Renyi null. A within-substrate control that permutes the spatial positions of one surface while holding its value distribution fixed removes a negative reserve reading entirely, isolating autocorrelation as the driver rather than any intrinsic property of the system. This article proposes a sensitivity index that makes the contingency reportable, gives an algorithmic protocol for constructing the admissible family over which it is computed, and states plainly which of its properties are demonstrated and which are conjectural. The stability theorem for persistence diagrams bounds the effect of perturbing a filtration function. It does not bound the effect of choosing a construction, of choosing a null, or of ignoring autocorrelation. That gap is the subject of this article.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示持久性摘要（persistence-derived summaries）并非数据本身的固有属性，而是依赖于构造方法、零模型和空间自相关等选择的偶然性结果。通过地下水枯竭表面和引用图等实例展示了这些依赖轴的影响，并提出敏感性指数和算法协议来报告这种偶然性。
AI.research_question: 持久性摘要（如持久性图及其衍生标量）在多大程度上依赖于分析方法的选择（构造、零模型、自相关），而非数据本身的固有属性？
AI.motivation: 持久性摘要常被当作数据本身的属性来使用，但本文指出这种处理是不安全的。持久性摘要依赖于多个维度的选择，而稳定性定理（stability theorem）仅约束了滤波函数扰动的效果，并未约束构造选择、零模型选择或忽略自相关带来的影响。这一差距是本文的动机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 持久同调（persistent homology）、稳定性定理、零模型、空间/图自相关、敏感性分析
AI.method: 通过三个依赖轴的实证演示：（1）地下水枯竭表面上四种不同的管道构造；（2）引用图上四种过滤构造；（3）固定引用图上度保持零模型与Erdos-Renyi零模型的对比；（4）空间位置置换控制实验。提出敏感性指数和算法协议。
AI.findings: （1）地下水表面上四种管道构造使分析结果从无信号变为强信号；（2）引用图上四种过滤构造使零维总持久度相差30倍；（3）固定引用图上持久性衍生储备指标在度保持零模型与Erdos-Renyi零模型下符号相反；（4）空间位置置换控制实验完全消除了负储备读数，表明自相关而非系统固有属性是驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 指出现有稳定性定理的局限——它仅约束滤波函数扰动，未约束构造选择、零模型选择和自相关忽略的影响。提出敏感性指数使这种偶然性可报告化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为持久性分析实践提供算法协议，用于构建"可容许族"（admissible family）并计算敏感性指数；提醒研究者持久性摘要的解读必须考虑分析选择的偶然性。

title: Does Immigration Relief Affect Labor Market Outcomes? Evidence from Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals

detail.title: Does Immigration Relief Affect Labor Market Outcomes? Evidence from Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals
detail.abstract: This paper studies the impacts of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) on individuals’ labor market outcomes using a Regression Discontinuity Design. I estimate the Intent to Treat (ITT) impact of DACA before the legal challenge to DACA in 2017. I find that the potentially eligible DACA population earned a significantly high income when the data is considered till 2017. I further compare my ITT estimates with other studies.

AI.tldr: 本文使用断点回归设计研究DACA（童年入境暂缓遣返计划）对个人劳动力市场结果的影响，发现在2017年法律挑战前，潜在符合条件人群的收入显著提高。
AI.research_question: DACA对个人劳动力市场结果（尤其是收入）有何影响？
AI.motivation: 评估DACA政策在2017年法律挑战前对劳动力市场的影响，并与已有研究进行比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 断点回归设计（RDD），意图处理效应（ITT）估计。
AI.method: 采用断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity Design），估计DACA的意图处理效应（ITT）。
AI.findings: 潜在符合条件的DACA人群在2017年前收入显著较高。
AI.theory_contributions: 为DACA政策的劳动力市场效应提供了因果证据，拓展了移民政策对经济结果影响的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估DACA的经济效益提供实证依据，特别是在法律挑战前后的政策讨论中。

title: When Not to Trade: Leakage-Aware Selective Machine Learning for Factor Rotation
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: When Not to Trade: Leakage-Aware Selective Machine Learning for Factor Rotation
detail.abstract: Machine-learning trading systems are often evaluated as always-on predictors: every period, a model is trained, a signal is produced, and a portfolio is formed. This paper studies a different question: when should a machine-learning strategy refuse to trade? Financial return prediction is exposed to non-stationarity, temporal distribution shift, selection bias, transaction costs, and backtest overfitting. Under such conditions, a model's apparent validation advantage may not justify deployment. I propose a leakage-aware selective alpha deployment framework for factor and sector rotation. The framework separates model fitting, validation calibration, and out-of-sample testing through a rolling-origin protocol. At each decision date, the strategy estimates whether a candidate machine-learning signal improves over a transparent fallback benchmark on a pre-specified validation window. The signal is deployed only when the validation improvement exceeds a calibrated threshold; otherwise, the strategy abstains and falls back to a benchmark portfolio. I formalize the selective strategy as a predictable portfolio rule, derive its return and mean-variance utility decomposition, provide a validation-error deployment bound, and show how null-calibrated gates control false deployment under placebo signals. In the baseline sector-rotation experiment, selective gradient boosting improves net Sharpe from 0.55 to 0.78, reduces maximum drawdown from-39.0% to-21.4%, and cuts turnover by more than half relative to its always-trade counterpart. The paper contributes a practical protocol for reducing leakage and deployment risk in machine-learning-based quantitative strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种泄漏感知的选择性阿尔法部署框架（Selective Alpha Deployment Framework），用于因子和行业轮动策略。该框架通过滚动窗口验证机制，让机器学习策略在信号未能超过透明基准时“拒绝交易”（abstain），从而有效提升风险调整后收益（净夏普比率从0.55提升至0.78），并大幅降低最大回撤和换手率。
AI.research_question: 机器学习交易策略在何种条件下应该“拒绝交易”？即如何设计一个机制，让策略在信号质量不足时主动选择不部署，而非总是交易？
AI.motivation: 金融收益预测面临非平稳性、时间分布偏移、选择偏差、交易成本和回测过拟合等问题，导致机器学习模型的验证优势在部署时可能不成立。现有研究多将模型视为“始终在线”的预测器，缺乏对何时应拒绝交易的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 泄漏感知的选择性部署框架（Leakage-Aware Selective Alpha Deployment Framework）；2. 滚动窗口验证协议（Rolling-Origin Protocol），分离模型拟合、验证校准和样本外测试；3. 可预测投资组合规则（Predictable Portfolio Rule）；4. 均值-方差效用分解；5. 验证误差部署边界（Validation-Error Deployment Bound）；6. 零假设校准门控（Null-Calibrated Gates），控制虚假信号下的错误部署。
AI.method: 提出选择性部署框架，在每个决策日估计候选机器学习信号是否优于透明基准（fallback benchmark），仅当验证窗口的改进超过校准阈值时才部署信号，否则退回到基准投资组合。采用滚动窗口协议确保泄漏感知，并通过零假设校准控制虚假部署风险。
AI.findings: 在基准行业轮动实验中，选择性梯度提升（Selective Gradient Boosting）相比“始终交易”的对应策略：净夏普比率从0.55提升至0.78，最大回撤从-39.0%降至-21.4%，换手率降低超过一半。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统性地将“拒绝交易”问题形式化为可预测投资组合规则；2. 提供了选择性策略的收益和均值-方差效用分解；3. 推导出验证误差部署边界，为选择性部署提供了理论保证；4. 引入零假设校准门控机制，从理论上控制虚假信号部署的概率。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个减少泄漏和部署风险的实用协议，可直接用于量化策略开发；2. 显著提升策略的风险调整后收益（夏普比率提升42%）；3. 大幅降低回撤和换手率，提高策略的实际可行性和稳健性；4. 为机器学习在金融领域的实践部署提供了“何时不行动”的操作指南。

title: No-Poach Agreements
affiliations: University of Cambridge and Duke University

detail.title: No-Poach Agreements
detail.abstract:
We study no-poach cartels using a wage-posting model that puts worker poaching at the center of labor market competition. Even when just two out of ten employers in a local labor market collude, wages fall by almost 5% market-wide. The reason is that no-poach agreements suppress competition along the job ladder, with spillovers to non-colluding firms. We then compare no-poach agreements to two other forms of anti-competitive conduct in the labor market: noncompete agreements and wage fixing. No-poach agreements have by far the largest negative wage effects.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过工资竞价模型研究不挖角卡特尔对劳动力市场的影响，发现即使只有两个雇主合谋，市场整体工资也会下降近5%，且不挖角协议对工资的负面效应远大于竞业禁止协议和固定工资协议。
AI.research_question: 不挖角卡特尔（no-poach cartels）对劳动力市场工资水平有何影响？与其他反竞争行为（竞业禁止协议和固定工资协议）相比，其负面效应有多大？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业通过不挖角协议限制劳动力市场竞争的现象日益受到反垄断关注，但对其量化的市场影响及传导机制的研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工资竞价模型（wage-posting model），将员工被挖角置于劳动力市场竞争的核心位置，构建职业阶梯竞争框架。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟分析，比较三种反竞争行为的工资效应。
AI.findings: （1）即使只有10家雇主中的2家合谋实施不挖角协议，市场整体工资下降近5%；（2）不挖角协议抑制了职业阶梯上的竞争，产生向非合谋企业的溢出效应；（3）不挖角协议的负面工资效应远大于竞业禁止协议和固定工资协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 将不挖角行为纳入劳动力市场反竞争分析框架，揭示了合谋企业通过抑制职业阶梯竞争向非合谋企业传导的溢出机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为反垄断执法机构评估和规制不挖角卡特尔提供了量化依据，表明此类行为对劳动者福利的危害可能被严重低估。

title: Immigrants' Legal Status and Firms: Evidence from the 2007 EU Enlargement
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and Northwestern University

detail.title: Immigrants' Legal Status and Firms: Evidence from the 2007 EU Enlargement
detail.abstract:
We study how firms and workers adjust when previously restricted migrants gain full and portable work rights in a labor market with substantial informality. We exploit the 2007 EU accession of Bulgaria and Romania, which granted unrestricted work rights to Italy's largest migrant group. Using matched employer–employee administrative data and an IV-DID design, we find that firms suddenly and persistently shift employment composition toward EU07 workers, compressing the native employment share without reducing native hiring or increasing separations. We don't detect any significant change in wages for either natives or EU07 workers. For migrants, this null effect reflects offsetting compositional shifts as newly observed and incumbent EU07 workers enter the formal workforce with different wage trajectories. Consistent with a shift in bargaining power toward workers, EU07 migrants experienced significant gains in job mobility and job security. Overall, the evidence suggests that removing legal restrictions reshaped firms’ personnel choices and altered migrants’ employment relationships, improving their outside options, bargaining position, and access to more secure jobs.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2007年保加利亚和罗马尼亚加入欧盟（欧盟扩大）这一准自然实验，研究了当移民获得完全可携带的工作权利时，企业和劳动者在高度非正规劳动力市场中如何调整。研究发现，企业迅速且持续地将就业结构转向新移民，压缩了本土就业份额，但并未减少本土员工的招聘或增加离职。移民的工资未发现显著变化，但其工作流动性和工作安全性显著提升，整体证据表明取消法律限制重塑了企业人事选择并改善了移民的就业关系与议价地位。
AI.research_question: 在劳动力市场存在大量非正规就业的背景下，当先前受限制的移民获得完全且可携带的工作权利时，企业和劳动者会如何调整？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对移民政策放松如何影响劳动力市场调整的理解仍不充分，尤其是在存在大量非正规就业的背景下。2007年欧盟东扩为保加利亚和罗马尼亚移民（意大利最大的移民群体）提供了自然实验，使得识别移民权利变化对劳动力市场的因果效应成为可能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动经济学中的移民市场调整理论、议价能力理论、以及劳动力市场分割理论（正式与非正式部门）。
AI.method: 采用匹配的雇主-雇员行政数据，结合工具变量与双重差分（IV-DID）方法进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 1）企业迅速且持续地将就业结构转向新移民，压缩了本土就业份额，但未减少本土员工的招聘或增加离职；2）移民和本土员工的工资均未发生显著变化；3）移民工资无显著变化的原因在于，新进入正式就业的移民与原有移民经历了不同的工资轨迹，相互抵消；4）移民的工作流动性（job mobility）和工作安全性（job security）显著提升，表明其议价能力增强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了移民法律权利变化通过改变企业人事选择（而非仅仅影响劳动力供给）来重塑劳动力市场均衡的机制；补充了关于移民政策放松如何影响非正规就业市场的理论理解；强调了议价能力和外部选择权在解释移民劳动力市场结果中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于取消移民工作限制的劳动力市场影响的经验证据：政策放松不会挤占本地人就业或压低工资，但能显著改善移民的工作质量和议价地位，这对移民融合和劳动力市场监管具有直接的政策启示。

title: Interdependence or Contagion? An Econometric Analysis of Stablecoin Resilience in Periods of Market Stress

detail.title: Interdependence or Contagion? An Econometric Analysis of Stablecoin Resilience in Periods of Market Stress
detail.abstract: This paper tests whether stablecoins exhibit nancial contagion during market stress or merely persistent interdependence. Using daily Coin Metrics data for 20222025 for six stablecoins (USDT, USDC, TUSD, BUSD, GUSD and DAI), we show that a naive comparison of correlations is biased, exactly as Forbes and Rigobon (2002) warned: the rise in crisis-period correlations is almost entirely explained by a jump in volatility. After the correct Forbes Rigobon heteroskedasticity adjustment, and independently under a DCC-GARCH model, the systemic-contagion hypothesis is not supported for any of the three crises (UST/LUNA, FTX, SVB). The only persistent elevated link, the USDCDAI pair, reects a direct collateral link between the assets rather than panic transmission. A Markov-switching model endogenously identies a high-volatility regime that captures the known crises, formalising the regime-dependent nature of interdependence. A logistic regression with an exogenous stress denition conrms the absence of signicant cross-asset transmission channels. Additional copula tail-dependence and DieboldYilmaz connectedness analyses conrm that no hidden tail or network contagion channel is detected. The results bear on macroprudential supervision and the assessment of stablecoin systemic risk.

AI.tldr: 本文检验稳定币在市场压力时期是否存在金融传染，还是仅存在持续的相互依存关系。使用2022-2025年六种稳定币的日度数据，经异方差调整后，发现三次危机中均不存在系统性传染，仅USDC-DAI因直接抵押品关联而保持高关联性。
AI.research_question: 稳定币在市场压力时期是表现出金融传染，还是仅存在持续的相互依存关系？
AI.motivation: Forbes和Rigobon（2002）曾警告，危机时期相关性上升可能仅由波动率跳升导致，但这一异方差偏误在稳定币研究中尚未被系统检验。本文旨在纠正这一偏误，准确判断稳定币市场是否存在真正的传染。
AI.theoretical_framework: Forbes-Rigobon异方差调整、DCC-GARCH模型、马尔可夫区制转换模型、Copula尾部依赖分析、Diebold-Yilmaz关联性分析。
AI.method: 使用2022-2025年Coin Metrics六种稳定币（USDT, USDC, TUSD, BUSD, GUSD, DAI）日度数据，采用Forbes-Rigobon异方差校正、DCC-GARCH、马尔可夫区制转换模型、Logistic回归、Copula尾部依赖和Diebold-Yilmaz溢出指数等多种方法。
AI.findings: 1. 危机期间相关系数上升几乎完全由波动率跳升驱动；2. 经异方差校正后，三次危机（UST/LUNA、FTX、SVB）均不支持系统性传染假说；3. 唯一持续高关联的USDC-DAI对反映直接抵押品关联而非恐慌传播；4. 马尔可夫模型内生识别出高波动区制；5. 尾部依赖和网络关联分析均未发现隐藏传染渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Forbes-Rigobon异方差校正方法系统应用于稳定币市场，严格区分了"传染"与"相互依存"的实证差异，证实了稳定币市场不存在跨资产传染渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 对宏观审慎监管和稳定币系统性风险评估具有重要政策含义：监管应关注特定资产之间的直接关联（如抵押品联系），而非泛化的恐慌传染风险。

title: Retreating from Science: The Long-Run Effects of the 1970s U.S. Military Disinvestment from University Research
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, Johns Hopkins University - School of Government & Policy and Duke University

detail.title: Retreating from Science: The Long-Run Effects of the 1970s U.S. Military Disinvestment from University Research
detail.abstract:
Between 1945 and 1970, the U.S. Department of Defense was one of the country's largest funders of university research, and the most important in the physical sciences and engineering. Political pressures subsequently led to this funding declining nearly two-thirds by the mid-1970s and never fully recovering. We show that these cuts were felt across the U.S. research system, with ensuing declines in university scientists, PhD production, and research output. Early career scientists who were DoD-funded in 1970 were more likely than peers to leave universities, with many moving to industry. Though some became more likely to patent, in the aggregate, this appears to have reduced science-linked innovation in related technologies and compressed U.S. leadership in formerly DoD-driven fields. These effects extend to outcomes more closely related to military objectives: fewer PhDs entered the defense industrial base, and an initial increase in science-linked defense patenting in the most exposed technology areas gave way to a long-run decline.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 1945-1970年间美国国防部是大学研究的主要资助者，但随后资助削减近三分之二。研究发现，这一削减导致大学科学家减少、博士产量下降、研究产出降低，年轻科研人员转向工业界，虽然专利活动增加但长期损害了国防相关领域的科学创新和美国领导地位。
AI.research_question: 美国国防部对大学研究资助的大幅削减如何影响科学研究产出、科学家职业发展、以及国防相关技术创新？
AI.motivation: 1945-1970年间国防部是美国大学研究最大资助方之一，但政治压力导致其资助在1970年代中期削减近三分之二且未完全恢复，作者希望评估这一政策冲击对科研体系和国防创新的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共科研资助的经济学、科学创新与人力资本流动理论、国防研发溢出效应理论
AI.method: 实证分析，利用1970年前后国防部资助削减作为准自然实验，比较受资助科学家与未受资助同行的职业轨迹、专利产出、博士培养等数据，并进行长期趋势分析。
AI.findings: 1）资助削减导致大学科学家数量、博士产量和研究产出全面下降；2）1970年受国防部资助的早期职业科学家更可能离开学术界进入工业界；3）部分科学家专利活动增加，但总体上减少了相关技术领域的科学驱动创新；4）美国在国防部主导领域的技术领导地位被压缩；5）进入国防工业基地的博士减少，国防相关科学专利在短期增加后长期下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 为公共科研资助与科学人力资本积累之间的关系提供了因果证据，揭示了政府资助削减对科学创新生态系统的长期系统性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估国防科研资助政策调整的长期后果提供了实证依据，提示削减基础科研资助可能损害国家安全相关的技术创新能力。

title: Human Enhancement Technologies: A Survey Experiment on Private Demand and Governance Preferences
affiliations: , ,  and Catholic University of Milan

detail.title: Human Enhancement Technologies: A Survey Experiment on Private Demand and Governance Preferences
detail.abstract:
When a new technology promises large private benefits but may impose social costs that markets do not price, demand need not reveal how citizens want it governed. We examine this using a nationally representative U.S. survey experiment (N=5,556) on human enhancement technologies (HET). The experiment randomizes benefit domain, mechanism, heritability, purpose, and risk across vignettes; for each respondent’s assigned vignette, we elicit stated adoption, preferred regulation, and ethical and societal concerns. Overall, about 53% would adopt. Framing the technology as enhancing rather than restorative lowers adoption by about five percentage points, as much as a severe side-effect profile. About 28% would not adopt at any benefit. This refusal is driven overwhelmingly by the enhancing framing rather than by risk, consistent with a non-compensatory constraint for a substantial subgroup. Most who would adopt still favor strict regulation, and most who would never adopt do not wish to forbid others from doing so. Productivity enhancement generates the most ethical concern of any attribute but attracts the least regulation, and respondents favor subsidizing rather than taxing its adoption, consistent with a concern about access rather than safety. Private demand is therefore an unreliable guide to the governance citizens want, and the divergence we document provides a basis for regulators seeking to align the direction of technical change with societal values and priorities.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过一项美国全国代表性调查实验（N=5,556），探讨人类增强技术（HET）的私人需求与公众治理偏好之间的脱节。研究发现，约53%的人会采用该技术，但“增强”而非“治疗”的框架会降低采用率；约28%的人无论收益多高都拒绝采用，这主要源于“增强”框架而非风险。大多数采用者仍支持严格监管，而拒绝者并不禁止他人使用。生产率增强引发的伦理关切最多，但要求的监管最少，且公众倾向于补贴而非征税。私人需求无法可靠反映公民期望的治理方式。
AI.research_question: 当新技术提供巨大私人收益但可能产生市场未定价的社会成本时，私人需求能否可靠地反映公民期望的治理方式？
AI.motivation: 新技术（如人类增强技术）可能带来私人收益的同时产生未定价的社会成本，这使得市场需求信号无法揭示公众的真实治理偏好，因此需要通过实验探究私人需求与治理偏好之间的分歧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非补偿性约束（non-compensatory constraint）：部分群体对“增强”而非“治疗”的框架存在刚性拒绝，即使收益再高也不愿采用；市场失灵与治理偏好理论：当外部性存在时，私人需求无法有效揭示社会最优治理方式。
AI.method: 全国代表性调查实验（N=5,556），通过随机分配不同属性（收益领域、机制、可遗传性、目的、风险）的情境描述，测量受访者的采用意愿、监管偏好及伦理与社会关切。
AI.findings: 1. 约53%的受访者会采用HET；2.“增强”框架比“治疗”框架降低约5个百分点的采用率，效果与严重副作用相当；3. 约28%在任何收益下都不采用，主要由“增强”框架驱动而非风险；4. 大多数采用者支持严格监管，拒绝者不禁止他人使用；5. 生产率增强引发最多伦理关切但要求最少监管，公众倾向补贴而非征税。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了私人市场信号在存在社会外部性时无法真实反映公民治理偏好的理论边界，识别了“增强”框架作为非补偿性约束的新机制，丰富了技术治理与行为经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了重要依据：不能仅依据市场需求来规制新技术的方向，而应直接考察公民的治理偏好；特别是在人类增强领域，监管设计需区分“治疗”与“增强”的不同社会反应，并关注可及性而非仅是安全性。

title: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
affiliations: , , University of California, San Diego (UCSD) and University of Texas at Austin - Department of Economics

detail.title: Supply Chain Risk, Trade and Economic Fragility
detail.abstract:
We study how equilibrium patterns of production, trade, and input sourcing in complex supply chains are shaped by aggregate risk. We develop a quantitative multi-country model with multi-sourcing across stages. We show that sourcing shares equal an input’s expected output elasticity — its expected marginal contribution to output across states of the world. Risk has a positional effect on sourcing and welfare, operating through offsetting cross-stage complementarity and within-stage substitutability; which one dominates is a quantitative question. An increase in a country’s own risk always lowers its welfare; risk elsewhere has ambiguous, sometimes positive, effects through relative prices. We also show analytically that risk attenuates comparative advantage, as countries shift sourcing away from their most productive suppliers. Quantifying the model for 50 countries and 3 production stages, we show that supply-chain complexity lowers volatility for the riskiest countries, and rising Chinese-origin risk reallocates production and lowers welfare unevenly across the chain.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含多阶段、多源采购的定量多国模型，研究总体风险如何塑造复杂供应链中的生产、贸易和投入采购均衡模式。发现风险通过跨阶段互补性和阶段内替代性的抵消效应产生位置效应，会削弱比较优势，且供应链复杂性会降低高风险国家的波动性。
AI.research_question: 总体风险如何影响复杂供应链中的生产、贸易和投入采购的均衡模式？
AI.motivation: 现代供应链日趋复杂且面临各种宏观风险（如地缘政治、疫情等），但关于风险如何塑造多层供应链结构的理论尚不充分，亟需一个量化框架来理解风险对全球供应链的重新配置效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多阶段多源采购的定量多国模型；投入的预期产出弹性理论；跨阶段互补性与阶段内替代性的位置效应框架。
AI.method: 构建包含多阶段生产和多源采购的定量多国模型，进行理论推导分析，并对50个国家和3个生产阶段的数据进行量化校准和模拟。
AI.findings: (1)采购份额等于投入的预期产出弹性（即各状态下投入对产出的预期边际贡献）；(2)风险通过跨阶段互补性与阶段内替代性的抵消效应产生位置效应；(3)一国自身风险上升总是降低其福利，但他国风险影响不确定（有时通过相对价格产生正面效应）；(4)风险会削弱比较优势；(5)供应链复杂性降低了高风险国家的波动性；(6)中国风险上升会沿供应链不均匀地重新配置生产并降低福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将总体风险系统地纳入多阶段供应链模型；揭示了风险通过"位置效应"影响采购决策的机制；证明了风险对比较优势的衰减作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估供应链风险（如中国风险上升）对不同国家、不同环节的差异化影响提供了量化工具；为企业优化风险条件下的多源采购策略提供理论指导。

title: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition
affiliations: Imperial College London, University Paris Dauphine-PSL and

detail.title: Exorbitant Privilege of the Periodic Table? Geoeconomics, Endogenous Centrality and Strategic Minerals for the Green Transition
detail.abstract:
Trade networks underpinning the energy transition are endogenous economic objects, and their structure is a source of market power. Using bilateral trade data for thirteen electrification metals over 1995–2023, we show that trade in these materials has reorganised into a hub-and-spoke system centred on China, in sharp contrast to the diffuse, multilateral structure of fossil fuels. This centrality did not follow from resource endowments: China holds few of the underlying reserves. It was built through processing investment, industrial policy, and commodity-targeted development finance—an equilibrium outcome rather than a geographical accident. We formalise this in a stylised model in which a country chooses how central to become, and show that centrality maps into pricing power: the world price response to a strategic supply cut is stronger when the network is more concentrated and downstream demand and fringe supply are more inelastic. Constructing text-based, commodity-specific supply shocks and estimating local projections, we find that supply contractions in critical metals raise US and EU consumer prices by roughly twice as much as comparable fossil-fuel shocks, and more persistently. Centrality is therefore not merely descriptive: it creates leverage over global prices. The green transition reduces strategic dependence on hydrocarbon exporters but reconstitutes it around mineral supply chains.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能源转型所需关键金属的贸易网络结构，发现其已重组为以中国为中心的"轮轴-辐条"体系，这种中心地位并非源于资源禀赋，而是通过加工投资、产业政策和定向发展金融形成的均衡结果。中心化程度越高，供应削减对全球价格的冲击越强，绿色转型虽减少了对油气出口国的依赖，却重构了对矿产供应链的战略依赖。
AI.research_question: 能源转型所需关键金属的贸易网络结构如何演变？这种结构如何影响市场定价权？
AI.motivation: 能源转型对关键金属的需求激增，但贸易网络结构及其价格影响机制尚不清晰，尤其是与化石燃料贸易结构的对比分析不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生贸易网络理论、市场势力与定价权理论、中心度-定价权模型
AI.method: 1995-2023年13种电气化金属双边贸易数据分析；构建基于文本的特定商品供应冲击指标；局部投影法估计
AI.findings: 关键金属贸易已重组为以中国为中心的轮轴-辐条体系，与化石燃料的分散多边结构形成鲜明对比；中国中心地位源于产业政策而非资源禀赋；网络中心度与定价权正相关；关键金属供应收缩对美欧消费者价格的冲击约为同类化石燃料冲击的两倍，且更持久。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立中心度-定价权理论模型，证明贸易网络结构内生于政策选择且是市场势力的来源；将网络结构与定价权机制化联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示绿色转型在减少对油气依赖的同时，可能重构对矿产供应链的战略依赖；为关键矿产供应链安全和产业政策制定提供实证依据。

title: The Changing Reality of Care: Effects of Institutional Changes and Third-Party Actors on The Experiences of Migrant Caregivers in Israel
affiliations: Tel Aviv University and Tel Aviv University - Department of Political Science

detail.title: The Changing Reality of Care: Effects of Institutional Changes and Third-Party Actors on The Experiences of Migrant Caregivers in Israel

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: This article aims to advance debates on migration governance by analyzing the structural contradictions of Israel's care migration regime over the past 25 years. Using a mixed-methods design, combining a survey of 141 caregivers with in-depth follow-up interviews, the study traces how bilateral labor agreements, regulatory reforms, and recruitment chains have reshaped conditions across arrival cohorts since the mid-1990s. The analysis shows that while formal reforms projected modernization, the system remained anchored in informal brokerage, escalating recruitment fees, and delegated enforcement. Building on these findings, we conceptualize Israel's regime as a form of hybrid migration governance: the state symbolically regulates migration while outsourcing recruitment, monitoring, and enforcement to transnational intermediaries. This configuration produces what we call "designed precarity", a structurally maintained condition where legal protections coexist with persistent exploitation. By foregrounding caregivers' lived experiences, the article demonstrates how state outsourcing does not dismantle coercive practices but reorganizes them through diffuse and networked forms of control. Situating the Israeli case within global debates on care chains and migration infrastructures, we argue that neoliberal outsourcing embeds dependency and vulnerability within transnational labor provision while sustaining the façade of regulatory progress. Because Israel's population is on average younger than many Western democracies, its long-standing reliance on migrant care offers an early warning model from which other aging societies can learn as they confront similar demographic and institutional pressures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析以色列过去25年的照护移民制度，揭示了其结构性矛盾。尽管进行了正式改革，该制度仍依赖非正式中介、高昂招募费用和委托执法。研究者提出"混合移民治理"和"设计性不稳定"两个概念，指出国家将监管外包给跨国中间机构，导致法律保护与持续剥削并存。以色列案例为其他面临老龄化压力的社会提供了早期预警模型。
AI.research_question: 以色列照护移民制度在过去25年中，其结构性矛盾如何演化？正式改革与非正式实践之间为何存在持续张力？
AI.motivation: 现有移民治理研究多关注正式政策和法律框架，但较少揭示国家外包监管如何通过非正式中介产生新型剥削形式。以色列作为长期依赖移民照护的年轻社会，为理解老龄化社会面临的移民治理困境提供了独特窗口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合移民治理（Hybrid Migration Governance）、设计性不稳定（Designed Precarity）、照护链（Care Chains）、移民基础设施（Migration Infrastructures）、新自由主义外包（Neoliberal Outsourcing）
AI.method: 混合研究方法：141名照护人员问卷调查 + 深度追踪访谈，按1990年代中期以来的入境队列进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 正式改革虽声称现代化，但制度仍锚定于非正式中介和高昂招募费用。2. 国家象征性监管移民，同时将招聘、监控和执行外包给跨国中间机构。3. "设计性不稳定"：法律保护与持续剥削在结构性条件下并存。4. 国家外包并未废除强制实践，而是通过分散化、网络化的控制形式重新组织这些实践。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"混合移民治理"和"设计性不稳定"两个理论概念，揭示国家外包监管如何将依赖性和脆弱性嵌入跨国劳动供给，同时维持监管进步的表象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为面临人口老龄化和照护移民压力的社会提供早期预警模型。2. 批判性揭示"监管现代化"话语下隐蔽的剥削机制，为政策制定者提供制度设计反思。

title: The Price of Political Ties: Reputational Risk and the Strategic Divestment of Corporate PACs
affiliations: Stanford University, , Stanford Law School and Stanford University

detail.title: The Price of Political Ties: Reputational Risk and the Strategic Divestment of Corporate PACs
detail.abstract:
Political contributions generate access and influence for firms, but their public visibility exposes firms to reputational risk. We study how firms adjust their political spending when the reputational cost of political ties rises sharply. To identify this response, we exploit fatal school shootings and mass shootings as exogenous shocks to the salience of gun violence in the United States. We implement a staggered difference-in-differences design on a panel of corporate PAC contributions to U.S. House candidates, 2000–2024. We find that corporate PACs divest selectively and temporarily following gun violence shocks. Contributions to Republican candidates fall by 70.3% after fatal school shootings in competitive districts and return to baseline within nine months, with no substitution toward Democratic candidates. A parallel penalty of 60.9% emerges for Republicans in safe Democratic districts but is absent in safe Republican districts. Mass shootings generate similar perturbations in corporate contributions. These patterns indicate that firms withdraw only where the reputational risk of continued association is high or its strategic value is low. The observed divestment appears across industries and is stronger for firms with greater consumer exposure. Our findings reveal that firms treat political ties as time-varying liabilities, temporarily withdrawing visible financial support when issue salience spikes and resuming once public attention fades, leaving firms’ long-run political investment intact. Since public pressure is limited and dissipates quickly, and corporate divestment is transient rather than durably reallocated, the underlying financial incentives facing policymakers remain unchanged in the long run, sustaining the policy status quo.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国校园枪击和大规模枪击事件作为外生冲击，采用2000-2024年企业PAC对众议院候选人捐款的面板数据进行交错双重差分分析，发现企业会暂时性地、有选择地从声誉风险高的政治关联中撤资（对共和党候选人捐款下降高达70.3%），但公众注意力消散后捐款恢复，长期政治投资不变，从而维持了政策现状。
AI.research_question: 当政治关联的声誉成本急剧上升时，企业如何调整其政治支出？
AI.motivation: 政治献金能为企业带来准入和影响力，但其公开性也使企业面临声誉风险。理解企业在声誉成本上升时如何应对，有助于揭示政治压力对企业行为的真实影响及其政策后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉风险理论；政治关联作为时变负债的观点；公众注意力周期与议题显著性理论。
AI.method: 交错双重差分设计（staggered difference-in-differences），使用2000-2024年企业PAC对美众议院候选人捐款的面板数据。
AI.findings: （1）校园枪击后，企业在竞争性选区对共和党候选人捐款下降70.3%，9个月内恢复；（2）安全民主党选区出现类似下降（60.9%），但安全共和党选区无显著变化；（3）大规模枪击事件也有类似效应；（4）撤资具有行业普遍性，消费者曝光度高的企业反应更强；（5）企业不会转向民主党候选人替代捐款。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示企业将政治关联视为“时变负债”（time-varying liabilities），在议题显著性飙升时临时撤回可见的财务支持，公众注意力消退后恢复，这丰富了政治关联与企业声誉风险管理的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 说明公众压力有限且消散迅速，企业撤资是暂时的而非持久的资源重新配置，因此政策制定者面临的长期财务激励不变，维持了政策现状——这对理解公众舆论、企业政治行为与政策停滞之间的关系具有重要启示。

title: Optimal Currency Strategies Under Deviations From Interest Parity
affiliations: and Netspar

detail.title: Optimal Currency Strategies Under Deviations From Interest Parity
detail.abstract:
This paper examines optimal currency demands for global equity and bond investors in a large cross-section of developed and emerging markets over the 1975-2023 period. It extends the framework of Campbell et al. (2010) by incorporating both optimal portfolio-risk minimizing currency exposures, accounting for empirically measured hedging costs arising from deviations of Covered Interest Parity (CIP), and optimal expected-return-driven currency demands based on non-zero expected excess currency returns arising from empirically measured deviations of Uncovered Interest Parity (UIP). The analysis shows that the main conclusions of their portfolio risk-minimizing framework hold for this larger and longer panel of countries and that they are robust to deviations from CIP. Specifically, it is optimal for portfolio risk-minimizing equity investors to hold exposures to the U.S. dollar and the euro while avoiding exposure to all other currencies, whereas bond investors should hedge all currency exposures. In contrast, observed deviations from UIP are sufficiently large and persistent among currencies with high average relative interest currencies, especially Emerging Markets currencies, to generate expected return-driven currency demands that offset, and in some cases reverse, portfolio-risk minimizing demands, even for investors with low risk tolerance. The average excess returns on those currencies are large enough to compensate investors for their substantial return volatility and strong positive covariance with equity returns.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1975-2023年间全球股票和债券投资者在发达与新兴市场中的最优货币需求，扩展了Campbell et al.(2010)的框架，纳入CIP偏离导致的套期保值成本和UIP偏离产生的预期收益驱动需求。结果表明股票投资者应持有美元和欧元敞口，债券投资者应完全对冲；但新兴市场货币的UIP偏离足够大，可抵消甚至逆转风险最小化需求。
AI.research_question: 在全球股票和债券投资组合中，投资者最优货币需求如何决定？纳入CIP偏离（套期保值成本）和UIP偏离（预期超额收益）后，风险最小化与预期收益驱动两种货币需求如何相互影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究（如Campbell et al., 2010）主要从风险最小化角度分析货币敞口，但忽略了实际市场中CIP和UIP的显著偏离。本文旨在检验这些偏离是否以及如何改变投资者的最优货币配置策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Campbell et al.(2010)的投资组合风险最小化框架，纳入CIP偏离衡量的实际套期保值成本，以及UIP偏离产生的非零预期超额货币收益。
AI.method: 使用1975-2023年大截面发达和新兴市场数据，实证测量CIP和UIP偏离，构建包含风险最小化和预期收益驱动的货币需求模型，进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) 风险最小化下股票投资者应持有美元和欧元敞口，避免其他货币；债券投资者应完全对冲。2) 该结论在更大样本和考虑CIP偏离后依然稳健。3) 新兴市场等高利率货币的UIP偏离足够大且持久，产生的预期收益驱动需求可抵消甚至逆转风险最小化需求，即使对低风险容忍度的投资者也如此。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了国际投资组合货币选择的经典理论框架，系统整合了风险最小化与预期收益驱动两种货币需求，揭示了CIP和UIP偏离对最优货币配置的联合影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为全球股票和债券投资者提供了具体的货币敞口管理策略建议，指出新兴市场货币虽高风险高波动，但其超额回报足以补偿风险，值得战略性配置。

title: Spreading Out Across Expanding Idea Space
affiliations: University of Massachusetts at Amherst - College of Social and Behavioral Sciences - Department of Economics, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Philadelphia and University of Essex

detail.title: Spreading Out Across Expanding Idea Space
detail.abstract:
Over nearly two centuries, US inventions have become increasingly dissimilar: not just fewer head-to-head collisions between inventors, but growing distance between neighboring inventions. We document this secular decline in similarity using validated neural language models applied to the full text of claims in over 11 million US patents (1836–2023), corroborated by a 98% decline in patent interference rates, a measure of independent simultaneous invention. Measuring this correctly requires validation, since different representations of the same patent text can yield opposite conclusions about whether inventions are converging or spreading out. Our validation framework, the first systematic comparison for patent text, selects among these representations. We develop a spatial competition model in which inventors choose locations in idea space. The model explains spreading out and connects it to several independently documented patterns — rising R&D investment per inventor, increasing patent values, weakening knowledge spillovers, and declining research productivity. The mechanism is spatial; as inventors spread out to capture new territory, inventions become more valuable but also more costly for others to absorb. In doing so, the model turns spillover intensity, innovation step size, and research productivity from fixed primitives into outcomes of inventor positioning. A calibrated decomposition attributes roughly 40% of the long-run decline in US research productivity to these spatial forces, alongside traditional explanations such as fishing out and the burden of knowledge. Where inventors stand relative to each other in idea space matters as much for growth as how many of them there are.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用神经网络语言模型分析1836-2023年超1100万份美国专利，发现近两个世纪以来美国发明之间的相似性持续下降，并构建了空间竞争模型来解释这一现象及其对生产率的影响。
AI.research_question: 美国发明之间的相似性随时间如何变化？这种变化背后的机制是什么？对研究生产率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 已有研究对发明是否趋同或发散存在争议，因为不同的文本表征方法可能得出相反结论。需要建立系统的验证框架来准确测量发明相似性的变化趋势，并解释其经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间竞争模型（Spatial Competition Model）：发明者在思想空间中选择位置；知识溢出强度、创新步长和研究生产率从固定的外生变量转变为发明者定位的内生结果。
AI.method: 使用经过验证的神经语言模型分析1100多万份美国专利（1836-2023年）的完整权利要求文本。通过专利干扰率（下降98%）进行交叉验证。构建并校准空间竞争模型进行机制分析。
AI.findings: 1) 美国发明相似性持续下降（"分散化"）；2) 专利干扰率下降98%；3) 空间竞争模型解释了R&D投入增加、专利价值上升、知识溢出减弱、研究生产率下降等现象；4) 空间力量解释了约40%的美国长期研究生产率下降。
AI.theory_contributions: 将知识溢出强度、创新步长和研究生产率从外生参数转化为发明者定位决策的内生结果，建立了空间竞争的理论框架来解释多个独立现象之间的内在联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了发明者在思想空间中的相对位置与数量同样重要，为理解研究生产率下降提供了新视角（约40%来自空间力量），对创新政策和R&D资源配置具有启示意义。

title: Volatility Disagreement in the Options Market
affiliations: Georgetown University - McDonough School of Business, Yale SOM and

detail.title: Volatility Disagreement in the Options Market
detail.abstract:
