We construct a novel stock-level measure of volatility disagreement as the cross-sectional dispersion of realized variance forecasts built from heterogeneous information sets and machine learning models. Sorting single-name delta-hedged straddles on this measure yields a long-short return of −5.14% per month, robust to known option return predictors and not subsumed by disagreement about first moments or the variance risk premium. A one-standard-deviation increase in volatility disagreement is associated with a 30% rise in option position opening. The cross-sectional patterns of our disagreement measure align with recent theoretical advances of beliefs and pricing of variance claims. Evidence on attention, ownership, and arbitrage costs is more consistent with mispricing than risk compensation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个基于机器学习异质信息集的股票层面波动率分歧度量，发现该度量能显著预测期权收益（多空组合月收益-5.14%），且与期权持仓量正相关，支持错误定价解释。
AI.research_question: 股票层面的波动率分歧如何度量，以及它对期权收益和交易行为有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注投资者对股票收益率（一阶矩）的分歧，但对波动率（二阶矩）分歧的研究较少；同时缺乏一个有效的股票层面波动率分歧度量来检验理论预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于异质信念理论、方差索取权的定价理论、以及错误定价与风险补偿的竞争性解释框架。
AI.method: 利用异质信息集和机器学习模型构建已实现方差预测的横截面离散度作为波动率分歧度量；进行投资组合排序分析（多空组合）、横截面回归、以及期权持仓量分析。
AI.findings: （1）波动率分歧高的股票，其delta对冲跨式期权组合的收益显著为负（月收益-5.14%）；（2）该效应不能被已知的期权收益预测因子、一阶矩分歧或方差风险溢价所解释；（3）波动率分歧增加一个标准差，期权持仓量增加30%；（4）横截面模式与最新理论一致；（5）证据支持错误定价解释而非风险补偿解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次构建了股票层面的波动率分歧度量，为异质信念与方差索取权定价的理论提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为期权交易者提供了新的预测因子和交易策略（做空高波动率分歧股票的期权）；揭示了波动率分歧对期权市场流动性和持仓行为的影响。

title: Life Insurance as a Random Variable: Path Enumeration and The Probability Distribution of the NPV
affiliations: Polytechnic University of Valencia

detail.title: Life Insurance as a Random Variable: Path Enumeration and The Probability Distribution of the NPV

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study. The research is purely mathematical and does not involve human participants, animal subjects, or personal data; all numerical illustrations use the published Illustrative Life Table (Bowers et al., 1997).
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The present value of the future net liabilities of a life insurance contract is a random variable, not a scalar. This paper constructs its exact probability distribution by path enumeration: the direct sum over all admissible trajectories, each with its deterministic discounted cash flow and its probability. The method completely separates the biometric component of the policy from its financial mechanics, so that both can be modelled independently. For an individual contract with a single transition to a terminal state we obtain, in continuous time, the exact density of the net present value (NPV), and we show that its mean is the classical prospective reserve: the usual actuarial valuation is thereby characterized as the first moment of that distribution. Discretizing time leads to the path enumeration algorithm, which operates directly on the mortality table and yields the complete NPV distribution of any finite-horizon multistate contract; from it, all moments, quantiles and risk measures are read off without further computation. Again, its mean coincides with the value given by classical actuarial mathematics. An endowment contract with a life annuity illustrates the method: the classical reserve is confirmed as the mean, the standard deviation is 32% of the total nominal premiums, and the 99.5% Solvency II VaR exceeds sixteen annual premiums. In addition, the explicit form of the NPV density under Gompertz-Makeham mortality is derived.

AI.tldr: 本文通过路径枚举方法构建了人寿保险合同未来净负债的精确概率分布，将生物计量成分与财务机制完全分离，证明了经典精算准备金是该分布的一阶矩，并通过 endowment 合同示例展示了其标准差和偿付能力风险度量。
AI.research_question: 如何构造人寿保险合同未来净负债（NPV）的精确概率分布？
AI.motivation: 人寿保险合同的未来净负债是随机变量而非标量，传统精算仅给出期望值（准备金），缺乏完整的分布信息，无法全面评估风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 路径枚举法（path enumeration）、概率分布理论、精算数学、随机现金流折现
AI.method: 路径枚举法：对所有可行轨迹进行直接求和，每条轨迹具有确定的折现现金流及其概率。连续时间下推导NPV精确密度，离散时间下基于生命表实现算法。
AI.findings: 经典精算准备金是NPV分布的一阶矩；标准 endowment 合同的标准差为总名义保费的32%；99.5% Solvency II VaR超过16年年保费；导出了Gompertz-Makeham死亡率下的NPV密度显式形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了人寿保险NPV的完整概率分布理论，将精算估值（准备金）定位为该分布的一阶矩，为风险度量提供了完整的分布基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可直接基于生命表运行的路径枚举算法，能直接计算任意有限 horizons 多状态合同的所有矩、分位数和风险度量，支持Solvency II等偿付能力评估。

title: Who Wants to Break Up Big Firms? Harm, Fairness, and the Demand for Antitrust
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) and

detail.title: Who Wants to Break Up Big Firms? Harm, Fairness, and the Demand for Antitrust
detail.abstract:
The rise of superstar firms has made dominant companies central to modern economic life, and antitrust enforcement is one of the main policy tools for regulating their market power. Public opinion can shape the political and regulatory environment in which antitrust enforcement takes place, yet there is little direct evidence on what drives these preferences. We conduct a pre-registered information-provision experiment with 4,000 American households. Respondents were told about one of five real antitrust cases and randomly assigned to information treatments designed to study four potential drivers of support for antitrust enforcement: perceived market share, perceived consumer harm, perceived unfair competition, and perceived negative image. All four treatments moved the beliefs they were designed to affect, but their effects on demand for antitrust differed sharply. Information about consumer harm had the most systematic effects: it increased plaintiff support and support for break-up and conduct remedies, with effects remaining visible one month later, and also spilled over to broader support for antitrust policies. By contrast, and contrary to expert forecasts, information about market share had no meaningful effect on demand for antitrust enforcement. The findings suggest that the public thinks like economists in one key respect: they do not care about market share per se, but respond instead to consumer harm. One factor outside the core economic framework, perceived unfair competition, also matters, though its effects are more limited in scope. We discuss implications for policymakers and regulators.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项针对4000个美国家庭的信息提供实验，研究了公众反垄断执法偏好的驱动因素。研究发现，消费者损害信息最能系统性地影响公众对反垄断的支持，而市场占有率信息几乎没有效果。公众更关注消费者伤害而非市场份额本身，同时感知到的公平竞争也会产生影响。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素驱动公众对反垄断执法的支持？具体考察市场占有率、消费者损害、不公平竞争和负面形象四个潜在驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 超级明星企业的崛起使主导公司成为现代经济生活的核心，反垄断执法是监管其市场力量的主要政策工具。公众舆论可以影响反垄断执法的政治和监管环境，但关于什么驱动这些偏好的直接证据很少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公众对反垄断支持的经济学与行为经济学理论，考察市场占有率、消费者损害、不公平竞争和负面形象四个潜在机制。
AI.method: 预注册信息提供实验（信息实验），对4000个美国家庭进行调查，随机分配告知一个真实反垄断案例中的五个案例之一，并随机接受四种信息处理之一。
AI.findings: 1）所有四种处理都改变了它们旨在影响的信念；2）消费者损害信息效果最系统：增加了原告支持和拆分、行为补救措施支持，效果在一个月后仍然可见，并溢出到更广泛的反垄断政策支持；3）与专家预测相反，市场占有率信息对反垄断执法需求没有有意义的影响；4）公众在某些方面像经济学家一样思考：不关心市场份额本身，而是对消费者损害做出反应；5）核心经济框架之外的因素——感知到的不公平竞争也重要，但影响范围有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了公众反垄断偏好的驱动机制，表明公众"像经济学家一样思考"——关注消费者损害而非市场份额本身，同时也关注不公平竞争等非经济因素，丰富了反垄断政治经济学和行为公共政策理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管者提供实证依据：消费者损害信息是塑造公众反垄断支持的最有效沟通策略；市场占有率信息效果甚微；应关注不公平竞争感知的影响。

title: What is the status of integration of rehabilitation and assistive technology into national strategies in the WHO European Region? A descriptive cross-sectional study
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Lucerne, University of Lucerne, University of Lucerne, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Lucerne

detail.title: What is the status of integration of rehabilitation and assistive technology into national strategies in the WHO European Region? A descriptive cross-sectional study
detail.abstract: Background: Integrating rehabilitation and assistive technologies (AT) into national health strategies is essential to achieving equitable, effective, and sustainable health systems and to achieve Universal Health Coverage.,Objectives: To identify and document the current status of integration of rehabilitation and AT into national strategies and to analyze the integration in available strategy documents.,Methods: This descriptive cross-sectional study collected quantitative and qualitative data. All 53 WHO/Europe member states were invited to participate in an online survey regarding the integration of rehabilitation and AT into their national strategies and were asked to provide related policy documents for analysis. Descriptive analysis was conducted on the quantitative data, while thematic analysis was applied to the free-text responses and the analysed documents.,Result: 39 survey responses were received from 27 countries. Of these, 18 countries reported that rehabilitation is integrated into a national strategy, seven indicated it is not, and four were uncertain. AT integration was reported in 15 countries, with five reporting no integration. Overall, 39 documents from 16 countries were eligible for analysis and comprised five document types: strategies (n=12), strategic frameworks and policy proposals (n=4), action plans (n=9), situation assessments (n=9) and programs (n=5).,Conclusion: Findings reveal limited integration of rehabilitation and AT, hindered by low policymaker awareness and a lack of leadership. Existing strategy documents offer models for integration, and the study provides recommendations to inform policy, support advocacy, and guide resource use.

AI.tldr: 本文通过调查53个WHO/欧洲成员国，发现康复和辅助技术在国家战略中的整合程度有限，主要障碍包括政策制定者认知不足和缺乏领导力。
AI.research_question: 康复和辅助技术在国家卫生战略中的整合现状如何？现有战略文件中的整合情况如何分析？
AI.motivation: 将康复和辅助技术整合到国家卫生战略中对于实现公平、有效、可持续的卫生系统和全民健康覆盖至关重要，但目前缺乏对整合现状的系统性了解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合康复与辅助技术到国家卫生战略的理论框架，基于WHO/欧洲成员国的政策分析与评估。
AI.method: 描述性横断面研究，收集定量和定性数据。通过在线问卷调查53个WHO/欧洲成员国，并收集相关政策文件进行主题分析。
AI.findings: 27个国家回复，18国报告康复已整合入国家战略，15国报告辅助技术已整合。分析了来自16个国家的39份文件，包括战略、行动计划和项目等五种类型。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统揭示了康复和辅助技术在国家战略层面的整合现状及其障碍因素（政策制定者认知不足和缺乏领导力），为政策整合理论提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了促进康复和辅助技术整合的具体建议，支持倡导工作并指导资源分配，有助于推动全民健康覆盖目标的实现。

title: From Extraction to Continuity: Circular Material Governance, and Precision Resource Stewardship in NewVistas
affiliations: Quaid-i-Azam University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Extraction to Continuity: Circular Material Governance, and Precision Resource Stewardship in NewVistas
detail.abstract: This paper formalizes Agency 22, Materials, as the constitutional standards governor of long-term raw-material continuity within the NewVistas LAW/PLAT system. Unlike conventional resource regimes that prioritize extraction volume, commodity exports, speculative ownership, or centralized mining scale, Agency 22 is designed to preserve the physical material base required for buildings, utilities, transportation systems, manufacturing, robotics, server infrastructure, fuel-cell systems, polymers, glass, cement tiles, stainless steel components, and steward enterprises. Its purpose is not to maximize mining, but to secure resilient material continuity for a cooperating of approximately fifty communities and five million people. The paper develops a recovery-first framework in which material demand is governed through the hierarchy of reuse, repair, remanufacture, recovery, recycling, substitution, precision extraction, and balanced strategic import. Waste streams are treated as artificial ore deposits, including stainless steel scrap, copper, aluminum, electronics, batteries, catalysts, polymers, glass, obsolete machinery, fuel-cell components, and precision equipment. As recovered and recycled supply expands, required primary extraction declines, extending the effective material horizon. Where virgin extraction becomes necessary, Agency 22 favors precision methods over mass excavation. The paper emphasizes PCD drilling, directional drilling, drill-and-ream systems, robotic extraction, remote operation, surface-based human supervision, digital hole records, assay records, material passports, and backfill documentation as alternatives to open-pit mining, drill-and-blast systems, and hazardous underground labor. Extraction becomes admissible only when tied to TOK-validated physical demand, binding off-take, safety certification, Agency 22 standards, and digital proof. The paper also preserves NewVistas constitutional boundaries. Agency 22 does not own resources, operate mines, finance equipment, hold custody, trade commodities, accumulate reserves, or collect transition funds. Title, finance, custody, execution, accounting, proof, and audit remain separated across the proper NewVistas rails. The result is a no-reserve, no-deficit, contractor-executed, recovery-first material governance system that transforms raw materials from speculative commodities into long-horizon civilizational continuity assets.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化了NewVistas LAW/PLAT系统中的Agency 22（材料署），将其作为长期原材料连续性的宪政标准治理机构。该机构采用"回收优先"框架，将废物流视为人工矿藏，通过优先使用回收材料减少原生开采，仅在必要时采用精密钻探等精准方法替代露天采矿。Agency 22不拥有资源、不运营矿山、不持有资产，通过分离所有权、融资、执行、审计等职能，将原材料从投机商品转变为文明延续性资产。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个宪政层级的材料治理系统，以确保约50个社区、500万人口的合作体在长期内获得物理材料的连续供应，同时避免传统资源体制中的投机、过度开采和安全问题？
AI.motivation: 传统资源体制以开采量、商品出口、投机所有权和集中化采矿规模为优先，导致资源枯竭、环境破坏、劳工安全隐患，且无法保障长期材料安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宪政治理理论、回收优先层级框架、人工矿藏概念、精密提取方法论、职能分离原则、代际公平理论。
AI.method: 规范分析/制度设计研究，通过形式化治理规则、流程层级和职能边界来构建治理系统。
AI.findings: 提出了一个"无储备、无赤字、承包商执行、回收优先"的材料治理系统，通过回收供应扩大减少原生开采需求，通过精密方法替代破坏性开采，通过职能分离防止权力滥用，实现了原材料从投机商品到文明延续性资产的转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"材料宪政主义"概念，将材料治理提升至宪政层级；提出了"人工矿藏"理论，重新定义废物流的经济和战略价值；发展了"回收优先"与"精密提取"相结合的整合性材料治理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NewVistas系统提供了可操作的材料治理制度设计，包括废物流分类管理、PCD钻探等精密提取技术规范、TOK验证的需求绑定机制、以及所有权、融资、执行、审计分离的治理架构。

title: Mapping of National Laws, Collective Agreements and Jurisprudence Concerning Work-Related Psychosocial Risks, Workplace Bullying and Work-related Stress in the EU27
affiliations: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI), Nottingham University Business School and Lancaster University

detail.title: Mapping of National Laws, Collective Agreements and Jurisprudence Concerning Work-Related Psychosocial Risks, Workplace Bullying and Work-related Stress in the EU27

publicationDetails.journalName: European Trade Union Institute (ETUI) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: There have been numerous changes in the European world of work in recent decades. The globalisation of markets, deindustrialisation and expansion of the tertiary sector are some of the shifts that have contributed to profound changes in the nature of work and the environment in which it is performed. Alongside these changes work-related psychosocial risks (PSR) have been exacerbated. This development has been subject to increasing attention in the public debate, in research and in policy responses, at both the European and the national level.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了欧洲工作领域近几十年的变化（全球化、去工业化、第三产业扩张）如何加剧了工作相关的心理社会风险（PSR），并指出这一发展在公共讨论、研究和政策层面（欧洲和国家层面）受到越来越多的关注。
AI.research_question: 欧洲工作领域的变化如何影响工作相关心理社会风险（PSR）的加剧，以及这些风险在公共、研究和政策层面的关注度演变。
AI.motivation: 近几十年欧洲工作性质和工作环境发生深刻变化，工作相关心理社会风险不断加剧，需要引起学界、公众和政策制定者的重视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工作相关心理社会风险（PSR）理论；工作环境变化与职业健康关系理论。
AI.method: 文献综述/理论分析（基于摘要内容，未详细说明具体方法）。
AI.findings: 全球化、去工业化和第三产业扩张等变化加剧了工作相关的心理社会风险；这些风险在欧洲和国家的公共讨论、研究和政策回应中受到日益增加的关注。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统梳理了宏观社会经济变化（全球化、去工业化、第三产业扩张）与工作相关心理社会风险加剧之间的关联。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲及各国政策制定者、企业管理者关注和应对工作相关心理社会风险提供了背景分析和方向指引。

reference: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 78
title: Too much of a Good Thing? Safe Assets, Spillovers, and Fiscal Policy Coordination
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), European Stability Mechanism, Banca d'Italia and European Stability Mechanism

detail.title: Too much of a Good Thing? Safe Assets, Spillovers, and Fiscal Policy Coordination

publicationDetails.detailsText: European Stability Mechanism Working Paper No. 78
publicationDetails.journalName: European Stability Mechanism (ESM) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Are public debt levels too high and convenience yields too low, or is the opposite true? Safe asset issuers have market power, which incentivises them to restrict issuance to raise the convenience yield earned on foreign-held debt. Yet, these governments also tend to over-issue, failing to internalise the fiscal cost they impose abroad by lowering demand for other countries’ bonds and, thus, their convenience yields. We develop a model of financially integrated economies and show analytically that the relative strength of these opposing incentives depends on public expenditure (which exacerbates the fiscal externality) and bond substitutability (which reduces governments’ bond market power). Calibrating the model to the euro area over the period 2015-2023, we find the fiscal externality to dominate: non-cooperative governments that ignore spillovers issue too much debt, on the order of 5% of GDP, compared to a cooperative benchmark. Introducing common debt mitigates the market power distortion, but exacerbates the fiscal externality and can thus improve the non-cooperative equilibrium when market power is the dominant distortion.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了公共债务水平与便利收益之间的关系。主权债务发行国既有利用市场力量限制发行以提高便利收益的动机，也存在过度发行以获取财政利益的外部性。作者构建了金融一体化经济体模型，并以2015-2023年欧元区数据进行校准，发现财政外部性占主导地位——非合作政府比合作基准多发行约5% GDP的债务。共同债务（如欧元区共同债券）可以缓解市场力量扭曲，但在市场力量是主要扭曲时才能改善非合作均衡。
AI.research_question: 公共债务水平是否过高？便利收益是否过低？主权债券发行国在非合作博弈中倾向于限制发行还是过度发行？
AI.motivation: 现实中主权债务发行国同时面临两种相反激励：作为安全资产发行者拥有市场力量（限制发行以提高便利收益），以及忽视对他国债券需求负面影响的财政外部性（过度发行）。需要厘清哪种力量占主导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融一体化经济体模型，包含市场力量（垄断定价）和财政外部性（跨境溢出）两种扭曲的理论框架。
AI.method: 理论建模，推导均衡条件；数值校准，使用2015-2023年欧元区数据。
AI.findings: 财政外部性占主导地位：非合作政府比合作基准多发行约5% GDP的债务。公共支出加剧财政外部性，债券替代性降低政府债券市场力量。共同债务虽缓解市场力量扭曲但加剧财政外部性，仅当市场力量是主要扭曲时才改善非合作均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了主权债券发行的市场力量效应与财政外部性效应，揭示了两种相反激励的相对强度取决于公共支出和债券替代性两个关键参数。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧元区债务治理提供政策启示：非合作导致过度发行（约5% GDP），引入共同债务需谨慎评估其净福利效应。

title: Restricted Correlation Framework (RCF): A Licensing Protocol and Technical System for Protecting Software Methodology from AI Extraction

detail.title: Restricted Correlation Framework (RCF): A Licensing Protocol and Technical System for Protecting Software Methodology from AI Extraction
detail.abstract: We present the Restricted Correlation Framework (RCF), a licensing protocol and technical system designed to protect software methodology from extraction by large language models (LLMs) and automated analysis systems. Existing open-source licenses-MIT, Apache 2.0, GPL-were designed before LLMs existed. They regulate copying and distribution but provide no mechanism to address a new class of intellectual property threat: the correlation and replication of methodology through AI training, where not a single original token need survive the translation between programming languages. RCF introduces three contributions. First, a legal layer: the RCF-PL license distinguishes Visibility rights (reading, auditing) from Usage rights (replication, AI training), establishing a licensing primitive absent from existing frameworks. Second, a mathematical layer: surprisal-weighted correlation over Program Dependence Graphs (PDGs), a language-invariant representation that survives translation between programming languages. Third, a proof layer: p-value and E-value statistics analogous to BLAST in bioinformatics, turning similarity scores into court-grade evidence of shared origin. We define a closed semantic alphabet Sigma that every language normalizer must implement, making cross-language fingerprinting possible by construction. We describe the methodology canary-a designed, functionally-neutral idiosyncrasy that serves as near-zero false-positive evidence of methodology extraction. RCF is implemented as an open-source TypeScript and Python package with 1,362+ npm downloads and active deployment in production systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出受限关联框架（RCF），一种旨在保护软件方法论不被大语言模型（LLM）和自动化分析系统提取的许可协议与技术系统。RCF包含法律层（RCF-PL许可，区分可见权与使用权）、数学层（基于程序依赖图的惊异度加权关联）和证明层（借鉴生物信息学的p值和E值统计），并引入"方法学金丝雀"作为方法论提取的近乎零误报证据。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种新的许可协议和技术系统，以保护软件方法论不被LLM和自动化分析系统通过跨语言关联与复制的方式提取？
AI.motivation: 现有开源许可证（MIT、Apache 2.0、GPL）设计于LLM出现之前，仅规范复制和分发，无法应对AI训练中通过跨语言翻译（不保留任何原始token）对软件方法论进行关联和复制的新型知识产权威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: RCF框架：法律层（RCF-PL许可，区分可见权与使用权）、数学层（程序依赖图PDG上的惊异度加权关联，实现语言无关表示）、证明层（借鉴BLAST的p值和E值统计，将相似度分数转化为法庭级证据）。
AI.method: 提出三个贡献层：1) 法律层：RCF-PL许可，定义可见权与使用权的分离；2) 数学层：基于程序依赖图（PDG）的惊异度加权关联，跨语言不变表示；3) 证明层：p值和E值统计，量化方法论提取的证据强度。定义封闭语义字母表Σ，要求所有语言归一化器实现。引入"方法学金丝雀"作为低误报检测机制。实现为开源TypeScript和Python包。
AI.findings: RCF已在生产系统中部署，npm下载量超过1362次。通过定义封闭语义字母表，使得跨语言指纹识别成为可能。方法学金丝雀能够提供近乎零误报的方法论提取证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了一种全新的知识产权保护框架，将可见权与使用权分离，填补了现有许可证在AI训练场景下的理论空白。2) 将生物信息学中的BLAST统计方法（p值和E值）引入软件方法论提取检测领域。3) 定义了跨语言不变的语义表示方法（基于PDG的惊异度加权关联），解决了代码指纹的语义不变性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供了可直接部署的RCF-PL许可证文本，为软件开发者和企业提供了保护方法论不被AI训练提取的法律工具。2) 开发并发布了开源TypeScript和Python实现包（npm下载1362+次），已在生产系统中使用。3) 提出了"方法学金丝雀"这一实用检测机制，可高置信度检测方法论提取行为。

title: Role of Higher Education Institutions in Promoting Green Communities

detail.title: Role of Higher Education Institutions in Promoting Green Communities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No declaration
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics
declarations.funderStatement: No funded

detail.abstract: Higher Education Institutions (HELs) plays an important role in evolving environmentally responsible citizens and developing the sustainable practices within society. HELs possess the potential to influence attitudes, behaviors and sustainable decision-making through knowledge creation, policy development and community engagement. The paper explores the contribution of HELs for the development of green communities by curriculum integration, campus sustainability initiatives, research innovations, outreach projects and student participation. Taking over the insights from global and national practices, the study emphasizes the transformative role of universities and college in strengthening the ecological awareness. Finally, the paper deals with a strategic, multi stakeholder approach within HELs that accelerates significantly the transition on environmentally conscious societies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了高等教育机构（HELs）通过课程整合、校园可持续计划、研究创新、外展项目和学生参与等方式，在建设绿色社区中的贡献，强调多利益相关者战略方法可加速向环境友好型社会转型。
AI.research_question: 高等教育机构如何通过课程整合、校园可持续计划、研究创新、外展项目和学生参与来促进绿色社区的建设？
AI.motivation: 高等教育机构在培养环境负责任公民和发展社会可持续实践方面具有重要潜力，但需要系统性地梳理其具体贡献路径和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展教育理论、多利益相关者治理理论、生态意识培育理论
AI.method: 基于全球和国家实践的文献综述与案例研究分析
AI.findings: 高等教育机构通过课程整合、校园可持续运营、研究创新、社区外展和学生参与等多维路径，能够有效促进绿色社区建设；采用多利益相关者战略方法可显著加速环境友好型社会的转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化了高等教育机构促进绿色社区建设的理论路径框架，强调了多利益相关者协同在可持续发展转型中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构制定可持续发展战略提供了实践指导，包括课程设计、校园管理、研究方向和社区参与等方面的具体建议。

reference: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 26-10
title: Intergenerational Mobility in Late Qing Dynasty: Evidence from Northeast China
affiliations: University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility, University of Chicago - Stone Center for Research on Wealth Inequality and Mobility and New Economic School (NES)

detail.title: Intergenerational Mobility in Late Qing Dynasty: Evidence from Northeast China

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 26-10
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines intergenerational mobility across social classes during the late Qing dynasty employing a remarkable data set from Liaoning province in Northeast China. We identify two distinct epochs with markedly different mobility dynamics. Before 1850, mobility patterns exhibited stability and convergence toward a steady state. The second epoch, beginning around 1850, was characterized by unstable intergenerational class dynamics that persisted until the dynasty's collapse. The transition between epochs coincides with the Opium Wars and Taiping Rebellion, demonstrating how the footprints of major crises in the late Qing era can be traced in mobility dynamics. Employing Markov-chain measures and two alternative mobility conceptsthe persistence of class origin across generations and intergenerational class movement-we document that intergenerational mobility increased over the period. However, this aggregate increase masked a decline in upward mobility alongside a rise in downward mobility-disparate patterns that resonate with broader theories of political instability.

AI.tldr: 本文利用辽宁数据集研究晚清社会阶级间的代际流动，发现1850年前后存在两个截然不同的时期：前期稳定趋近稳态，后期因鸦片战争和太平天国运动等重大危机影响，代际流动性增加，但向上流动减少、向下流动增加，与政治不稳定理论相呼应。
AI.research_question: 晚清时期中国社会各阶级间的代际流动性如何变化？重大历史危机（如鸦片战争、太平天国运动）如何影响代际流动模式？
AI.motivation: 理解重大历史危机对代际流动和社会结构的影响，以及晚清社会流动性与其政治崩溃之间的关联。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际流动理论、马尔可夫链分析方法、政治不稳定理论
AI.method: 利用辽宁数据集，采用马尔可夫链测度方法，分析阶级起源的持续性和代际阶级流动两个维度的流动性变化。
AI.findings: （1）1850年前代际流动稳定并收敛于稳态；（2）1850年后代际阶级动态不稳定并持续至清朝灭亡；（3）总体代际流动性增加；（4）但向上流动减少、向下流动增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 将重大历史危机与代际流动模式的转变联系起来，揭示总体流动性增加可能掩盖向上/向下流动的不对称变化，为政治不稳定理论提供历史证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解危机时期的代际不平等和社会流动性变化提供历史视角，对当代社会应对重大危机时的流动性政策具有启示意义。

title: The Struggle Between The Geographical Indications Act And Lifestyle Industries

detail.title: The Struggle Between The Geographical Indications Act And Lifestyle Industries
detail.abstract: India is in a very strange and paradoxical place in the global panorama of cultural appropriation of Intellectual Property. It is a repository of civilisations that showcases cultural diversity in a staggering manner, with hundreds of different weaving techniques, metallurgical crafts, performing art forms and material cultural practices, many of which are the sole inheritance of the specific tribal and artisanal communities but the major piece of legislation under which the Indian state claims to safeguard these expressions in the commercial domain, the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act 1999, was not a law for cultural protection, but rather a trade law statute, shaped by India's obligations under Article 22 of the Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS). It is neither from the loops of Kutch nor the dhokra furnaces of Bastar but from the vineyards of Bordeaux and the cheese caves of Parma. This paper argues that that structural origin story is not incidental, it is determinative of the Act's limitations. It is pertinent to mention that the GI Act, 1999 is structurally inadequate.

AI.tldr: 本文指出印度1999年《地理标志法》本质上是一部贸易法而非文化保护法，其源自TRIPS协议的结构性起源导致该法在保护传统文化表达方面存在根本性缺陷。
AI.research_question: 印度《地理标志法》的结构性起源如何决定了其在保护传统文化表达方面的局限性？
AI.motivation: 印度拥有丰富的非物质文化遗产（如织造技艺、手工艺、表演艺术等），但主要保护立法《地理标志法》并非为文化保护而设计，而是源自TRIPS协议的贸易法框架，这一结构性矛盾导致保护效果不佳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权法结构性分析；TRIPS协议与传统文化保护的关系；地理标志制度的贸易法本质与文化保护需求之间的张力。
AI.method: 法律文本分析与结构性论证，追溯印度GI法案的TRIPS协议起源，论证其结构性缺陷。
AI.findings: 印度GI法案源自欧盟葡萄酒和奶酪地理标志保护模式（如波尔多葡萄园、帕尔马奶酪），而非印度本土的文化实践；这种贸易法起源不是偶然的，而是决定性的，导致该法在保护印度部落和 artisan 社区传统文化表达方面结构性不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了知识产权法律的结构性起源对其功能实现的决定性影响，批判了将贸易法工具用于文化保护目的的内在矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似发展中国家改革地理标志制度、制定真正适合传统文化保护的法律框架提供了理论基础和政策启示。

title: Correlated Weights: Partial Pooling for Synthetic Control with Multiple Outcomes
affiliations: Texas Tech University

detail.title: Correlated Weights: Partial Pooling for Synthetic Control with Multiple Outcomes

declarations.ethicsApproval: no patients or participants it's public data, theory and computer code

detail.abstract: A study that applies the synthetic control method to several outcomes faces an unacknowledged choice. Fit each outcome its own donor weights, or impose one common set on all of them. The right answer often lies between the two, and this paper makes the middle ground available. The estimator gives each outcome its own weights while penalizing their dispersion around a common centroid, so that the penalty lambda spans a family with existing practice at its corners, with separate fits at lambda = 0 and common weights at lambda = infinity. Because short pre-treatment panels make cross-validation brittle, no single lambda is selected. The estimator aggregates across the family with exponential weights earned by leave-one-out prediction. Aggregation stabilizes estimation and yields the paper's central diagnostic, the mass profile, the data's own answer to how much the outcomes share donor structure. Regret theory caps the price of aggregating and characterizes when the interior's guarantee undercuts both corners'. Placebo inference reruns the entire pipeline, tuning included, in every permutation. Python and Stata implementations accompany the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种介于"各结果变量独立赋权"与"所有结果变量共用一套权重"之间的合成控制方法，通过惩罚权重分散性、指数聚合与留一法预测，实现多结果变量的稳健估计，并给出核心诊断工具——质量剖面。
AI.research_question: 在合成控制法中，面对多个结果变量时，应选择各自独立赋权还是统一赋权？如何找到介于两者之间的最优方案？
AI.motivation: 现有合成控制法在处理多个结果变量时，面临一个未被充分认识的选择困境：独立赋权可能过拟合，统一赋权可能欠拟合，缺乏中间路径。短预处理面板数据使交叉验证不稳定，亟需一种稳健的折中方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 惩罚最小二乘（惩罚权重围绕公共质心的离散程度）、指数加权聚合、遗憾理论（regret theory）
AI.method: 提出一种正则化合成控制方法：为每个结果变量分配独立权重，同时惩罚各权重围绕公共质心的离散程度（惩罚参数λ控制折中程度）；使用留一法预测的指数权重聚合所有λ下的估计结果，而非选择单一λ；采用安慰剂检验（permutation-based placebo inference）进行推断。
AI.findings: 聚合估计比选择单一λ更稳定；核心诊断工具"质量剖面"（mass profile）能反映数据本身对"各结果共享多少供体结构"的回答；遗憾理论证明聚合的代价有上限，且中间路径（λ∈(0,∞)）的保证优于两个极端（λ=0或∞）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统处理多结果变量合成控制中的赋权选择问题，提出连续谱系的折中框架；引入遗憾理论为聚合估计提供理论保障；提出质量剖面作为数据驱动的诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供Python和Stata的实现代码；为实证研究者提供可直接使用的稳健估计方法；质量剖面帮助研究者判断不同结果变量是否共享相似的供体结构。

title: Foreign Direct Investments in EAEU Member States in 2025
affiliations: Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy

detail.title: Foreign Direct Investments in EAEU Member States in 2025

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not require ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: Gaidar Institute funded this research paper

detail.abstract: In 2025, a trend toward the recovery of inward and outward foreign direct investment (FDI) flows in the Eurasian region became apparent following a significant decline since 2022 (primarily due to the imposition of Western sanctions). Starting in 2022, the geography of outbound FDI from EAEU countries changed substantially. In particular, FDI flows expanded considerably to the UAE, Serbia, China, Uzbekistan, India, and Turkey. At the same time, a pattern of country-specific specialization has emerged for Eurasian outbound FDI: the UAE and Turkey have become major trade and financial hubs, while China and India have become manufacturing and energy partners. The share of mutual investment among EAEU countries remains at around 4% of total FDI

AI.tldr: 2025年欧亚地区FDI流动态势分析：从2022年制裁导致的下降中复苏，EAEU国家对外FDI地理分布发生重大变化，阿联酋、土耳其成为贸易金融中心，中国、印度成为制造业能源伙伴，EAEU内部相互投资仅占4%。
AI.research_question: 欧亚经济联盟（EAEU）国家在西方制裁背景下，其对外直接投资（FDI）的地理分布和行业专业化模式发生了怎样的变化？
AI.motivation: 2022年西方制裁导致欧亚地区FDI大幅下降，但2025年出现复苏趋势，同时FDI地理分布发生显著变化，需要系统性地描述和解析这一结构性转变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际直接投资理论、地缘经济与制裁经济学、区域经济一体化理论。
AI.method: 描述性统计分析，基于FDI流量和地理分布数据的趋势分析。
AI.findings: （1）2025年欧亚地区FDI呈现复苏趋势；（2）EAEU对外FDI地理分布从传统目的地转向阿联酋、塞尔维亚、中国、乌兹别克斯坦、印度和土耳其；（3）形成了国别专业化分工模式：阿联酋和土耳其成为贸易金融枢纽，中国和印度成为制造业和能源伙伴；（4）EAEU内部相互投资仅占总FDI的4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了制裁驱动下区域FDI流向的重构模式，丰富了地缘政治冲击下国际资本流动的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为EAEU国家企业对外投资决策、东道国吸引外资政策制定以及理解制裁对区域经济格局的影响提供实证依据。

title: Speed, Departure Time, and the Peak-Hour Trap: A Bayesian Game of Urban Morning Commuting Under Incomplete Road-State Information
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Speed, Departure Time, and the Peak-Hour Trap: A Bayesian Game of Urban Morning Commuting Under Incomplete Road-State Information

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, in connection with the research presented in this paper. No funding was received for this work from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. Accordingly, ethics approval was not required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper develops a Bayesian game of peak-hour urban commuting in which n commuters simultaneously choose speed v i ∈ [v min , v max ] and departure time τ i ∈ [0, T max ], but do so under incomplete information about the road state : each commuter holds a private prior µ over the crowd density ñ they will encounter at the bottleneck, and the true road state θ = ñ(τ i , τ-i ; δ) is not common knowledge. The departure time δ > 0 denes the temporal proximity window within which two commuters are mutual road users; it is the model's key structural parameter and is shown to be the prediction horizon over which road-state information is decision-relevant. 
We prove ve results. First, v ∗ = vmax is a dominant strategy in speed regardless of prior beliefs (Lemma 1). Second, under the homogeneous prior µ(θ) = 1[θ = n − 1] - the belief that all others depart simultaneously - the unique Bayes-Nash equilibrium in departure time is simultaneous departure τ ∗ i = τ¯ for all i (Theorem 1). Third, under the uninformative prior µ ∼ U[0, n − 1] the Bayes-Nash equilibrium is dispersed departure, achieving the social optimum (Theorem 2). Fourth, the Price of Anarchy PoA = vmax/(vmax − α(n − 1)) measures the welfare cost of the homogeneous prior relative to the social optimum, and diverges at the congestion threshold n ∗ = vmax/α (Theorem 3). Fifth, we derive the Value of Road-State Information VoI - the welfare gain from the state providing commuters with the true road-state distribution before departure - and show VoI = (PoA − 1) · |W∗ |, which equals the full welfare cost of congestion (Theorem 4).
The central implication is normative: peak-hour congestion is not primarily a failure of individual rationality but of the information sets the state makes available to citizens. Commuters are rational agents playing a Harsanyi incompleteinformation game in which the type-relevant information exists, is held by the state, and is not transmitted. This frames the congestion problem as an institutional information failure - a micro-level instance of the inclusive-institutions argument of Acemoglu et al. (2024) - and establishes information provision as the rst-best policy instrument, strictly dominating Pigouvian tolls, road expansion, and mandate-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个贝叶斯博弈模型，研究早高峰通勤者在道路状态信息不完整下的速度和出发时间选择。核心发现：拥堵主要不是个体理性失败，而是政府未能向公民提供道路状态信息所致。信息提供是缓解拥堵的最优政策工具，优于庇古税、道路扩建和行政命令。
AI.research_question: 在不完全信息条件下（通勤者只知道道路状态的先验分布，不知真实拥堵情况），通勤者的速度和出发时间选择如何影响早高峰拥堵？信息提供作为政策工具的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 传统拥堵研究假设通勤者掌握完全信息，但现实中人们对道路状态存在信息不对称。作者试图从信息不完整博弈的角度重新解释高峰期拥堵的成因，并探讨信息提供作为"第一优"政策工具的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Harsanyi不完全信息博弈（贝叶斯博弈）、价格无政府（Price of Anarchy）、道路状态信息价值（Value of Information）、包容性制度理论（Acemoglu et al., 2024）
AI.method: 建立贝叶斯博弈模型，n个通勤者同时选择速度v_i和出发时间τ_i，每个通勤者持有关于道路状态（瓶颈处人群密度）的私人先验分布。模型关键参数为δ（出发时间邻近窗口），定义了多大时间范围内的通勤者互为道路使用者。通过求解不同类型的先验信念下的贝叶斯-纳什均衡，推导出五个定理。
AI.findings: （1）全速行驶是速度选择的占优策略；（2）在同质先验（认为所有人同时出发）下，均衡为同时出发，形成拥堵；（3）在无信息先验（均匀分布）下，出发时间分散化，达到社会最优；（4）价格无政府度量了同质先验相对于社会最优的福利损失，在拥堵阈值处发散；（5）道路状态信息价值等于拥堵的全部福利成本，表明信息提供可以完全消除拥挤损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将拥堵问题重新定义为制度性信息失败——政府掌握道路状态信息但未传递给公民。这是Acemoglu等人（2024）包容性制度论点在微观层面的应用。证明了信息提供是"第一优"政策工具，严格优于庇古税等传统方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通政策制定提供了明确方向：政府应优先投资于道路状态信息的实时采集与公开（如实时拥堵数据、预测信息），而非单纯依赖收费、修路或限行措施。信息提供可以在不增加社会成本的情况下实现帕累托改进。

title: From Search Engines to AI Agents: Interface Control and the Restructuring of Communication Power
affiliations: and University of Southern California - Annenberg School for Communication and Journalism

detail.title: From Search Engines to AI Agents: Interface Control and the Restructuring of Communication Power
detail.abstract: Control over digital interfaces has become a significant aspect of geopolitical struggles. This article advances an analytical framework illuminating how global communication power manifests across three key interfaces: search engines, social media, and AI agents. We articulate the evolution of these interfaces from corporate innovation to an aspect of contested transnational control, and conceptualize how corporate multinationals like Google, Facebook, TikTok, and DeepSeek leverage interface design to consolidate authority while state interventions challenge their market control. Governments seek to instrumentalize or challenge corporate interfaces to advance national goals, while firms strategically align with or resist state agendas to secure market access. The framework articulates how these forces reconfigure relations between information, people, and machines, with implications for the internet's next phase.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个分析框架，揭示全球传播权力如何通过搜索引擎、社交媒体和AI代理三大数字界面展开地缘政治博弈，探讨跨国企业与国家政府之间的权力竞合关系及其对互联网未来形态的影响。
AI.research_question: 全球传播权力如何通过数字界面（搜索引擎、社交媒体、AI代理）在不同行为体（跨国企业与国家政府）之间的博弈中得以体现和重构？
AI.motivation: 数字界面控制已成为地缘政治斗争的重要组成部分，但现有研究缺乏一个统一的分析框架来系统解释跨国企业（如Google、Facebook、TikTok、DeepSeek）与国家政府之间在界面层面的权力博弈及其演变逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球传播权力理论、数字界面政治经济学、地缘政治与跨国企业战略互动理论
AI.method: 概念框架构建与理论分析
AI.findings: （1）数字界面经历了从企业创新到跨国控制对象的演变；（2）跨国企业通过界面设计巩固权力，而政府干预挑战其市场控制；（3）政府试图利用或挑战企业界面以实现国家目标，企业则战略性地配合或抵制政府议程以保障市场准入；（4）这些力量重新配置了信息、人与机器之间的关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合性的数字界面权力分析框架，系统阐释了跨国企业与国家政府之间在界面层面的动态博弈机制，为理解互联网下一阶段的全球传播权力格局提供了理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解数字界面地缘政治竞争的本质提供分析视角，为跨国企业制定全球化战略时平衡商业利益与政治风险提供参考，为公众理解数字界面的权力结构及其社会影响提供认知框架。

title: The Residual Vehicle: Section 503 Enforcement, Federal Contractor Disability Hiring, and the Underutilization of Existing Civil Rights Authority

detail.title: The Residual Vehicle: Section 503 Enforcement, Federal Contractor Disability Hiring, and the Underutilization of Existing Civil Rights Authority
detail.abstract: Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973 requires federal contractors with contracts exceeding ten thousand dollars to take affirmative action to employ and advance qualified individuals with disabilities. Federal contractors with fifty or more employees and contracts of fifty thousand dollars or more must maintain written affirmative action programs. The Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) enforces. Section 503 is the residual civil rights vehicle for federal contractor employment of disabled workers because federal procurement contracts are excluded from Section 504’s reach by regulation and Department of Justice interpretive guidance. The statute has been in force for more than fifty years. Its enforcement at major federal contractors with substantial documented disability hiring programs has been inconsistent, with extended periods of administrative inattention at companies that publicly advertise disability hiring as a corporate social responsibility commitment. This Article documents the enforcement gap, identifies its structural causes (the limited private right of action, the narrow remedial scope, OFCCP resource constraints, and prosecutorial discretion across administrations), and proposes resolution through administrative reform and prosecutorial priority within existing statutory authority. Walmart Inc. serves as the principal case study because its dual role as federal procurement contractor and large-scale employer of workers with intellectual and developmental disabilities is unusually transparent on the public record. The Article does not propose new civil rights legislation. The statutory and regulatory authority needed to close the enforcement gap already exists. What is needed is the institutional will to use it.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了《康复法案》第503条在联邦承包商残疾人雇佣执法中的"执行差距"，以沃尔玛为案例，分析了结构性原因（私人诉权有限、救济范围狭窄、OFCCP资源约束、行政裁量权变化），并提出在现有法律框架内通过行政改革和优先执法来弥合差距，无需新立法。
AI.research_question: 为什么联邦承包商在残疾人雇佣方面的第503条执法存在"执行差距"？如何在不制定新立法的情况下弥合这一差距？
AI.motivation: 《康复法案》第503条已实施超过50年，但执法严重不一致：一些公开宣称残疾人雇佣为CSR承诺的大型联邦承包商长期未受有效监管，形成了法律"有规定但无执行"的空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 残障公民权利法律框架、行政执法与裁量权理论、私人诉权与公共执法的互补/替代关系。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析+案例研究（以沃尔玛为主要案例，因其双重角色——联邦承包商与智力和发育障碍者的大型雇主——且信息高度公开）。
AI.findings: 503条执法存在系统性"执行差距"，成因包括：私人诉权受限、OFCCP资源不足、救济范围狭窄、不同政府时期行政裁量权变化。沃尔玛案例显示，即使企业公开宣传残疾人雇佣CSR，执法也长期缺位。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统化识别并归因了残障就业平权法律执行中的结构性障碍，揭示了"法律文本-企业承诺-实际执法"三者之间的脱节。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出不依赖新立法、在现有法定权限内通过行政改革和优先执法即可弥合差距的具体路径，对政策制定者和监管机构具有直接指导意义。

reference: Sri Lankan Journal of Agricultural Economics, Volume 10, 2012
title: Food Security as a Public Good: Oman's Prospects
affiliations: Sultan Qaboos University

detail.title: Food Security as a Public Good: Oman's Prospects

publicationDetails.detailsText: Sri Lankan Journal of Agricultural Economics, Volume 10, 2012

detail.abstract:
The recent phenomenal crisis in the financial sector and the surge in food prices have resurrected the debate on the role of government, in economic management and in particular in securing national food security. This paper briefly reviews the theoretical literature in favor of government intervention in the market to secure food security. It is argued that food security needs to be considered as a public good, hence justifying government intervention in supplying it. Sustaining the potential to domestically produce safe minimum amounts of a staple food should be considered as a national strategic objective to achieve food security.

Wheat is a staple food in Oman and it has been a major crop in the farming systems of Oman. Wheat cultivation under present circumstances of crop prices, yield, agricultural technology and resource availability in Oman's commercial farming is not viable, without government support. With the use of a linear programming model that simulates the farming systems; in a major agricultural region in Oman (Batinah region) the production subsidy that is required as an incentive to promote the cultivation of wheat is estimated. The wheat yield in Oman is considered as 3 Tons/Ha and world price of wheat is around 100 OR/Ton. Wheat cultivation under commercial farming would be viable if a subsidy of at least 414 OR/Ha (138 OR/Ton) is provided. This subsidy can be instrumented as an input subsidy and/or price supports as Saudi Arabia had done (190 OR/Ton of wheat). If the wheat yield could be increased through technological and managerial means to global potential yield of 5 Tons/Ha then the price support need to be at least 83 OR/Ton of wheat. The extent of its achievement in terms of extent of land cultivated and total domestic production of wheat, need to be considered in relation to the trade-off of fiscal cost and political choice of the degree of food security deemed as necessary to achieve.

AI.tldr: 本文以阿曼小麦为例，论证粮食安全应被视为公共产品，需政府干预。通过线性规划模型估算，在现有产量（3吨/公顷）下，需补贴414 OR/公顷（138 OR/吨）才能使商业化小麦种植具有可行性；若产量提升至5吨/公顷，补贴可降至83 OR/吨。
AI.research_question: 政府如何通过补贴干预市场以实现国家粮食安全，以及在阿曼小麦种植中需要的最低生产补贴是多少？
AI.motivation: 金融危机和食品价格上涨重新引发了关于政府在经济管理特别是保障国家粮食安全中作用的争论，需要通过实证分析为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 粮食安全作为公共产品的理论；政府干预市场的理论依据。
AI.method: 使用线性规划模型模拟阿曼巴提纳地区的农业系统，估算使小麦种植具有经济可行性的最低生产补贴。
AI.findings: 在当前产量（3吨/公顷）和世界价格（100 OR/吨）下，需要至少414 OR/公顷（138 OR/吨）的补贴；若产量提升至5吨/公顷，价格支持可降至83 OR/吨。
AI.theory_contributions: 将粮食安全明确界定为公共产品，为政府干预提供了理论正当性；将补贴需求与产量提升结合分析，拓展了公共产品供给的成本效益视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿曼及其他面临类似粮食安全问题的国家提供了具体的补贴标准参考，并指出产量提升可降低补贴负担，为政策制定中的财政成本与粮食安全程度的权衡提供了量化依据。

title: Beyond Deterrence: Option-Oriented Jurisprudence and the Twin Pillars of Criminal Law Reform

detail.title: Beyond Deterrence: Option-Oriented Jurisprudence and the Twin Pillars of Criminal Law Reform
detail.abstract:
The dominant tradition in criminal law theory frames crime as a rational calculation deterred by sufficient punishment costs. This paper argues that this framework, while internally coherent, addresses the wrong variable. The primary driver of criminal behavior is not insufficient punishment but insufficient legitimate choice. When an agent’s lawful options for satisfying fundamental needs are systematically constrained, crime becomes a conditionally rational response to a depleted choice set. Furthermore, once an agent has crossed a behavioral threshold for the first time, pure deterrence fails systematically: moral, identity, and social evaluation costs become permanently sunk, and the threshold for subsequent transgressions declines monotonically. No increase in formal penalty can reconstitute what the first crossing has dismantled. 
This paper proposes Option-Oriented Jurisprudence (OOJ) as an alternative framework, grounded in two foundational pillars: Sovereign Expansion — enlarging the space of legitimate choices to preempt criminal motivation at its structural source — and Cost Reconstruction — rebuilding the personal stakes that make re-offending genuinely costly, rather than raising formal penalties that no longer bind. The paper further introduces the concept of the Consensual Adversary to delineate with precision the boundary between lawful zero-sum competition and criminal harm: the former involves parties who voluntarily enter a structured interaction under symmetrical intent and mutual assumption of risk; the latter involves a unilateral, non-consensual destruction of another party’s choice space through deliberate malice.
The behavioral microfoundation of the paper draws on the Rational Sovereignty framework (He, 2026), which formalizes how sovereignty constraints shape an agent’s effective choice set and explains why behavior that appears irrational to external observers is often conditionally optimal within the agent’s actual decision environment. The legal implications are concrete: criminal law reform should prioritize expanding lawful options, sealing minor criminal records to enable genuine reintegration, and investing in social bond reconstruction for returning citizens — rather than escalating punishments that are structurally ineffective against those who have already crossed the threshold.

AI.tldr: 本文批判传统刑法理论将犯罪视为被惩罚成本威慑的理性计算，提出"面向选择的法理学"（OOJ），认为犯罪的根本原因不是惩罚不足，而是合法选择不足。首次越轨后，道德、身份和社会成本永久沉没，再高的正式惩罚也无法重建威慑。替代框架包括"主权扩张"（扩大合法选择空间）和"成本重建"（重建犯罪者的个人成本），并引入"合意对抗者"概念区分合法零和竞争与犯罪伤害。
AI.research_question: 传统刑法理论将犯罪视为理性计算被惩罚成本所威慑，但这一框架是否关注了错误的变量？如果犯罪的主要驱动力不是惩罚不足而是合法选择不足，那么刑法改革应如何重新定向？
AI.motivation: 传统威慑理论内部逻辑自洽但可能指向了错误的干预变量；首次越轨后道德、身份和社会评价成本永久沉没，正式惩罚无法重建威慑，因此需要新的理论框架来指导刑法改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 面向选择的法理学（Option-Oriented Jurisprudence, OOJ），基于"理性主权"框架（Rational Sovereignty），包括"主权扩张"（扩大合法选择空间）和"成本重建"（重建个人层面的犯罪成本）两大支柱，以及"合意对抗者"概念。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念分析，基于"理性主权"框架（He, 2026）的行为微观基础，通过对传统威慑理论的批判性分析提出替代性理论框架。
AI.findings: 合法选择不足是犯罪的主要结构性原因；首次越轨后道德、身份和社会评价成本永久沉没，正式惩罚无法恢复这些成本；"主权扩张"和"成本重建"是比提高惩罚更有效的犯罪预防策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出面向选择的法理学（OOJ）作为传统威慑理论的替代框架；引入"合意对抗者"概念精确区分合法竞争与犯罪伤害；运用"理性主权"框架为刑法理论提供新的行为微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 刑法改革应优先扩大合法选择、封存轻微犯罪记录以促进真正回归社会、投资重建出狱者的社会纽带，而非升级对已越轨者结构性无效的惩罚。

title: Economic Spillovers of Tariff Policy: Evidence from Foreign Tourism to the United States
affiliations: , University of Wisconsin-Madison - Department of Accounting and Information Systems and University of Illinois at Chicago - Department of Accounting

detail.title: Economic Spillovers of Tariff Policy: Evidence from Foreign Tourism to the United States
detail.abstract: We examine whether tariffs generate economic spillovers to the taxing country, specifically a reduction in inbound international tourism. Using the April 2, 2025 "Liberation Day" tariff announcements as a quasi-natural experiment, we implement a fixed effects counterfactual estimator comparing inbound tourism to the United States (U.S.) with tourism to nearby Canada. Tourists from countries facing reciprocal tariffs reduced travel to the U.S. by approximately 20.5 percent-about 315,000 fewer monthly visitors-with stronger effects for U.S. geopolitical allies. Travel-related services exports fell nearly 7 percent relative to other U.S. service categories, implying over $1 billion in lost monthly revenue. Finally, we show that firms more exposed to international tourism experienced incremental declines in stock prices around Liberation Day. Overall, our results indicate tariffs on foreign goods affect a major services export: tourism.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2025年4月2日“解放日”关税公告作为准自然实验，发现关税会通过减少入境国际旅游对征税国产生经济溢出效应。来自面临互惠关税国家的游客赴美人数下降约20.5%（每月约31.5万人次），旅游服务出口下降近7%，相关企业股价也受到负面影响。
AI.research_question: 关税是否会对征税国产生经济溢出效应，具体而言，关税是否会导致入境国际旅游减少？
AI.motivation: 传统研究多关注关税对贸易伙伴国的影响，但较少探讨关税对征税国自身服务业（如旅游）的溢出效应。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 准自然实验；固定效应反事实估计
AI.method: 采用2025年4月2日“解放日”关税公告作为准自然实验，使用固定效应反事实估计量，比较美国与邻近加拿大之间的入境旅游差异。
AI.findings: （1）来自面临互惠关税国家的游客赴美人数下降约20.5%，每月约减少31.5万人次；（2）对美国 geopolitical 盟友的影响更强；（3）旅游服务出口相对于其他美国服务类别下降近7%，每月损失超10亿美元；（4）对国际旅游敞口更大的企业，在解放日前后股价跌幅更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证揭示关税对征税国自身的服务业溢出效应，拓展了关税经济后果的研究边界，将国际贸易与旅游经济学联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供警示：关税政策不仅影响商品贸易，还会通过抑制入境旅游对本土服务业造成显著经济损失，贸易政策需考虑服务业的连带反应。

title: Effect of Institutional Investors on How Financial Statement Comparability Affects Stock Price Crash Risk
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Delhi

detail.title: Effect of Institutional Investors on How Financial Statement Comparability Affects Stock Price Crash Risk
detail.abstract: Prior studies on the developed markets show that crash risk decreases when financial reporting of a firm is comparable to that of its peer firms. By using a sample of Indian firms, I show that firms with high financial statement comparability experience lower stock price crash risk. The negative relationship between comparability and crash risk becomes stronger with institutional ownership. The relationship between comparability and crash risk is not influenced by the presence of foreign institutional investors or foreign promoters. Improvement in the information quality is the potential channel through which comparability enhances usefulness of accounting information to the institutional investors, thus lowering crash risk.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在印度市场，财务报告可比性越高，股价崩盘风险越低，且机构持股会强化这一负向关系。信息质量提升是可比性降低崩盘风险的作用渠道。
AI.research_question: 财务报告可比性是否以及如何影响新兴市场（印度）的股价崩盘风险？
AI.motivation: 发达市场已有证据表明财务报告可比性降低崩盘风险，但新兴市场（如印度）的制度环境与发达市场存在显著差异，需检验该关系是否在新兴市场中成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息质量理论；财务报告可比性通过提升信息质量，降低信息不对称，减少管理层隐藏坏消息的空间，从而降低崩盘风险。
AI.method: 以印度上市公司为样本进行实证分析，采用多元回归检验可比性与崩盘风险的关系，并考察机构持股、外资机构投资者、外国发起人等调节效应。
AI.findings: （1）印度市场中财务报告可比性与股价崩盘风险呈显著负相关；（2）机构持股强化了上述负向关系；（3）外资机构投资者和外国发起人并不显著影响该关系；（4）信息质量提升是可比性降低崩盘风险的作用渠道。
AI.theory_contributions: 将财务报告可比性与崩盘风险的研究从发达市场拓展至新兴市场（印度），验证了信息质量渠道的中介作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度等新兴市场的投资者和监管者提供了政策启示：提高财务报告可比性有助于降低资本市场崩盘风险，尤其对机构投资者更为重要。

title: DVC Mechanism: The Impact on EU Equity Markets
affiliations: European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA), affiliation not provided to SSRN, European Securities and Markets Authority, and European Securities and Markets Authority

detail.title: DVC Mechanism: The Impact on EU Equity Markets
detail.abstract: This paper analyses the impact of the Double Volume Cap (DVC) mechanism on European equity markets since it was introduced in March 2018. The DVC mechanism introduces limits to the amount of transactions executed under reference price and negotiated trade waivers in equity markets. For equities where DVC restrictions were applied from March 2018 onwards and for which the restriction ended in September 2018, the amount of trading on dark pools dropped from more than 7% in January 2018 to less than 1% of the total in August 2018, while the share of trading in frequent batch auctions increased over the same period from below 1% to 4% of the total. However, as the restriction on dark trading for some of these equities was lifted in September 2018, the volume of dark pool trading for these shares increased to more than 5% and the volume in frequent batch auctions declined to 2.5%. We also analyse the impact of the DVC mechanism on market liquidity in lit markets, building on a set of market liquidity indicators. The results point to an overall positive impact of the DVC measure on market liquidity in the continuous trading and auction markets (lit markets). For equities where DVC restrictions were applied from March 2018, the econometric analysis shows that market liquidity in lit markets generally improved in terms of breadth, tightness and depth. Consistently with the scope of the DVC mechanism, the turnover in continuous trading and auctions markets of the ISINs banned by the DVC mechanism is estimated to have increased significantly by about 10% following the ban compared to non-banned ISINs. Results hold when different econometric techniques are employed.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2018年3月欧盟引入的"双容量上限"（DVC）机制对欧洲股票市场的影响。研究发现，DVC限制显著降低了暗池交易量，同时增加了频繁批量拍卖的交易份额；当限制解除后，暗池交易回升。整体上，DVC机制对公开市场的流动性（广度、紧度、深度）产生了积极影响，被禁股票的公开市场交易量增加了约10%。
AI.research_question: 双容量上限（DVC）机制如何影响欧洲股票市场的暗池交易、频繁批量拍卖以及公开市场的流动性？
AI.motivation: 检验DVC这一旨在限制暗池交易、促进交易透明度的监管政策是否达到了预期效果，并评估其对市场质量的整体影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场微观结构理论，从市场流动性（广度、紧度、深度）和交易渠道转移的角度分析监管干预对市场质量的影响。
AI.method: 采用事件研究和计量经济学分析，对比DVC限制生效期、解除期前后的交易量和流动性指标变化，并使用多种计量技术进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）DVC限制期内，暗池交易占比从7%降至不足1%，频繁批量拍卖占比从不足1%升至4%；限制解除后，暗池回升至5%以上，频繁批量拍卖降至2.5%。（2）DVC对公开市场的流动性（广度、紧度、深度）有总体积极影响。（3）被禁股票在公开市场的交易量相比非被禁股票显著增加约10%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管政策如何影响市场微观结构中的交易渠道选择和流动性提供了实证证据，丰富了关于"暗池vs公开市场竞争"的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构评估和优化暗池交易限制措施提供了量化依据，表明DVC机制在提升市场透明度方面有效，且未损害公开市场流动性。

title: Age and Social Trust: Within-Person Evidence from Germany and Switzerland
affiliations: BI Norwegian Business School

detail.title: Age and Social Trust: Within-Person Evidence from Germany and Switzerland
detail.abstract: In cross-sectional surveys generalized trust rises to a peak near midlife, but age and birth cohort are collinear in a cross-section, so this profile may reflect differences between generations rather than ageing. I separate the two with a within-person first-difference design that removes cohort by construction, using the German SocioEconomic Panel (2003-2023) and the Swiss Household Panel (2002-2024). In both panels the detrended within-person change in trust falls significantly with age, so the profile is genuinely concave over the life course rather than a generational artifact. The within-person curvature is statistically indistinguishable from the cross-sectional one in Germany, leaving no detectable cohort contribution to the hump's shape, but is about half as large in Switzerland, where a substantial part of the apparent shape appears to be cohort. Both within-person curvatures are imprecise, so these shares are read by interval overlap, not point estimate.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用德国和瑞士的面板数据，通过组内一阶差分法分离年龄和世代效应，发现广义信任的倒U型生命周期模式真实存在，但世代贡献在不同国家存在差异。
AI.research_question: 广义信任随年龄变化的倒U型曲线是真实的生命周期效应，还是由世代差异造成的伪像？
AI.motivation: 横截面研究中信任在中年前后达到峰值，但年龄与出生世代在横截面中完全共线性，无法区分年龄效应和世代效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 年龄-时期-世代（APC）分解框架；组内一阶差分法消除世代效应。
AI.method: 使用德国社会经济面板（2003-2023）和瑞士家庭面板（2002-2024），采用组内一阶差分设计，通过去趋势后的组内信任变化随年龄的变动来估计生命周期效应。
AI.findings: 两国去趋势后的组内信任变化均随年龄显著下降，表明生命周期效应真实存在。德国组内曲率与横截面曲率统计上无差异（世代贡献可忽略），瑞士组内曲率约为横截面的一半（世代贡献显著）。两类曲率估计均不精确，需通过区间重叠而非点估计判断。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格分离了信任随年龄变化的年龄效应与世代效应，证实信任的倒U型生命周期特征并非完全由世代差异驱动。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了信任形成机制中年龄发展与世代烙印的相对重要性存在国家差异，对理解社会信任的长期变迁具有政策启示。

title: Under Pressure: Unveiling the Instincts Behind (Dis)Honesty
affiliations: University of Genoa and University of Copenhagen - Department of Economics

detail.title: Under Pressure: Unveiling the Instincts Behind (Dis)Honesty
detail.abstract: This chapter aims to explore the causes of dishonesty from a variety of fields, including economics, psychology, sociology, and neuroscience, to understand whether dishonest actions are mainly driven by instinct or by deliberate decision-making. By examining recent studies, we assess how situational factors-such as time pressure, cognitive load, reduced self-control, depletion, and physical states-affect the process of making ethical decisions. The analysis highlights how external and psychological drivers influence people's moral choices and shows how complex the decision-making environment can be. The chapter emphasizes how important it is to recognize these factors when creating strategies to promote honesty in different areas of society. This chapter contributes to a deeper understanding of the forces that drive dishonest behavior and offers valuable insights for designing interventions that encourage ethical actions in diverse social settings, ultimately improving the integrity of both individuals and organizations.

AI.tldr: 本章从经济学、心理学、社会学和神经科学等多个领域探讨不诚实行为的成因，重点分析情境因素（如时间压力、认知负荷、自我控制减弱、资源消耗和生理状态）如何影响道德决策过程。研究认为不诚实行为既受本能驱动，也受有意决策影响，并为促进社会各领域诚实行为提供了策略建议。
AI.research_question: 不诚实行为主要是由本能驱动还是由有意决策驱动？情境因素如何影响道德决策过程？
AI.motivation: 理解不诚实行为的根本成因，以设计有效的干预措施来促进个人和组织的诚信行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科视角（经济学、心理学、社会学、神经科学）下的道德决策理论；本能与有意决策的二分框架；情境因素对道德判断的影响模型。
AI.method: 文献综述法，综合评述多个领域关于不诚实行为及情境因素影响的最新实证研究。
AI.findings: 情境因素（时间压力、认知负荷、自我控制减弱、资源消耗、生理状态）显著影响道德决策过程；不诚实行为是本能与有意决策共同作用的结果；外部和心理驱动因素共同塑造人们的道德选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合多学科视角，深化对不诚实行为驱动力的理解；揭示了道德决策环境的复杂性，强调了情境因素在理论模型中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计促进社会各领域诚信行为的干预措施提供了实证依据；有助于提升个人和组织的道德诚信水平。

title: Out of Balance? Assessing the Impact of the Green Transition on Banks
affiliations: Potsdam Institute of Climate Impact Research, Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK) and Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK)

detail.title: Out of Balance? Assessing the Impact of the Green Transition on Banks

declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the German Federal Ministry of Research, Technology and Space, BMFTR, (Grant Number 01LA2212C)

detail.abstract: Climate policy that phases out emission-intensive capital will strand assets on bank balance sheets. We quantify these transition risks in a two-sector environmental DSGE model with balance-sheet frictions and investment adjustment costs. Emissions fall only through a shift from brown to green production, not by abatement technology. We compute the Ramsey-optimal carbon tax path from a business-as-usual initial state to a green steady state. Financial frictions leave the qualitative transition largely unchanged but concentrate substantial balance-sheet stress in the first year: brown asset prices fall by more than 20%, bank net worth collapses to about one quarter of its initial level, and leverage spikes sharply. Financial frictions delay the green expansion without substantially affecting brown disinvestment. The Ramsey planner trades off climate damages against balance-sheet losses, setting a lower carbon tax than without financial frictions. Transition risk for the aggregate banking sector is substantial but transient.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个包含金融摩擦的两部门环境DSGE模型，量化了气候政策（逐步淘汰高排放资本）对银行资产负债表的转型风险，发现金融摩擦会放大短期冲击但整体转型路径变化不大，Ramsey规划者会权衡气候损害与资产负债表损失从而设定较低的碳税。
AI.research_question: 气候政策导致的资本淘汰如何通过金融摩擦对银行资产负债表产生转型风险？Ramsey最优碳税路径在存在金融摩擦时如何变化？
AI.motivation: 现有气候政策研究多关注实体经济转型，忽视了银行资产负债表上搁浅资产带来的金融脆弱性；需要量化评估金融摩擦对气候转型路径和最优政策设计的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两部门环境DSGE模型（棕色与绿色生产）、资产负债表摩擦、投资调整成本、Ramsey最优碳税路径
AI.method: 构建包含金融摩擦的两部门环境DSGE模型，从业务照常初始状态到绿色稳态，计算Ramsey最优碳税路径，比较有/无金融摩擦情景下的转型动态。
AI.findings: 金融摩擦不改变转型的定性路径，但会集中资产负债表压力于第一年：棕色资产价格下跌超20%，银行净值萎缩至初始水平的四分之一，杠杆率急剧上升；金融摩擦延迟绿色扩张但不显著影响棕色资本撤资；Ramsey规划者会设定比无金融摩擦时更低的碳税；对银行部门的转型风险显著但具有暂时性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融摩擦（资产负债表约束）嵌入环境DSGE框架，揭示了气候转型风险通过银行部门的传导机制；证明了最优气候政策需要内生化金融稳定目标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行和监管机构量化气候转型风险对银行系统的冲击提供了分析框架和数值基准；提示政策制定者在碳税设计中应纳入金融稳定考量，避免过度激进的转型引发系统性金融风险。

title: Pólya-Gamma Bandits
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Pólya-Gamma Bandits
detail.abstract: Dynamic assortment optimization under a multinomial-logit (MNL) choice model is the canonical combinatorial bandit of revenue management. The optimal index policy-the Gittins index-is intractable here, and the state-of-the-art Thompson sampler keeps only a two-moment Gaussian approximation of the posterior, because the exact MNL posterior under choice feedback has no closed form. We remove the approximation. Following Scott (2010), we treat the bandit by randomized probability matching (Thompson sampling), and we make the matching exact: a stick-breaking representation turns each multinomial choice into a sequence of binary logits whose log-odds are linear in the parameter, so Pólya-Gamma augmentation (Polson et al., 2013) yields a conditionally Gaussian Gibbs sampler with no normalizing offset. The resulting PG-Thompson sampler is exact and cheap. In a reproducible study it attains 4.6× lower cumulative regret than the Gaussianapproximation sampler, and we trace the gap to calibration: under the adaptive, near-separated data a bandit generates, the Laplace-Gaussian posterior over-covers, so Thompson sampling overexplores; exact PG is near-nominal.

AI.tldr: 本文针对MNL选择模型下的动态组合优化问题，提出了一种精确的PG-Thompson采样算法，通过stick-breaking表示和Pólya-Gamma增广技术消除了传统高斯近似的偏差，显著降低了累积遗憾。
AI.research_question: 如何在MNL选择模型下的组合老虎机问题中，实现精确而非近似的Thompson采样，以提升决策性能？
AI.motivation: 现有Thompson采样器仅保留后验的两矩高斯近似，因为MNL选择反馈下的精确后验无闭式解，这种近似导致过度探索和性能损失。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机概率匹配（Thompson采样）、stick-breaking表示、Pólya-Gamma增广、条件高斯Gibbs采样
AI.method: 将多项选择通过stick-breaking转化为一系列二元logit（其对数优势比与参数线性相关），再利用Pólya-Gamma增广得到条件高斯的Gibbs采样器，实现精确后验采样。
AI.findings: PG-Thompson采样器累积遗憾比高斯近似采样器低4.6倍；性能差距源于校准问题——在自适应、近分离数据下，拉普拉斯-高斯后验过度覆盖，导致Thompson采样过度探索，而精确PG采样接近名义覆盖水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在MNL组合老虎机中实现精确Thompson采样，消除了后验近似的系统性偏差；2. 揭示了高斯近似在自适应数据下过度覆盖导致过度探索的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出了一种既精确又廉价的PG-Thompson算法，可直接应用于收益管理中的动态产品组合优化；2. 研究成果可复现，具有实证参考价值。

title: Killing the Inner Loop: Amortized Bayesian Computation for Input Uncertainty
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Killing the Inner Loop: Amortized Bayesian Computation for Input Uncertainty
detail.abstract: Decision making with stochastic simulators must account for input uncertainty: the simulator's parameters are estimated, so a posterior sits over them. The textbook estimator of a risk functional of system performance is nested Monte Carlo-an outer loop over posterior draws, an inner simulation per draw-whose cost is the product of the two loop lengths and whose inner noise biases tail functionals. We replace the nested computation by a single amortized pass. Generative Bayesian computation trains one surrogate from (input, output) pairs, each costing a single short simulation, and propagates the entire posterior through the surrogate with no inner loop. On an M/M/1 queue with a Bayesian posterior over arrival and service rates, the amortized estimator of the 0.9-quantile of mean sojourn time is 2.8× more accurate than nested Monte Carlo at equal budget, and reaches accuracy nested simulation does not attain at any budget we test, because nested inner noise inflates the outer quantile. A sensitivity study shows the advantage is largest in the normal operating regime and narrows as utilization approaches saturation, where the response nears a singularity-an honest guide to when to use the surrogate and when to retain an inner loop. A second study, varying the amount of input data, shows the same boundary from the other side: the surrogate dominates by up to an order of magnitude once the input posterior is even moderately concentrated, and trails nested only when the posterior is so diffuse that it straddles the instability boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用生成式贝叶斯计算替代嵌套蒙特卡洛方法，通过单次摊销前向传播估计随机模拟器的风险函数，在M/M/1队列实验中，摊销估计器在相同预算下精度比嵌套蒙特卡洛高2.8倍，且能到达嵌套方法无法企及的精度水平。
AI.research_question: 如何高效且无偏地估计随机模拟器在参数后验分布下的风险函数（如分位数）？
AI.motivation: 嵌套蒙特卡洛方法计算成本高（两层循环的乘积），且内层模拟噪声会偏误尾部函数估计（如高分位数），需要更高效的计算方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成式贝叶斯计算（Generative Bayesian Computation）；摊销推断（Amortized Inference）；嵌套蒙特卡洛（Nested Monte Carlo）。
AI.method: 训练一个替代模型（surrogate），从（输入参数, 输出）配对数据中学习输入-输出映射，然后直接通过替代模型传播整个后验分布，无需内层循环。每个数据点只需一次短模拟。
AI.findings: （1）在M/M/1队列中，摊销估计器对平均逗留时间0.9分位数的估计在相同预算下比嵌套蒙特卡洛准确2.8倍；（2）嵌套蒙特卡洛的内层噪声会膨胀外层分位数估计，导致在某些预算下无法达到摊销方法的精度；（3）优势在正常运营区域最大，在利用率接近饱和（响应接近奇点）时优势缩小；（4）当输入后验足够集中时，替代方法优势可达一个数量级；仅在后验极度分散（跨越不稳定边界）时才落后于嵌套方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种替代嵌套蒙特卡洛的摊销计算方法，从理论上揭示了嵌套内层噪声对尾部风险函数估计的偏误机制，并刻画了替代方法与嵌套方法的适用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为随机模拟器的决策提供了一种计算效率更高、精度更好的风险估计方法；给出了何时使用替代方法、何时保留内层循环的实践指导（正常运营区域用替代法，接近饱和时用嵌套法）。

title: The Road as a Commons: Congestion as Collective Over-Exploitation, Speed Limits as Temporal Resource Management, and a Dynamic Mechanism for Smart Urban Mobility
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Road as a Commons: Congestion as Collective Over-Exploitation, Speed Limits as Temporal Resource Management, and a Dynamic Mechanism for Smart Urban Mobility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, in connection with the research presented in this paper. No funding was received for this work from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.funderStatement: This research does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. Accordingly, ethics approval was not required for this study.

detail.abstract:
This paper develops a unied theory of urban peak-hour congestion as a commonpool resource failure, extends it to a mechanism design framework for the state, and derives the architecture of a dynamic smart-mobility system grounded in vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) and vehicle-to-infrastructure (V2I) communication. We formalise the road's temporal capacity Q(t) - the maximum number of vehicles that can pass through a bottleneck per unit time without inducing speed collapse - as a common-pool resource rivalrous in consumption and non-excludable under current institutions. Each commuter who drives above the regulated speed v reg consumes temporal capacity qi > qreg, depleting the commons faster than the socially optimal rate. We prove that aggregate over-exploitation occurs whenever the share of non-compliant commuters exceeds a critical threshold λ ∗ = (vmax − v reg)/(αn), and that the resulting congestion is precisely the common-pool tragedy identied by Hardin (1968) in a spatial-temporal guise. We then reinterpret speed limits not as safety instruments but as quantity restrictions on temporal resource consumption - a second-best regulatory tool that is dominated by a properly designed dynamic mechanism.

The dynamic mechanism we propose has four interlocking components: (i) institutional temporal dispersal via regulated staggering of oce and school timings, which we prove achieves the social optimum without any price instrument; (ii) a peak-hour tradeable temporal quota (TTQ) system, under which commuters hold vouchers entitling them to road access during peak windows, with excess demand cleared through a competitive permit market and a bounded free emergency quota tier preserving access for urgent and unscheduled trips; (iii) a dynamic routing mandate embedded in vehicles, converting the simultaneous non-cooperative game of Deep (2026a) into a centrally-coordinated sequential allocation problem; and (iv) a V2V/V2I network layer that provides the real-time state information required for all three preceding components. We prove incentive compatibility and individual rationality of the TTQ mechanism, derive the revenue-maximising permit price, bound the welfare cost of the emergency quota tier, and show that the full mechanism achieves the social optimum in the limit of perfect information and full V2V coverage. We also derive the second-best optimum under partial technology adoption, providing a transition path relevant to rapidly urbanising economies such as India.

Empirical motivation draws on TomTom Trac Index 2025 data showing Bengaluru as the world's second most congested city (168 hours lost annually), Indian speed-violation rates of 4075% on urban arterials, and peak-hour speed collapse from free-ow speeds of ∼60 km hr−1 to observed averages of 13.916.6 km hr−1 .

AI.tldr: 本文将城市高峰拥堵重新概念化为一种"公地悲剧"——道路的时间通行能力是竞争性且非排他性的公共池资源。作者提出了一套包含错峰制度、可交易时间配额（TTQ）、动态路由指令和V2V/V2I通信网络的四维动态机制设计，并证明该机制在完美信息条件下可达社会最优。
AI.research_question: 如何从公共池资源视角理解城市高峰拥堵，并设计一种基于动态机制的市场化方案（而非传统限速工具）来缓解拥堵？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中如班加罗尔等城市高峰拥堵极其严重（2025年TomTom数据：每年损失168小时），且超速违规率高达40-75%，高峰期车速从60 km/h骤降至13.9-16.6 km/h，表明现有限速等监管工具效果有限，亟需新的理论框架和机制设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公地悲剧理论（Hardin, 1968）；公共池资源理论（竞争性+非排他性）；机制设计理论（激励相容、个体理性）；博弈论（非合作博弈→协调序贯分配）。
AI.method: 理论建模：推导临界阈值λ∗=(vmax−vreg)/(αn)证明过度开采条件；机制设计：提出包含四项组件的动态机制；最优性证明：证明TTQ机制的激励相容性和个体理性，推导收入最大化许可价格，对紧急配额层的福利成本进行边界分析。
AI.findings: （1）当违规通勤者比例超过临界阈值λ∗时，必然发生公地悲剧式拥堵；（2）现有限速仅是次优的二阶工具；（3）错峰制度无需价格工具即可实现社会最优；（4）TTQ机制具有激励相容性和个体理性；（5）完整机制在完美信息和完全V2V覆盖下可达社会最优；（6）提供了部分技术采纳情境下的次优路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将城市高峰拥堵严谨地形式化为时空维度的公地悲剧，拓展了Hardin经典理论到动态交通场景；将限速重新解释为数量管制工具而非安全工具，为交通政策理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可操作的四维动态智能出行系统架构（错峰+可交易配额+动态路由+V2V/V2I），提供了从次优到最优的渐进转型路径，对班加罗尔等快速城市化地区具有直接政策参考价值。

title: GBC for Risk-sensitive Design of Accelerated Life Tests
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and George Washington University

detail.title: GBC for Risk-sensitive Design of Accelerated Life Tests
detail.abstract: Accelerated life testing (ALT) is a decision problem: a fixed budget of test units and test time must be allocated across stress levels to learn as much as possible about field reliability at use conditions, where failures are almost never observed directly. Because the lifetime model is nonlinear and the target-a low percentile of life at use stress-is an extrapolation, the optimal plan depends on the unknown parameters, and a plan tuned to a best guess can be far from optimal for plausible alternatives. We give a modern Bayesian treatment built on Generative Bayesian Computation (GBC). A single deep quantile network is trained on a prior-predictive simulation table, with the design as an input and the reliability utility in its first layer; expected utility is then a one-dimensional integral of a learned quantile function, evaluated for any plan by a forward pass. This amortises the objective over the whole space of plans-stress levels, allocations, and censoring times-without a likelihood, an evidence integral, or a nested Monte Carlo loop, modernising the augmented-probability simulation behind earlier simulation-based ALT design. The quantile representation also yields risk-sensitive plans at no extra cost: by Yaari's dual theory of choice, re-weighting quantile levels produces conservative designs that protect the worst-case extrapolation, the testplanning analogue of conditional value at risk. The static problem embeds in a Bayes-adaptive Markov decision process, so sequential and step-stress plans are Bellman backups solved by the same network. A reproducible lognormal study recovers the classical compromise plan, quantifies each plan's value of information, and produces a robust plan that lifts the worst-case precision of the use-condition percentile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）的加速寿命试验（ALT）设计方法，利用深度分位数网络一次性求解所有可能设计方案下的期望效用，无需似然函数或嵌套蒙特卡洛，并支持风险敏感设计与序贯/步进应力规划。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限预算（测试单元与时间）下，针对未知参数的非线性寿命模型，设计最优的加速寿命试验方案以最大化使用条件下低分位数寿命的推断精度？
AI.motivation: ALT设计本质上是决策问题，但最优方案依赖未知参数，基于点估计的方案在参数偏离时可能表现很差。传统方法需嵌套蒙特卡洛模拟，计算成本极高，且难以处理风险敏感和序贯设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）；深度分位数网络；Yaari对偶理论（风险敏感决策）；贝叶斯自适应马尔可夫决策过程（序贯/步进应力设计）；条件风险价值（CVaR）类比。
AI.method: 在完整的设计空间（应力水平、分配比例、截尾时间）上训练一个深度分位数网络，以设计方案为输入、可靠性效用的分位数函数为输出。期望效用通过分位数函数的一维积分计算，任意方案只需一次前向传播即可评估。风险敏感设计通过对分位数水平重新加权实现。
AI.findings: 对数正态案例研究表明：该方法可恢复经典折中方案；可量化每个方案的信息价值；可生成稳健方案，提升使用条件百分位数的最坏情况精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将ALT设计问题统一为贝叶斯决策框架下的分位数学习问题，避免了似然函数和证据积分的计算，实现了全设计空间上的效用摊销；将Yaari对偶理论引入试验设计，实现了无需额外成本的风险敏感规划。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可复现、计算高效的ALT设计工具，支持经典设计、风险敏感设计及序贯/步进应力设计，可直接用于工程可靠性测试规划。

title: “What Have You Got to Lose?”: Ignorance and Experimentation in a Spatial Voting Model

detail.title: “What Have You Got to Lose?”: Ignorance and Experimentation in a Spatial Voting Model
detail.abstract: I develop a three-period spatial voting model in which a voter knows her utility function but not her ideal point. An incumbent offers the status quo with certainty; a challenger implements policy with error. In a single-election setting, the voter always prefer the incumbent - replicating canonical results. With two elections, this result inverts: experimentation generates information enabling better future choices. When sufficiently dissatisfied with the status quo, the voter elects the challenger. Extending the model to a continuum of citizens who vote strategically and may enter as challengers, I show that challenger support emerges from both ideological flanks. Voters far from the status quo - whether left or right - form coalitions united by shared dissatisfaction, providing novel theoretical foundations for cross-ideological coalitions.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个三期空间投票模型，研究选民在不确定理想点情况下，如何通过选举实验性挑战者来获取信息，从而在当下牺牲利益以换取未来更好的选择，并为跨意识形态联盟提供理论基础。
AI.research_question: 在选民知道自己效用函数但不知道自身理想点的情况下，选民为何会支持挑战者（而非总是支持现任者）？跨意识形态联盟是如何形成的？
AI.motivation: 传统空间投票模型预测选民总是偏好现任者，但现实中选民经常支持挑战者。本文试图通过引入信息不确定性（选民不知道自己的理想点）和实验性投票来解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三期空间投票模型；信息实验（experimentation）；贝叶斯更新；战略投票。
AI.method: 理论建模：先构建单期和两期选举的基本模型，再扩展至连续选民空间，引入战略进入和投票。
AI.findings: 单期选举中选民总是偏好现任者（复刻经典结果）；两期选举中，当对现状足够不满时，选民会选举挑战者以获取信息；扩展至连续选民后，挑战者支持来自意识形态两翼——左翼和右翼的选民因共同不满而结成联盟。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将信息实验引入空间投票模型，解释"牺牲当下选票换取未来信息"的投票行为；2. 为跨意识形态联盟提供了新的理论解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于理解政治极化背景下，不同意识形态选民为何会联合支持同一挑战者，对选举策略和政治传播具有启示意义。

title: The AI Buildout and the Economy: Publicly Available Data to Assess AI's Impact
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and

detail.title: The AI Buildout and the Economy: Publicly Available Data to Assess AI's Impact

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: This note presents publicly available indicators that can help researchers and policymakers track the evolution of the generative AI buildout and its potential impact on the economy on a timely basis. We organize the indicators into three categories: capabilities and costs; firm investment and adoption; and productivity and labor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了三类公开指标（能力与成本、企业投资与采纳、生产率与劳动力），帮助追踪生成式AI建设进展及其对经济的潜在影响。
AI.research_question: 如何通过公开指标及时追踪生成式AI建设进展及其对经济的影响？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI快速发展，但缺乏系统性的公开指标来帮助研究者和政策制定者及时了解其建设进展和经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成式AI的指标分类框架：能力与成本、企业投资与采纳、生产率与劳动力。
AI.method: 文献综述与指标构建，整理公开可获取的数据来源。
AI.findings: 提出了三类有助于追踪生成式AI建设与经济影响的公开指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 为生成式AI的经济影响研究提供了系统化的指标分类框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和政策制定者提供了可操作的公开指标，便于及时监测生成式AI的发展动态。

title: The Generative Newsvendor
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: The Generative Newsvendor
detail.abstract: The newsvendor's optimal order is a quantile: the conditional critical fractile of demand. We solve the feature-based newsvendor under decision-dependent censoring by targeting that quantile directly with generative Bayesian computation (GBC). Because lost sales are unobserved we record only min(D, q); we fold this censoring into a forward simulator through the survival/density split of the likelihood, so the predictive quantile is learned by simulation without a conjugate update, which fails under censoring. The key structural fact is that the decision is a smooth functional of the predictive law, so what governs regret is getting the shape of that law right. We make this precise: a parametric plug-in carries an O(1) quantile bias under misspecification, while a flexible generative predictive is consistent and conditionally calibrated. Reproducible experiments confirm the theory. When the parametric model is correct, GBC ties an oracle-parametric Bayes rule and both reduce regret by an order of magnitude over empirical risk minimization on censored sales. When demand is multimodal-the regime of Ekin et al. (2014)-GBC is the only calibrated rule and cuts regret by 2.7× over a parametric plug-in; a sensitivity study shows the advantage grows monotonically with the degree of multimodality, from parity at unimodal demand to a near 4× gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）的方法，直接针对需求的条件临界分位数进行特征驱动的报童问题求解，在需求多模态和模型误设下显著优于参数化方法和经验风险最小化。
AI.research_question: 在决策依赖删失（lost sales不可观测）的条件下，如何通过特征信息直接学习最优订货量的条件分位数？
AI.motivation: 传统报童模型在删失数据下无法使用共轭更新，参数化方法存在误设偏差，而直接最小化经验风险在删失下表现不佳。需要一种在删失下仍然一致且校准的分位数学习方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生成贝叶斯计算（GBC）；生存/密度似然分解；分位数回归；条件校准；模型误设下的偏差分析。
AI.method: 将决策依赖删失嵌入前向模拟器，通过生存/密度分裂保留似然信息；使用GBC直接学习预测分布的分位数，无需共轭更新；通过模拟实验验证参数化插件、GBC和经验风险最小化三种方法的绩效。
AI.findings: （1）参数化插件在模型误设下存在O(1)的分位数偏差；（2）GBC方法具有一致性且条件校准；（3）在正确模型下，GBC与贝叶斯最优规则相当，二者比经验风险最小化降低一个数量级的遗憾；（4）在多模态需求下，GBC是唯一校准的规则，遗憾比参数化插件降低2.7倍，且优势随多模态程度单调增长至近4倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了决策依赖删失下参数插件存在O(1)分位数偏差的理论事实；证明了灵活生成式预测的一致性及其条件校准性质；建立了“决策是预测分布的光滑泛函”这一结构性洞察。
AI.practical_contributions: 为特征驱动的库存管理提供了一种在删失数据下可操作且鲁棒的决策方法；实验证明了GBC在多模态需求等复杂场景下显著优于现有方法，具有实际应用价值。

title: Scalable Linear Bayes Prediction for Mixtures of Experts and LLMs
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business, George Mason University and

detail.title: Scalable Linear Bayes Prediction for Mixtures of Experts and LLMs
detail.abstract: A companion paper shows that Bayes Linear (BL) estimation and cross-fitted prediction-powered inference (Cross-PPI) solve the same Kalman-gain equation, differing only in whether the effective prior precision comes from a subjective elicitation V −1 0 or the information matrix N −1X ⊤ u Xu of an unlabelled pool. This paper extends that duality to dynamic, non-Gaussian, and large-scale settings, and uses it to explain—and quantitatively demonstrate—why sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training of large language models (LLMs) is efficient. We prove four results. First, the Ensemble Kalman Filter (EnKF, Evensen, 1994) is BL applied sequentially with a Monte Carlo prior; we bound its excess risk relative to the exact Kalman filter as O(p/M) in ensemble size M and confirm the rate numerically. Second, the Bengtsson–Snyder–Nychka (BSN) mixture filter (Bengtsson et al., 2003) extends the EnKF to non-Gaussian forecasts via a Gaussian mixture with per-component Kalman updates; we prove it degenerates gracefully to the EnKF under unimodality, and—new to this paper—prove a threshold theorem identifying exactly when the mixture helps and when it hurts, governed by the ratio of observation noise to modal separation. A controlled experiment confirms the predicted crossover: a 40% error reduction under weak observations reverses to a 41% increase under strong observations.
