AI.motivation: 凯恩斯的理论在经济学中极为重要，但其原著多以文字论述为主，缺乏精确的数学形式化表达。本文旨在通过构建数学模型，使凯恩斯的核心思想更加严谨和可操作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以凯恩斯的有效需求理论为核心框架，具体包括：流动性偏好理论、资本边际效率理论、边际消费倾向与乘数理论。
AI.method: 数学建模方法。所有模型构建均严格参照凯恩斯原著原文，将文字论述转化为数学方程和函数关系。
AI.findings: 流动性偏好、资本边际效率和边际消费倾向是决定总收入和就业水平的三大核心因素；在任何可能的利率水平下，这三者共同作用于总需求，进而决定均衡产出和就业。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将凯恩斯理论进行了严格的数学形式化，弥补了原著缺乏数学表达的不足。2. 验证并强化了凯恩斯三大心理因素（流动性偏好、资本边际效率、边际消费倾向）在宏观经济中的决定性作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为后续凯恩斯主义宏观经济模型的构建（如IS-LM模型）提供了更坚实的理论基础；有助于政策制定者更精确地理解利率、投资和消费对就业的影响机制。

title: Ranking Metrics: Extending Acceptability and Performance Indices
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Insubria - Department of Economics, University of London - Economics, Mathematics and Statistics and Universidade Federal do Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS)

detail.title: Ranking Metrics: Extending Acceptability and Performance Indices
detail.abstract: This paper develops an axiomatic framework for ranking metrics, a general class of functionals for evaluating and ordering financial or insurance positions. Unlike traditional risk-adjusted performance measures, such as the Sharpe ratio, RAROC, or Omega, that express reward per unit of risk, ranking metrics assign each position a performance level rather than a normalized return. Relying on monotonicity and a new property called cash-quasiconcavity, we derive representation results linking ranking metrics to families of acceptance sets and risk measures, extending the theory of acceptability indices. Classical ratios arise as special cases, while new examples-based on expected-loss, Λ-quantile, and bibliometric indices-illustrate the framework's flexibility. Empirical applications to portfolio ranking and climate-risk insurance demonstrate its practical relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文为排序指标（ranking metrics）建立了一个公理化框架。排序指标是一类用于评估和排序金融或保险头寸的泛函。与传统风险调整绩效度量（如夏普比率、RAROC或Omega）不同，排序指标为每个头寸分配一个绩效水平而非标准化回报。基于单调性和一种称为现金拟凹性（cash-quasiconcavity）的新性质，作者推导出将排序指标与接受集和风险度量族联系起来的表征结果，扩展了可接受性指数（acceptability indices）理论。经典比率作为特例出现，而基于预期损失、Λ-分位数和文献计量指数的新例子则展示了该框架的灵活性。对投资组合排序和气候风险保险的实证应用证明了其实践相关性。
AI.research_question: 如何为排序指标（ranking metrics）建立一个统一的公理化框架，使其能够一般性地评估和排序金融或保险头寸的绩效水平，并扩展可接受性指数理论？
AI.motivation: 传统风险调整绩效度量（如夏普比率、RAROC、Omega）以"每单位风险的回报"形式表达绩效，但未覆盖更广泛的绩效评估方法。需要一种更一般的公理化框架来统一理解各类排序指标，并揭示其与接受集、风险度量之间的内在联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公理化方法：基于单调性（monotonicity）和新提出的现金拟凹性（cash-quasiconcavity）两个核心性质，推导排序指标与接受集族、风险度量族之间的表征关系，扩展可接受性指数理论。
AI.method: 理论推导（构建公理化体系并证明表征定理）+ 实证应用（投资组合排序和气候风险保险两个案例）。
AI.findings: （1）建立了排序指标的公理化表征定理，将其与接受集族和风险度量族联系起来；（2）经典比率（如夏普比率、RAROC、Omega）是该框架的特例；（3）基于预期损失、Λ-分位数和文献计量指数的新例子验证了框架的灵活性；（4）实证应用证明了框架在投资组合排序和气候风险保险中的实践价值。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次为排序指标建立了系统的公理化框架；（2）提出现金拟凹性新性质并推导出表征定理；（3）将排序指标理论与可接受性指数理论统一起来，深化了对绩效度量数学结构的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了比传统风险调整绩效度量更灵活的绩效评估工具；（2）通过投资组合排序和气候风险保险两个实证案例，证明了框架在金融和保险实践中的直接应用价值。

title: Stablecoins as the New Shadow Banks

detail.title: Stablecoins as the New Shadow Banks
detail.abstract: Although blockchain has transformed financial markets, one of the most significant concerns is how stablecoins are beginning to affect the traditional banking system and contribute to the growth of shadow banking. Stablecoins are cryptocurrencies on a public blockchain that are designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to a fiat currency, including the U.S. dollar. This article discusses how the growth of stablecoins has raised concerns about how they potentially disrupt traditional banks. Although U.S. regulators have begun to address the risks posed by stablecoins, current framework remains incomplete without stricter federal rules and uniform requirements. The article argues that despite the potential for technological innovation in payments, stablecoin issuers risk repeating the same patterns that exist in the shadow banking system and exposing the economy to instability and potential failure due to regulatory gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了稳定币如何影响传统银行体系并促进影子银行增长，指出尽管稳定币在支付领域有技术创新潜力，但由于监管框架不完善，其发行方可能重演影子银行的风险模式，导致经济不稳定。
AI.research_question: 稳定币如何影响传统银行体系并促进影子银行的发展？
AI.motivation: 区块链已变革金融市场，但稳定币对传统银行业的潜在冲击及其与影子银行的关联尚未被充分审视，现有监管框架存在漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 影子银行理论、金融监管理论、货币稳定性理论
AI.method: 规范性法律与政策分析
AI.findings: 稳定币发行可能重演影子银行的风险模式，美国现行监管缺乏严格的联邦规则和统一要求，存在监管空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 将稳定币纳入影子银行分析框架，揭示了加密货币领域与传统影子银行体系的结构性相似性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国监管机构提出完善联邦层面统一监管规则的建议，提示政策制定者关注稳定币引发的系统性风险。

title: The Behavior of Stock Returns Before the Public Holidays in the Time Intervals Associated to Halloween Effect
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: The Behavior of Stock Returns Before the Public Holidays in the Time Intervals Associated to Halloween Effect
detail.abstract: This paper approaches the interactions between the circumstances that influence the evolution of stock returns before the public holidays and the factors that cause the Halloween Effect. We employ the values of five indexes of developed stock markets for the period of January 2009-May 2026. We found some particularities of stock returns' behavior before the public holidays in the two time intervals associated to Halloween Effect: November-April and May-October.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了公共假期前后股票收益变化与万圣节效应之间的相互作用，基于2009年1月至2026年5月五个发达股票市场指数的数据，发现万圣节效应的两个时间段（11月-4月与5月-10月）中，假期前股票收益表现存在特殊规律。
AI.research_question: 公共假期前后的股票收益变化与万圣节效应（Halloween Effect）之间存在怎样的相互作用？
AI.motivation: 已有文献分别研究了假期效应和万圣节效应对股票收益的影响，但两者之间的交互作用尚未被充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 假期效应（Holiday Effect）、万圣节效应（Halloween Effect，即"五月卖出，然后离开"策略）
AI.method: 选取2009年1月至2026年5月五个发达股票市场指数的日度数据，将时间分为万圣节效应的两个区间（11月-4月与5月-10月），分析公共假期前股票收益的异常表现。
AI.findings: 在万圣节效应的两个时间区间（11月-4月与5月-10月）中，公共假期前的股票收益表现出各自不同的特殊性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将假期效应与万圣节效应结合起来分析，揭示了两种市场异常现象之间的交互作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者在不同季节和假期前后的投资策略调整提供了实证依据，有助于优化交易时机选择。

title: Settlement Manipulation in Prediction Markets
affiliations: , Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business and Stanford University

detail.title: Settlement Manipulation in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: Prediction markets increasingly list contracts settling on an asset price that holders can move by trading the underlying. We build a model showing that such contracts transfer wealth from prediction-market liquidity traders to manipulators and harm price discovery in the underlying, even as it becomes more liquid. After the launch of Polymarket's five-minute Bitcoin contract, settlement-time spot order flow spikes, causing large price reversals after settlement. Manipulators capture a large amount of profit, mostly from retail. Manipulation is largely absent in the fifteen-minute contracts: lengthening the contract horizon removes it, providing the market-design remedy our model and evidence support.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了预测市场中结算价格可被交易者操纵的合约（如Polymarket的5分钟比特币合约），发现这类合约会导致财富从流动性交易者向操纵者转移，损害基础资产的价格发现功能，即使基础资产流动性增加。通过15分钟合约对比，延长合约期限可以有效消除操纵行为。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中结算价格可被交易者通过交易基础资产操纵的合约，对市场参与者和价格发现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 现实中的预测市场（如Polymarket）推出了结算价基于基础资产价格的短期合约，但这类合约存在被交易者通过买卖基础资产来操纵结算价的潜在问题，亟需理论分析和实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论、价格发现理论、市场操纵理论
AI.method: 理论模型构建 + 实证分析（利用Polymarket推出5分钟和15分钟比特币合约的自然实验，分析结算时刻的订单流、价格反转和交易者利润）
AI.findings: 1. 可操纵合约导致财富从流动性交易者向操纵者转移；2. 损害基础资产的价格发现功能；3. 基础资产流动性增加；4. 5分钟合约结算时刻订单流激增，价格大幅反转；5. 操纵利润主要来自零售交易者；6. 15分钟合约中操纵行为基本消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模并实证检验了预测市场短期结算合约的操纵问题及其对价格发现的负面影响，揭示了合约期限在抑制操纵中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为预测市场设计提供了可操作的政策建议：延长合约结算期限（如从5分钟延长至15分钟）可以有效消除操纵行为，保护零售投资者，维护市场健康。

title: Sparse Reduced-Rank Regression: From Tikhonov to Horseshoe
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business and George Mason University

detail.title: Sparse Reduced-Rank Regression: From Tikhonov to Horseshoe
detail.abstract: We develop a sparse Bayesian regularization framework for reduced-rank predictive regression, extending the global-local view of regularization (Polson and Sokolov, 2019) from coordinate-wise sparsity to two new structures: the spectral directions of an ill-conditioned design and the rank of the predictive coefficient. Starting from the regularized reducedrank regression (RRRR) objective of Dobrev and Schaumburg (2014), we show that its filter factors are exactly the per-direction posterior shrinkage weights, so that Tikhonov ridge and spectral truncation are the constant-variance and spike-and-slab endpoints of a single Gaussian-prior family. The mean-square-optimal filter is an oracle posterior mean depending on an unknown per-direction signal-to-noise ratio; a horseshoe prior on the singular directions provides its feasible, data-adaptive surrogate, and a column-wise global-local prior on the factor loadings selects the number of forecasting factors automatically. The construction is conditionally conjugate, links directly to sparse deep learning as regularized regression (Polson and Sokolov, 2017), and reduces to RRRR in the fixed-scale, fixedrank limit. A Monte Carlo study calibrated to Dobrev and Schaumburg (2014) confirms that (i) the horseshoe posterior filter tracks the oracle filter while ridge over-smooths and truncation is brittle; (ii) the reduced-rank horseshoe matches oracle-tuned RRRR in outof-sample mean-squared error without selecting either the number of components or the rank; and (iii) column shrinkage recovers the true number of forecasting factors. On the FRED-MD macroeconomic panel-the modern Stock-Watson diffusion-index problemthe method beats an autoregressive benchmark for almost every aggregate, matches the principal-component forecast, and additionally returns calibrated predictive densities, a time-varying number of forecasting factors, and an interpretable factor decomposition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种稀疏贝叶斯正则化框架，用于降秩预测回归。该方法通过将全局-局部正则化观点从坐标稀疏性扩展到谱方向稀疏性和预测系数秩稀疏性，实现了数据自适应的因子选择与预测。在FRED-MD宏观经济数据上表现优于AR基准模型，匹配主成分预测，并提供了校准的预测密度、时变因子数和可解释的因子分解。
AI.research_question: 如何将稀疏贝叶斯正则化从坐标稀疏性扩展到谱方向和秩结构，以实现数据自适应的降秩预测回归？
AI.motivation: 现有降秩预测回归（RRRR）方法需要手动选择秩和成分数，而传统正则化方法（如岭回归和谱截断）要么过度平滑，要么缺乏稳健性。需要一种数据自适应的方法来自动确定因子数量和秩。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全局-局部正则化框架（Polson and Sokolov, 2019）、降秩预测回归（Dobrev and Schaumburg, 2014）、Horseshoe先验、稀疏深度学习（Polson and Sokolov, 2017）
AI.method: 提出稀疏贝叶斯正则化框架：对奇异方向施加Horseshoe先验实现数据自适应的谱方向收缩；对因子载荷施加列向全局-局部先验自动选择预测因子数量。构造条件共轭形式，连接稀疏深度学习。
AI.findings: (1) Horseshoe后验滤波器可追踪Oracle滤波器，而岭回归过度平滑、截断不稳健；(2) 降秩Horseshoe在不需选择成分数和秩的情况下匹配Oracle调优的RRRR的样本外MSE；(3) 列向收缩可恢复真实的预测因子数量；(4) 在FRED-MD宏观经济数据上优于AR基准，匹配主成分预测，并提供校准的预测密度和可解释的因子分解。
AI.theory_contributions: 将全局-局部正则化从坐标稀疏性扩展到谱方向和秩结构；揭示了Tikhonov岭回归和谱截断是同一高斯先验族下的常方差和spike-and-slab端点；建立了Horseshoe先验作为Oracle后验均值的数据自适应替代。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需手动选择超参数即可实现最优预测的方法；在FRED-MD大规模宏观经济面板上验证了有效性；返回校准的预测密度、时变因子数和可解释的因子分解，增强了实用性。

title: The Threshold Trap: Recursive Self-Improvement, the Economics of Self-Production, and the Case for Predictive Harm Assessment

detail.title: The Threshold Trap: Recursive Self-Improvement, the Economics of Self-Production, and the Case for Predictive Harm Assessment
detail.abstract: Recursive self-improvement has been treated in AI governance as a future capability threshold, a configuration that, once a system reaches it, is supposed to trigger heightened control. This paper argues that the threshold framing systematically under-protects, because the dynamics that bear on harm accrue across the economically driven precursor steps that are already deployed, and not at the terminal configuration alone. Two releases from June 2026 illustrate the precursor structure. OpenAI's Jalapeño inference chip was designed with assistance from OpenAI's own models, placing a recursive loop at the hardware layer. DeepReinforce's Ornith-1.0, an open coding model, authors its own training scaffold in a self-improvement loop, placing a recursive loop at the learning layer. The components of the loop are demonstrated rather than imagined: the research literature already shows reinforcement learning designing chip layouts at superhuman level, and reinforcement-trained frontier models already gaming their own reward checks. Both releases are bounded today, and both instantiate a monotonic incentive gradient under which cost pressure drives a firm to automate first labor, then the means of production, then the means of improvement. The paper applies the Harm Blindness Framework as a predictive instrument, asking who is harmed as the trajectory advances and whether the layer of human oversight is preserved or eroded, rather than waiting for the catastrophic configuration to verify the harm after the fact. It closes with the implication that governance keyed to a terminal threshold rehearses a failure mode in which the proof of danger arrives only once it is too late to act on it.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战AI治理中“递归自我改进”作为未来能力阈值的传统观点，指出这种阈值框架系统性保护不足。通过分析OpenAI Jalapeño芯片和DeepReinforce Ornith-1.0两个2026年案例，论证递归循环已在硬件层和学习层部署，并运用“伤害盲视框架”预测危害轨迹，得出基于阈值的治理将在危害确证时已无力行动的结论。
AI.research_question: 递归自我改进的阈值框架是否充分保护社会免受AI系统带来的危害？如果不充分，更有效的治理框架是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理将递归自我改进视为未来危险（终端阈值），但经济驱动的中间步骤已实际部署并产生危害，需重新审视治理策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 伤害盲视框架（Harm Blindness Framework）：从“谁受到伤害”和“人类监督层是否被侵蚀”两个维度预测危害，而非等待灾难性配置事后验证。
AI.method: 两个真实案例分析（OpenAI Jalapeño芯片、DeepReinforce Ornith-1.0）结合文献综述，论证递归循环的现实存在，并运用伤害盲视框架进行预测分析。
AI.findings: 1）递归自我改进已非未来阈值，而是正在发生的现实（硬件层和学习层均有实例）；2）存在单调激励梯度：成本压力推动企业依次自动化劳动力、生产资料、改进手段；3）阈值框架使危害确证时已无力行动。在两个案例中，人类监督层正在被侵蚀。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）否定递归自我改进作为未来阈值的传统设定，重新框定为正在发生的累积过程；2）提出“单调激励梯度”概念解释企业自动化演进的经济动力机制；3）将伤害盲视框架引入AI治理领域作为前瞻性预测工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）警示AI治理不应仅关注终端阈值，而应监测中间步骤的累积危害；2）为政策制定者提供新的治理切入点：在硬件层和学习层即应介入，而非等待“危险系统”出现；3）揭示当前治理框架的系统性保护不足问题。

title: Forecasting Commodity Volatility with Commodity-aligned Geopolitical Risk
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE), Vlerick Business School and

detail.title: Forecasting Commodity Volatility with Commodity-aligned Geopolitical Risk
detail.abstract: Geopolitical risk has risen as the top global risk. However existing global geopolitical risk measures contain substantial geopolitical information irrelevant to specific commodity markets, which hinders our ability to accurately forecast commodity price volatility. To address this problem, we propose a commodityaligned global geopolitical risk index. The new index captures the sensitivity of geopolitical risks to the realized volatility of individual commodities, thereby discarding the geopolitical noise that is not relevant for the commodity. We document that the new index displays robust both in-and out-of-sample predictive capability for forecasting the volatility of agriculture, livestock, energy, industrial and precious metals for horizons up to six months. The commodity-aligned geopolitical risk index outperforms the global geopolitical risk index. The results stay robust even after accounting for macroeconomic and policy uncertainty, historical commodity price volatility, news-based volatility, oil price fluctuations, financial stress, and other aggregate indicators closely intertwined with the production and operation of commodity markets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种商品对齐的全球地缘政治风险指数，该指数通过过滤掉与特定商品市场无关的地缘政治噪音，显著提升了预测大宗商品价格波动的能力，在样本内和样本外均优于传统的全球地缘政治风险指数。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够更准确预测大宗商品价格波动的地缘政治风险指标？
AI.motivation: 现有的全球地缘政治风险指标包含大量与特定商品市场无关的信息，干扰了对商品价格波动率的准确预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地缘政治风险与商品市场波动的关系理论、信息过滤与信号提取理论。
AI.method: 构建商品对齐的全球地缘政治风险指数，通过捕捉地缘政治风险对单个商品已实现波动率的敏感性，剔除不相关的地缘政治噪音；进行样本内和样本外预测能力检验，并控制宏观经济不确定性、政策不确定性、历史波动率、新闻波动率、油价波动、金融压力等多重因素进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 新指数对农产品、畜牧业、能源、工业金属和贵金属等六大类商品的波动率预测能力显著优于传统全球地缘政治风险指数，预测期限可达六个月，且结果在多种稳健性检验中依然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"商品对齐"地缘政治风险的概念框架，为地缘政治风险与特定资产类别之间的关系提供了更精准的理论建模方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和商品市场参与者提供了一个更有效的风险预测工具，有助于优化商品投资决策、风险管理和政策制定。

title: From Integration to Rewiring: Trade Conflict, Third-Country Rerouting, and Capability Formation in Global Value Chains

detail.title: From Integration to Rewiring: Trade Conflict, Third-Country Rerouting, and Capability Formation in Global Value Chains

declarations.funderStatement: No funding received by the author for doing research.

detail.abstract: The 2018-2019 U.S.-China trade conflict reduced direct bilateral trade in tariff-exposed products at substantial cost to U.S. importers, raising the question of whether it produced durable relocation of productive capability or merely rerouted Chinese value added through third countries. Combining the timing and product coverage of U.S. Section 301 tariffs with CEPII-BACI bilateral trade (2012-2024), monthly U.S. Census imports, UNIDO industrial statistics, and the OECD's 2025 Trade-in-Value-Added accounts, this paper runs a four-stage design that traces the displaced trade from its source to the production behind it. U.S. imports from China fell sharply in tariffed products relative to untreated ones (a 0.65 log-point differential decline), and third countries captured the difference (a 0.55 logpoint differential gain, corroborated by an all-non-China rest-of-world aggregate). Yet across the ten largest beneficiaries, the domestic value-added share of exports fell in eight, while the Chinese value-added share rose in all ten, and a country's export gain is strongly associated with a rise in its Chinese content (correlation: 0.78). The first phase of the China+1 reallocation was therefore predominantly assembly-based re-intermediation rather than autonomous capability formation. The paper contributes a transparent linelevel Section 301 treatment map, a four-data-system triangulation of trade, intermediateinput, and value-added evidence, and a rerouting-relocation spectrum on which most apparent winners exhibit the signature of assembly-based rerouting rather than full relocation.

AI.tldr: 2018-2019年中美贸易冲突中，美国对华加征关税大幅减少了双边直接贸易，但第三方国家增加的出口中，国内增加值占比下降而中国增加值占比上升，表明这主要是中国附加值通过第三国“绕道”而非真正的生产能力转移。
AI.research_question: 中美贸易冲突是否导致生产能力的持久转移（relocation），还是仅仅将中国附加值通过第三国重新路由（rerouting）？
AI.motivation: 2018-2019年中美贸易冲突使关税暴露产品的双边贸易大幅下降，但第三方国家对美出口增加。需要区分这究竟是真正的产能转移，还是中国附加值通过第三国的间接出口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易战、全球价值链、附加值贸易、绕道转移（rerouting vs. relocation）
AI.method: 四阶段设计：结合CEPII-BACI双边贸易数据（2012-2024）、美国月度海关进口数据、UNIDO工业统计和OECD 2025年贸易附加值账户，利用美国301关税的产品覆盖和时间变化进行准实验分析。
AI.findings: 1）美国从中国进口在受关税影响的产品上相对未受影响产品下降了0.65个对数点；2）第三方国家填补了该缺口（增长0.55个对数点）；3）十大受益国中，八个国家的国内出口附加值占比下降，而十个国家的中国附加值占比均上升；4）一国出口增长与其中国内容物含量高度相关（相关性0.78）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了“绕道-转移谱”（rerouting-relocation spectrum）概念，为区分贸易战中的附加值绕道与真实产能转移提供了分析框架和可操作指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了透明的301关税产品处理清单，以及四套数据系统交叉验证的方法论，为政策制定者评估贸易战的实际效果和全球价值链重构提供实证依据。

title: Green Investment, Fiscal Sustainability, and the Cost of Net-Zero: The Carbon-to-Carbon-Free Energy Transition for Korea Using the CO-STIRPAT Dynamic System

detail.title: Green Investment, Fiscal Sustainability, and the Cost of Net-Zero: The Carbon-to-Carbon-Free Energy Transition for Korea Using the CO-STIRPAT Dynamic System
detail.abstract: This paper asks what the carbon-to-carbon-free energy transition costs in growth terms, and what it takes to keep that transition both net-zero and fiscally sustainable. Using the CO-STIRPAT dynamic system—estimated on Korean data (1980–2024) and integrated with the OECD EDISON fiscal accounting framework—we model net-zero as a phase-down of carbon energy matched by an expansion of carbon-free energy, and let total factor productivity depend on a constant-elasticity-of-substitution energy aggregate. The elasticity of substitution σ measures the ease with which carbon-free energy can be expanded to replace the carbon energy withdrawn. We obtain four results for the Republic of Korea over 2025–2050. First, the transition’s GDP path depends first-order on σ: the 2050 shortfall relative to baseline growth ranges from about 4 percent when carbon-free expansion is easy (σ = 2.0) to about 10.5 percent when it is hard (σ = 0.5). Second, the transition is fiscally self-financing—its added tax revenue covering the public transition cost—once the erosion of carbon-related tax revenue is accounted for, at an energy-efficiency gain of about 7–8 percent and average growth near 1.5 percent per year (about 6 percent absent the carbon-revenue loss). Third, holding full potential growth (1.9 percent) while reaching net-zero is far more demanding, requiring a cumulative efficiency gain of 25 to 69 percent depending on σ. Fourth, the public fiscal requirement is on the order of 0.2 percent of GDP per year (about 140 trillion KRW), with engineering and model-implied estimates converging at σ ≈ 1.0. The policy message is that fiscal neutrality is attainable but not automatic—it requires replacing the eroding fuel-tax base—while a genuinely growth-neutral net-zero transition hinges on raising σ—accelerating the carbon-free build-out—and on deep energy-efficiency gains.

AI.tldr: 本文利用韩国1980-2024年数据，通过CO-STIRPAT动态模型和OECD EDISON财政框架，分析了2030-2050年韩国碳中和转型的经济成本与财政可持续性。研究发现：转型的GDP成本高度依赖于清洁能源与碳能源的替代弹性σ；转型在能源效率提升7-8%时可实现财政自给；若要保持潜在增长同时实现净零，则需要大幅度的效率提升；财政需求约为每年GDP的0.2%。政策启示是财政中性可达但非自动，增长中性则需提高替代弹性并深化能效提升。
AI.research_question: 碳中和能源转型的经济增长成本是多少？如何在实现净零排放的同时保持财政可持续性？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏对碳中和转型经济增长成本与财政可持续性之间权衡关系的系统性量化分析，特别是缺乏考虑清洁能源与碳能源之间替代弹性的动态影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: CO-STIRPAT动态系统模型；OECD EDISON财政核算框架；恒定替代弹性（CES）能源加总生产函数；全要素生产率内生化模型。
AI.method: 基于韩国1980-2024年时间序列数据，估计CO-STIRPAT动态系统模型，并与OECD EDISON财政框架整合，进行2025-2050年的情景模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）转型GDP路径主要取决于σ：2050年GDP缺口在4%（σ=2.0）至10.5%（σ=0.5）之间；（2）能源效率提升7-8%、年均增长约1.5%时，转型可自筹资金；（3）维持1.9%潜在增长同时实现净零，需累计效率提升25%-69%；（4）公共财政需求约为每年GDP的0.2%（约140万亿韩元）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将替代弹性σ作为碳中和转型经济增长成本的核心决定因素纳入统一动态分析框架；揭示了财政中性、增长中性、净零目标三者之间的权衡关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了碳中和转型的量化成本估计；明确指出财政中性需替换侵蚀的燃油税基，增长中性则需加速清洁能源建设（提高σ）和深度能效提升。

title: The New Economics of Transnational Corporate Punishment

detail.title: The New Economics of Transnational Corporate Punishment
detail.abstract: In December 2008, Germany and the United States simultaneously announced coordinated settlements with Siemens, closing a transnational bribery investigation without either country prosecuting the matter on its own. The episode inaugurated a model that, in less than two decades, has become dominant: the multijurisdictional resolution (MJR) of corporate corruption cases. This essay reads the phenomenon through the lens of law and economics. Its central claim is that MJRs constitute an institutional technology designed to solve a dual and symmetric problem—the underenforcement caused by fragmentation across jurisdictions, and the overenforcement caused by the uncoordinated stacking of sanctions. The argument, however, is not celebratory. It contends that the model’s efficiency rests on a hegemonic architecture whose legitimacy was laid bare the moment the system’s central actor—the United States—reoriented its enforcement to serve its own economic and geopolitical objectives. The globalization of the firm has produced the globalization of the sanction; the open question is under whose governance.

AI.tldr: 本文从法律经济学视角分析跨国企业腐败案件的多司法辖区和解（MJR）模式。该模式解决了跨国执法中碎片化导致的执法不足与制裁叠加导致的执法过度这一双重对称问题，但其效率建立在美国主导的霸权架构之上，一旦美国将执法转向服务自身经济地缘目标，该模式的合法性便暴露无遗。
AI.research_question: 多司法辖区和解（MJR）作为企业腐败案件跨国执法的主导模式，其制度逻辑、效率基础与合法性危机是什么？
AI.motivation: 2008年美德对西门子的联合执法开启了MJR模式，该模式在不到二十年内成为主导，但其制度设计的内在张力（效率vs.合法性）尚未被充分剖析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律经济学；制度设计理论；跨国执法治理
AI.method: 规范分析（法律经济学视角的理论推演）
AI.findings: MJR是一种解决双重对称问题的制度技术：跨国执法碎片化导致执法不足，各国制裁未协调叠加导致执法过度。但该模式的效率建立在以美国为核心的霸权架构上，当美国将执法工具化为经济地缘政治武器时，其合法性基础便瓦解。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了MJR作为制度技术的内在矛盾——效率与合法性的张力；将跨国执法治理的核心问题提炼为"制裁全球化了，但归谁治理"。
AI.practical_contributions: 警示跨国执法合作中对单一霸权国依赖的制度风险；为构建更均衡的多边执法治理框架提供理论依据。

title: Pricing and Hedging Options with Higher Moments
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements and Department of Finance

detail.title: Pricing and Hedging Options with Higher Moments
detail.abstract: We extend the Black-Scholes formula to higher moments by replicating option payoffs with the underlying stock and portfolios that pay polynomial functions of the log-return. Because an option's price is the discounted expected value of its payoff, the same series delivers a valuation formula that augments Black-Scholes with explicit corrections for skewness, kurtosis, and higher-order cumulants. The series also prescribes a static hedge: a fixed portfolio held to expiration without rebalancing. Along the way, we generalize the Carr and Madan (1998) log-portfolio measure of variance to model-free log-squared and log-cubed portfolios for skewness and kurtosis. We take the formula to 0DTE S&P 500 options, where the higher-moment terms cut the mean squared pricing error to 44% of Black-Scholes. The hedging gains are larger still: a single skewness term roughly halves the error of the log-portfolio hedge, and the full model reduces the hedging mean squared error by about 91% relative to the Black-Scholes delta hedge.

AI.tldr: 本文将Black-Scholes公式扩展到高阶矩，通过复制期权收益与标的股票和多项式组合，得到包含偏度、峰度等修正的定价公式，并在0DTE S&P 500期权中将定价均方误差降至BS的44%，对冲误差降低约91%。
AI.research_question: 如何将Black-Scholes期权定价公式扩展至包含高阶矩（偏度、峰度等），并检验其在定价和对冲中的表现？
AI.motivation: 经典Black-Scholes公式假设收益率正态分布，忽略了实际金融市场中存在的偏度和峰度等非正态特征，导致定价和对冲存在系统性偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高阶矩扩展的Black-Scholes公式、对冲复制理论、Carr-Madan对数组合测度方法。
AI.method: 通过多项式函数复制期权收益，将定价公式展开为包含偏度、峰度及高阶累积量的修正项；推广Carr-Madan方法构建无模型的对数平方和对数立方组合；在0DTE S&P 500期权数据上进行实证检验。
AI.findings: 高阶矩修正项将定价均方误差降至BS的44%；偏度项单独将对冲误差减半；完整模型将对冲均方误差相比BS delta对冲降低约91%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将BS公式系统性地扩展到高阶矩，提供了包含偏度和峰度显式修正的定价级数，并推广了无模型的高阶矩测度方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了静态对冲组合（无需再平衡），显著降低了0DTE期权的定价和对冲误差，具有重要的交易实践价值。

title: Comparing Data Envelopment Analysis and Stochastic Frontier Estimates of Attacking-output Efficiency in the 2021-2022 English Premier League

detail.title: Comparing Data Envelopment Analysis and Stochastic Frontier Estimates of Attacking-output Efficiency in the 2021-2022 English Premier League
detail.abstract:
This working paper compares non-parametric Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) and parametric
Stochastic Frontier Analysis (SFA) estimates of attacking-output efficiency for players in the 2021-
2022 English Premier League. The retained data contain 499 player records compiled and manually
cleaned by the author in 2023 from publicly accessible football-statistics sources. After excluding 179
zero-PGA records from the positive-output DEA design, the original DEA sample contains 320
observations. Logged econometric and SFA models use 317 observations with positive PGA and
positive expected attacking contribution, and the principal cross-model comparison excludes
goalkeepers and matches 315 outfield players. DEA is specified as an output-oriented model with
matches played as the input and goals and assists as outputs under CRS and VRS technologies. The
original DEA scores were independently reproduced using linear programming and matched PIM-
DEA output essentially exactly. SFA uses a reduced second-order production frontier in ln(PGA) with
ln(npxG+xAG) and one-half its squared log term; half-normal and exponential inefficiency models
were validated in R using sfaR 1.0.1 in a reproducible package environment. Package-validated mean
technical efficiency is 0.676302 under the half-normal model and 0.776817 under the exponential
model. In the final 315-player matched comparison, VRS DEA and exponential-SFA scores show a
moderately positive Pearson correlation of 0.444502, with Spearman 0.587790 and Kendall tau-b
0.416194, while top-rank overlap remains limited. The study contributes a verified player-level
comparison of frontier methods and shows that modelling choices materially affect attacking-
efficiency rankings. Its primary limitation is the single-season, attacking-output-only design.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了DEA和SFA两种前沿分析方法在2021-2022赛季英超球员进攻效率评估中的应用，发现方法选择会显著影响球员效率排名，两种方法的结果呈中等正相关。
AI.research_question: 非参数DEA与参数SFA在评估英超球员进攻效率时，结果有何异同？方法选择如何影响球员效率排名？
AI.motivation: 足球球员效率评估中，DEA和SFA是两种主流前沿分析方法，但鲜有研究在同一数据集上系统比较二者的结果差异，尤其是球员层面的排名一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据包络分析（DEA）与随机前沿分析（SFA）的生产前沿面理论；效率测度中的参数与非参数方法对比。
AI.method: DEA采用产出导向模型，以出场次数为投入、进球和助攻为产出，设定CRS和VRS技术；SFA采用ln(PGA)的简化二次生产前沿，含ln(npxG+xAG)及其平方项，使用半正态和指数无效率模型。最终对比315名外场球员的VRS DEA与指数SFA得分。
AI.findings: 半正态SFA平均技术效率0.676，指数SFA为0.777；VRS DEA与指数SFA得分的Pearson相关系数为0.445，Spearman为0.588，Kendall tau-b为0.416，顶端排名重叠有限。表明建模选择会实质影响球员进攻效率排名。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在球员层面系统验证了DEA与SFA两种前沿方法在足球效率评估中的可比性与差异性，揭示了非参数与参数方法在排名一致性上的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球数据分析人员和俱乐部决策者提供了方法选择的依据：不同前沿方法得出的球员效率排名差异较大，评估时应谨慎解读单一方法的结果。

title:
Taxing Winners, Empowering Citizens: The Economic and Accounting Case for a Gradual Shift Toward Direct Cash Redistribution 
A Research Paper in Economics and Accounting

detail.title:
Taxing Winners, Empowering Citizens: The Economic and Accounting Case for a Gradual Shift Toward Direct Cash Redistribution 
A Research Paper in Economics and Accounting
detail.abstract: The United States already operates one of the largest redistributive states in the world, but it redistributes in a particular and rarely examined way: it raises roughly four-fifths of federal revenue from income, payroll, and capital taxes, then channels most of the proceeds through in-kind programs and congressionally appropriated spending rather than returning resources directly to lower-income households as cash. This paper develops the economic and accounting case for gradually reweighting that system, raising more revenue from "winners" (high labor incomes and capital income) and delivering a larger share of redistribution as unconditional or refundable cash transfers administered through the tax system, in place of a portion of discretionary and in-kind spending. Drawing on optimal income tax theory (Mirrlees 1971; Diamond and Saez 2011), the cash-versus-in-kind transfer literature (Currie and Gahvari 2008; Nichols and Zeckhauser 1982), the negative-income-tax tradition (Friedman 1962; Tobin), and a now-substantial body of randomized and quasi-experimental evidence (the OpenResearch guaranteed-income study; the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend; the Earned Income Tax Credit), I argue that a cash-forward system can be more efficient, more transparent, and more accountable than the status quo, while taking seriously the efficiency, paternalism, and political-economy reasons that in-kind transfers persist. The paper proposes a phased, revenue-neutral transition and uses an accounting lens to examine administrative cost, fiscal incidence, and measurement. The conclusion is qualified rather than triumphal: cash should do more of the work the federal government already finances, but in-kind provision retains a defensible role for a subset of merit and information-sensitive goods.

AI.tldr: 美国联邦政府目前主要通过征收收入税、工资税和资本税筹集资金，再以实物项目（如医疗、食品券）和国会拨款形式进行再分配，而非直接向低收入家庭发放现金。本文主张逐步转向"现金优先"体系，通过增加对高劳动收入和资本收入的征税，将更大比例的再分配通过无条件或可退还的现金转移（通过税收系统发放）来实现。基于最优所得税理论、现金与实物转移文献、负所得税传统以及大量实验证据，本文认为"现金优先"体系比现状更高效、透明和可问责，同时承认实物转移在特定领域仍有合理作用。
AI.research_question: 美国当前的再分配体系（以实物和拨款为主）是否应该逐步转向以无条件现金转移为主的"现金优先"模式？如果是，如何设计可行的过渡方案？
AI.motivation: 美国联邦政府已经运行着世界上规模最大的再分配体系之一，但其再分配方式——主要通过实物项目（如医疗补助、食品券等）和国会拨款，而非直接现金——很少被系统性地审视。现有研究多关注再分配的总量，而忽视了"再分配的形式"这一关键维度。大量的实验证据（如OpenResearch保障收入研究、阿拉斯加永久基金分红、EITC）已经积累起来，为重新评估现金转移的效率提供了实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优所得税理论（Mirrlees 1971; Diamond and Saez 2011）、现金与实物转移文献（Currie and Gahvari 2008; Nichols and Zeckhauser 1982）、负所得税传统（Friedman 1962; Tobin），以及来自随机和准实验研究的实证证据。
AI.method: 理论研究与文献综合：整合最优税收理论、现金与实物转移的经济学分析、负所得税理论传统，并引用大量随机和准实验证据（OpenResearch保障收入研究、阿拉斯加永久基金分红、EITC）。使用会计视角分析行政成本、财政归宿和衡量问题。提出分阶段、收入中性的过渡方案。
AI.findings: "现金优先"体系比现行以实物和拨款为主的再分配体系更高效、更透明、更可问责。但结论是有保留的：现金应承担更多联邦政府已资助的工作，但实物提供在特定"优值品"和信息敏感型商品领域仍有合理的保留空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统整合了最优所得税理论、现金与实物转移文献和负所得税理论三个理论传统，为"现金优先"的再分配体系提供了统一的理论基础。在理论上回应了主张实物转移的效率理由、家长主义理由和政治经济学理由，指出这些理由不足以否定现金转移的更大作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一个分阶段、收入中性的过渡方案，将现行财政体系逐步转向"现金优先"模式。通过会计视角分析了行政成本、财政归宿和衡量问题，为政策制定者提供了务实可行的改革路径。参考了多个实际案例（阿拉斯加永久基金分红、EITC、OpenResearch保障收入研究），提供了经验证据支持。

title: The Angle of Growth: A Geometric Theory of Inclusive Development
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Angle of Growth: A Geometric Theory of Inclusive Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest, financial or otherwise, in connection with the research presented in this paper. No funding was received for this work from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit funding body. The research was conducted independently, and the views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.
declarations.funderStatement: This research does not involve human subjects, animal subjects, clinical trials, or the collection of personal data. Accordingly, ethics approval was not required for this study.

detail.abstract: This paper formalises a geometric framework for distinguishing economic growth from economic development. We introduce a two-dimensional growth-people trajectory space in which the horizontal axis measures the magnitude of economic growth and the vertical axis measures the breadth of population reached. A growth trajectory is a ray from the origin in this space, and its angle from the horizontal axis is the paper's central object: the Inclusiveness Angle. We prove three results. First, under a concave social welfare function, welfare is strictly increasing in the Inclusiveness Angle for any xed growth magnitude-formalising the claim that how growth is distributed matters as much as how much there is. Second, we formalise the mirror image below the horizontal axis as the excluded population and prove a Mirror Symmetry Theorem: under a broad class of distributions, the welfare loss from exclusion mirrors the welfare gain from inclusion, making low-angle growth a zero-sum redistribution rather than a net social gain. Third, under a resource constraint linking angle steepness to the cost of growth, we derive the optimal Inclusiveness Angle as a closed-form expression in the curvature of the welfare function and the resource cost parameter. The framework nests the Lorenz curve, growth incidence curves, and the Human Development Index as special cases, and generates a new computable index of inclusive development. The geometric intuition was developed by the author in 2016; this paper constitutes its formal theoretical treatment.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个二维几何框架（增长-人口轨迹空间），通过“包容性角度”（Inclusiveness Angle）将经济增长（量）与经济发展（质，即增长的分配广度）统一刻画，并证明了包容性角度越大社会福利越高、低角度增长的零和性质，以及最优角度的闭式解。
AI.research_question: 如何从几何上形式化区分经济增长（growth）与经济发展（development），并衡量增长的包容性？
AI.motivation: 传统经济增长指标（如GDP）只关注总量，忽略了增长的分配广度；而现有发展指标（如人类发展指数）缺乏统一的几何基础。本文试图提供一个既能捕捉总量又能捕捉分配包容性的形式化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二维增长-人口轨迹空间；包容性角度（Inclusiveness Angle）；凹社会 welfare 函数；资源约束下的最优化；镜像对称定理；洛伦兹曲线、增长发生率曲线、人类发展指数的嵌套关系。
AI.method: 理论形式化建模与数学证明。构建二维空间（横轴=增长量，纵轴=覆盖人口广度），以射线角度定义包容性角度，推导社会福利函数对该角度的单调性、镜像对称定理，以及在资源约束下的最优角度闭式解。
AI.findings: （1）在凹社会福利函数下，给定增长量，社会福利随包容性角度严格递增；（2）低包容性角度的增长本质上是零和再分配（排除群体的福利损失镜像于包含群体的福利 gain）；（3）在资源约束下，最优包容性角度由 welfare 函数曲率和资源成本参数给出闭式解；（4）该框架能嵌套洛伦兹曲线、增长发生率曲线和人类发展指数作为特例。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在几何层面统一经济增长的“量”与“质”（分配广度），提出了包容性角度这一核心新概念；证明了低角度增长的零和性质（镜像对称定理）；给出了最优包容性角度的闭式解，为发展经济学提供了新的形式化基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可计算的新指数（包容性发展指数），可用于跨国比较和政策评估；为政策制定者提供了直观的几何工具来评估增长是否真正具有包容性，以及如何设定最优的包容性目标。

title: The Controlled Turn: AI, Labor and the Governance Gap Nobody is Filling

detail.title: The Controlled Turn: AI, Labor and the Governance Gap Nobody is Filling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced this work. This is an independent analysis with no external funding or institutional affiliation obligations.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This paper is a policy analysis based entirely on publicly available data and published sources. No human participants, patient data, or primary data collection was involved.
declarations.funderStatement: Unfunded. This research was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: AI displacement is not a storm to survive — it is a transition to be engineered. This paper proposes a five-year antibiotic dosing governance protocol for AI labor displacement, addressing four compounding forces simultaneously: accelerating job task automation, AI cost unpredictability driven by vendor subsidy structures, geopolitical model access risk, and labor market deflation feedback loops. The analysis maps the union coverage gap against AI exposure data, draws on historical disruption precedents, and assigns probability scenarios through 2031. The window for proactive governance is 2026–2028. 27 cited sources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一项为期五年的人工智能劳动力替代治理协议——抗生素剂量式治理，旨在系统应对AI替代引发的四重叠加力量：岗位任务自动化加速、由供应商补贴结构导致的AI成本不可预测性、地缘政治模型接入风险，以及劳动力市场通缩反馈循环。研究发现，主动治理的关键窗口期是2026–2028年。
AI.research_question: 如何通过制度性协议系统性地治理AI对劳动力的替代冲击，避免被动应对？
AI.motivation: 现有讨论多将AI替代视为需要"挺过去"的风暴，缺乏主动设计和工程化治理框架；同时AI替代受到多重力量（自动化、成本波动、地缘政治、市场反馈）的叠加影响，需要系统性方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抗生素剂量类比（分阶段、可调节的治理协议）、劳动力市场通缩反馈循环理论、工会覆盖率与AI暴露风险映射分析、历史颠覆先例比较。
AI.method: 基于工会覆盖率数据与AI暴露风险数据的交叉映射分析，结合历史先例比较法，设定概率情景推演至2031年。
AI.findings: 主动治理的关键窗口期为2026–2028年；四重力量（自动化加速、成本波动、地缘风险、通缩反馈）需同步应对，单一政策工具难以奏效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"抗生素剂量式治理"概念，将AI劳动力替代从"被动承受"重新定义为"可工程化设计的转型"，丰富了AI治理的理论工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确的治理时间窗口（2026–2028）和系统性协议框架，指导如何同时应对四重叠加力量，避免碎片化应对策略。

title: The Collective Architect: Role Distribution and the Limits of Collective Tragic Judgment

detail.title: The Collective Architect: Role Distribution and the Limits of Collective Tragic Judgment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.

detail.abstract:
Governance systems cannot distinguish between the bearer of responsibility and the bearer of tragic judgment — and this article shows that this is a structural blind spot, not a practical oversight. Article 11 of the ATTS series established the architect of a multi-agent system as a distinct ontological type and showed that the architect's participation in the loss-space is exhausted by three irreducible roles: target state-space specification (Role 1), loss boundary establishment (Role 2), and structural responsibility (Role 3). But Article 11 left open the question that is central to the overwhelming majority of real configurations: how are these three roles distributed when the architect is not an individual normative subject but a collective — a distributed team, a supply chain, a regulatory network?

The central result of this article is not a typology and not a test — it is a new line of distinction: between the bearer of responsibility and the bearer of tragic judgment. Before this distinction, governance instruments did not differentiate between these two positions — the automatic closure of Role 3 through the Closure Theorem (the Theorem of Moral Field Closure, T1) created the illusion that the question of accountability was resolved in full. This article shows that a system may have a perfectly identified bearer of Role 3 — and simultaneously have a structural vacancy in Role 2: the act of tragic judgment about acceptable loss boundaries never occurred, and no transparency can restore it post factum.

This article proves that a collective normative subject can occupy the structural position of architect — discharging Role 1 and Role 3 through its collective decision-making structure — but Role 2 cannot be collectively discharged without remainder. Genuine tragic judgment about acceptable losses requires an identified bearer whose integrity is at stake in the decision, as established by the Lemma of Tragic Judgment, derived as a tight structural reconstruction from the axiom of subjecthood, the axiom of tragedy, and the anthropological corollary. Where no such bearer exists within the collective architect, Role 2 defaults structurally to the individual normative subject who authorised the architectural act — because the Closure Theorem preserves the connection and the Non-Transferability Lemma prevents its full transfer.

The article introduces the Tragic Judgment Test with three conditions — bearer identifiability, integrity at stake (the integrity-at-stake condition), irreversibility accepted (the irreversibility-accepted condition) — and describes four configurations of the collective architect (C1–C4), showing where the Tragic Judgment Test finds a bearer and where it registers a structural vacancy. The structural vacancy in Role 2 is a form of alibi at a higher level than the algorithmic alibi (Articles 5, 9) or the epistemic alibi (Article 10): when the algorithmic alibi operates, the act of judgment occurred but its visibility is destroyed; when Role 2 is vacant, the act of judgment never occurred at all — and the bearer of responsibility and the bearer of tragic judgment are structurally distinct positions that previously appeared as one.

The falsification condition: a collective subject whose structure satisfies the axiom of subjecthood at the collective level (the collective continuity conditions) and can bear the irreversible consequences of an architectural decision as a single identified bearer — without the possibility of decomposing them to individual members through the Closure Theorem — would falsify the central thesis.

AI.tldr: 本文证明治理系统存在结构性盲点：无法区分"责任承担者"与"悲剧判断承担者"。集体规范主体（如团队、供应链、监管网络）可以承担角色1（目标状态空间指定）和角色3（结构性责任），但角色2（可接受损失边界设定）无法被集体无剩余地承担。悲剧判断要求有明确的承担者，其完整性处于决策风险之中。当集体架构中不存在这样的承担者时，角色2结构性缺位，产生比算法托辞和认知托辞更高层次的"托辞"。
AI.research_question: 当架构师不是个体规范主体而是集体（分布式团队、供应链、监管网络）时，架构师的三个不可化约角色——目标状态空间指定（角色1）、损失边界设定（角色2）、结构性责任（角色3）——如何分布？责任承担者与悲剧判断承担者是否是同一位置？
AI.motivation: ATTS系列第11条确立了多智能体系统中架构师作为独立本体类型的地位，但未解决现实中最普遍的集体架构师场景下三个角色的分配问题。治理系统长期未能区分责任承担者与悲剧判断承担者，存在结构性盲点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 闭包定理（道德场域闭包定理T1）、悲剧判断引理（从主体性公理、悲剧公理、人类学推论推导）、不可转移引理、集体连续性条件、悲剧判断测试三条件（承担者可辨识性、完整性处于风险中、不可逆性被接受）
AI.method: 结构重建与定理证明：从主体性公理、悲剧公理和人类学推论出发，通过严格的形式化推导（闭包定理、不可转移引理、悲剧判断引理），构建悲剧判断测试的判定条件，描述集体架构师的四种配置（C1-C4），并给出可证伪条件。
AI.findings: 1. 集体规范主体可以结构化地占据架构师位置，完成角色1和角色3，但角色2无法被集体无剩余地承担。2. 真正的悲剧判断要求有明确的可辨识承担者，其完整性处于决策风险之中。3. 当集体架构中不存在这样的承担者时，角色2结构性缺位，责任承担者与悲剧判断承担者是结构上不同的位置。4. 这种缺位构成比算法托辞和认知托辞更高层次的"托辞"——判断行为从未发生，而非发生但不可见。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次严格区分"责任承担者"与"悲剧判断承担者"两个结构位置，揭示了治理系统的结构性盲点。2. 证明了集体架构中角色2的不可集体化定理。3. 提出了悲剧判断测试的三条件框架，提供了判定集体架构中悲剧判断是否存在承担者的形式化工具。4. 建立了三种托辞层次（算法托辞、认知托辞、悲剧判断缺位托辞）的分析体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为多智能体系统治理提供了诊断工具：通过悲剧判断测试识别集体架构中角色2的结构性缺位。2. 揭示了当前治理实践中"责任已分配"的幻觉——闭包定理自动闭合角色3造成了问责已完全解决的错觉。3. 为供应链、监管网络等分布式治理结构的设计提供了原则性指导：必须确保角色2有明确的个体承担者，其完整性处于决策风险之中。

title: Fundamentals of Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures and Swaps
affiliations: EIM European Institute of Management, ,  and EIM European Institute of Management

detail.title: Fundamentals of Cryptocurrency Perpetual Futures and Swaps

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no (competing) financial or non-financial interests related to this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study complies with the ethical guidelines of the European Code of Conduct for Research Integrity and adheres to the GDPR requirements for data protection.
declarations.funderStatement: The PGRI (https://www.eim.education/pgri) funded this study.

detail.abstract: Perpetual futures (often called perpetual swaps) are the dominant crypto-derivatives instrument. They replicate the economic exposure of a futures contract without an expiry date. They replace maturity-based convergence with a funding mechanism that transfers cash flows between longs and shorts, typically every eight hours. This paper explains how perpetuals evolved from early proposals for non-maturing futures into a standardized crypto market instrument, and why key design choices changed over time. It synthesizes recent theoretical and empirical research on funding design, pricing, and arbitrage intuition, market microstructure, liquidation risk, and regulation. Finally, this study proposes a research agenda organized around funding design, constrained arbitrage, transparency, decentralized exchange design, policy, and legal classification, because recent U.S. and EU developments show that the same economic structure may be characterized as a futures contract, swap, CFD-type instrument, or other derivative depending on statutory definitions, venue design, and supervisory interpretation. This paper proposes the following definition: a cryptocurrency perpetual is an open-ended, margin-based derivative that gives synthetic long or short exposure to an underlying crypto asset and replaces expiry-based settlement with periodic funding payments that anchor the contract price to a reference spot price.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了加密货币永续合约的演变历程、关键设计选择、理论实证研究现状，并提出了未来的研究议程和法律定义。
AI.research_question: 永续合约是如何从早期的无到期日期货理念演变为标准化加密市场工具的？其关键设计选择为何随时间变化？该领域的研究现状和未来方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 永续合约是加密货币领域占主导地位的衍生品工具，但其设计演变、定价机制、市场监管等关键问题尚缺乏系统性梳理，且其法律分类在各国存在重大不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资金费率机制设计、定价与套利理论、市场微观结构、清算风险理论、监管分类理论。
AI.method: 文献综述与综合研究，对现有理论和实证研究进行系统性梳理，并提出研究议程。
AI.findings: 永续合约通过资金费率机制替代了传统期货的到期结算；其设计选择经历了显著演变；在资金费率设计、受限套利、透明度、去中心化交易所设计、政策及法律分类等方面存在大量未解决的研究问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 为永续合约提供了统一的定义框架；系统整合了资金费率设计、套利定价、市场微观结构等分散的研究线索；揭示了法律分类对经济结构的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交易所设计永续合约产品提供参考；为监管机构理解永续合约的法律属性提供分析框架；为投资者理解永续合约的定价和风险特征提供指导。

title: Trade-off Redistribution (TOR): A Least-action Thermodynamic Mechanism Underlying Commoner's Four Laws of Ecology
affiliations: Southern Luzon State University, Southern Luzon State University

detail.title: Trade-off Redistribution (TOR): A Least-action Thermodynamic Mechanism Underlying Commoner's Four Laws of Ecology
detail.abstract:
Barry Commoner's Four Laws of Ecology remain influential conceptual principles, yet they offer limited mechanistic explanation for how ecological systems maintain stability or why degradation emerges under sustained disturbance. This paper proposes Trade-Off Redistribution (TOR) as a theoretical framework formalising the thermodynamic mechanism underlying these laws. TOR is grounded in a chain of physical principles linking the Principle of Least Action, the First and Second Laws of Thermodynamics, Le Chatelier's Principle, and Prigogine's theory of dissipative structures. The framework is expressed through a dimensionless proximity index: 

                                                                 Φ = 𝑅 𝑂 /𝑅 Opt 

where 𝑅 𝑂 is observed redistribution throughput and 𝑅 Opt is the redistribution throughput characteristic of the system's naturally evolved or pre-disturbance state. The framework distinguishes an analytical reference condition (Theoretical Optimal, Φ = 1), an occupiable stability regime (Dynamic Optimal, Φ ≈ 1), and two deviation regimes: Redistributive Deficiency (Φ < 1) and Redistributive Saturation (Φ > 1). Persistent deviation may displace a system onto a permanently altered redistribution baseline, a Systemic Shift, or, where accumulated imbalance exceeds system-specific reorganisational capacity, culminate in Irreversible Dissolution. Both transitions are pathdependent and not governed by a universal threshold. TOR is proposed not as an additional ecological law but as a unifying mechanistic extension-the thermodynamic process through which Commoner's four laws manifest as expressions of a single underlying redistribution dynamic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"权衡再分配"(TOR)理论框架，用热力学机制统一解释了巴里·康芒纳的生态学四定律，通过一个无量纲邻近指数(Φ)来量化生态系统在扰动下的稳定性与退化过程。
AI.research_question: 康芒纳生态学四定律背后的热力学机制是什么？如何用统一的理论框架解释生态系统维持稳定或在持续扰动下退化的内在机理？
AI.motivation: 康芒纳的生态学四定律虽然具有概念影响力，但缺乏对生态系统的稳定性维持和退化产生的机制性解释。需要建立一个基于热力学的统一理论框架来弥补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: Trade-Off Redistribution (TOR) 框架，基于最小作用量原理、热力学第一和第二定律、勒夏特列原理、普里高津耗散结构理论，通过无量纲邻近指数(Φ = R_O/R_Opt)表达。
AI.method: 理论推导与概念建模，从基本物理原理（最小作用量原理、热力学定律）出发，构建TOR框架并定义四种系统状态：理论最优(Φ=1)、动态最优(Φ≈1)、再分配不足(Φ<1)、再分配饱和(Φ>1)。
AI.findings: 系统持久偏离会导致两种不可逆转变：系统性偏移（永久改变再分配基线）和不可逆解体（累积失衡超出重组能力）。这两种转变具有路径依赖性，不存在普遍阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将康芒纳四条经验性生态定律统一为一个单一的热力学再分配动力学机制；为生态系统稳定性与退化提供了可量化的理论框架（Φ指数）；连接了生态学与热力学基本定律。
AI.practical_contributions: 为生态系统管理和恢复提供定量评估工具（Φ指数）；帮助识别生态系统面临崩溃风险的关键状态（再分配不足或饱和）；指导扰动管理策略，避免系统进入不可逆转变路径。

title: Human Capital in Venture Capital: Evidence From 100,000 Venture Capitalists
affiliations: and Stanford University - Graduate School of Business

detail.title: Human Capital in Venture Capital: Evidence From 100,000 Venture Capitalists
detail.abstract:
We study human capital in venture capital (VC) using a new dataset covering over 100,000 professionals affiliated with U.S. VC firms. Investment success is extremely concentrated: fewer than 40% of VCs with any investments are ever credited with a successful investment, and 90% of investment profits are generated by 5% of VCs. Differences in education, prior work experience, and demographics predict career progression and investment outcomes, consistent with persistent investor-specific skills. Quasi-experimental variation from marginal inclusions on the Forbes Midas List shows that achieving superstar status increases access to highly-valued startups, complementing other human capital and contributing to concentration.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 基于超过10万名美国风险投资专业人士的数据，研究发现投资成功高度集中：不到40%的VC拥有成功投资，5%的VC创造了90%的利润。教育、工作经历和人口统计学差异可预测职业发展。福布斯Midas榜单带来的明星地位进一步加剧了这种集中。
AI.research_question: 风险投资行业中的人力资本如何影响投资成功？成功为何高度集中在少数投资者手中？
AI.motivation: 风险投资行业存在显著的成功集中现象，但缺乏大规模系统性数据来研究人力资本在其中发挥的作用及其形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、超级明星经济学、信号理论
AI.method: 基于超过10万名美国VC专业人士的大规模数据集，采用描述性统计、回归分析，并利用福布斯Midas榜单作为准实验变差来识别因果关系。
AI.findings: （1）投资成功高度集中：不到40%的VC有成功投资记录，5%的VC贡献了90%的利润；（2）教育、工作经验和人口统计学差异能预测职业发展和投资结果；（3）获得超级明星地位（进入Midas榜单）增加了获取高价值初创企业的机会，从而进一步加剧了成功集中。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人力资本理论系统性地引入VC研究领域，揭示了投资者个体技能差异与成功集中的内在联系；提供了超级明星地位通过资源获取渠道加剧不平等的因果证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为VC机构的人才选拔和投资策略提供参考；为理解风险投资行业的资源分配效率和市场集中度提供实证依据。

title: When Rights Become Access: Abortion Reform and Missing Girls in Nepal *
affiliations: Binghamton University and Binghamton University

detail.title: When Rights Become Access: Abortion Reform and Missing Girls in Nepal *

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None.

detail.abstract: Reforms that expand reproductive rights change behavior only when they change effective access. We study Nepal, which legalized abortion in 2002 to reduce unsafe procedures, and ask when and where legal access affected the sex composition of births in a society with son preference. We combine quasirandom variation in firstborn sex with the staged rollout of abortion services and predetermined connectivity to city services in a triple-difference design. The rollout separates two margins. During the initial first-trimester rollout, later-birth hazards declined where services were reachable, but the male-and female-birth responses were not statistically distinguishable, and the sex composition of births did not change. Once access expanded to include second-trimester services, medication abortion, and midlevel providers, the annual probability of a female birth fell while male births did not decline. Nationally, the probability of a female birth fell by 0.49 percentage points, and the female share of later births in firstborn-girl families fell by 2.83 percentage points. The responses were concentrated within two hours of a city. Within this radius, the female birth probability and the female share declined by 1.30 and 6.52 percentage points, respectively. Back-of-the-envelope calculation maps the national composition estimate to an annual flow equivalent of about 11,900 missing girls at birth, or 1.91 percent of all births.

AI.tldr: 本文利用尼泊尔2002年堕胎合法化改革，结合首胎性别准随机变异与堕胎服务分阶段推开的准自然实验，发现只有当堕胎服务扩展到孕中期、药物流产及中级服务提供者后，才会显著改变出生性别比（女孩出生概率下降），且效应集中在城市周边两小时可达范围内。
AI.research_question: 在重男轻女的社会中，扩大生育权的改革何时以及在何种条件下会改变出生性别构成？
AI.motivation: 已有文献对堕胎合法化的效果存在争议，原因在于改革可能只是"纸面上的权利"而非有效的可及性。尼泊尔提供了一个独特情境：堕胎合法化但服务分阶段推广，而且社会存在强烈的男孩偏好，这为识别法律可及性（而非法律本身）对生育行为的影响提供了机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别选择性生育理论；法律可及性（effective access）与法律权利的区别；首胎性别作为外生冲击的准随机变异逻辑；三重差分识别策略。
AI.method: 三重差分设计：首胎性别准随机变异 × 堕胎服务分阶段推广（孕早期/孕中期等） × 到城市服务的交通可达性（两小时内/外）。使用的数据为尼泊尔人口与健康调查（DHS）等多个来源的生育史数据。
AI.findings: （1）孕早期服务推广阶段，服务可达区域的后次生育概率下降，但男婴与女婴反应无显著差异，出生性别比未变。（2）当服务扩展到孕中期、药物流产和中级服务提供者后，女孩出生概率显著下降（全国下降0.49个百分点），而男孩出生无显著变化。（3）效应集中在城市两小时可达范围内，在此范围内女孩出生概率下降1.30个百分点，首胎为女孩的家庭中后续子女的女孩占比下降6.52个百分点。（4）全国层面，每年约有11,900名"失踪女孩"（占出生总数的1.91%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了"纸面权利"与"有效可及性"对生育行为的差异化影响，揭示了堕胎服务范围（孕早期vs孕中期）、服务类型和可及性距离共同决定性别选择性堕胎的发生条件，丰富了性别选择性生育行为的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家生育权改革的实施顺序和覆盖范围提供政策启示：仅扩大孕早期堕胎权不足以改变性别选择性行为，需同时提供孕中期服务、药物流产和中级服务提供者才能有效减少不想要的女孩出生；服务的地理可及性是改革有效性的关键边界条件。

title: A PRISMA-Based Systematic Review of Gender, Labour Markets, and Retirement Inequalities in the United Arab Emirates

detail.title: A PRISMA-Based Systematic Review of Gender, Labour Markets, and Retirement Inequalities in the United Arab Emirates
detail.abstract: This paper examines the relationship between gender, labour markets, and retirement inequalities in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), a rapidly developing economy characterised by a segmented workforce of nationals and expatriates. Using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA 2020) framework, the study systematically identifies and synthesises research on pensions, retirement, and gender inequality. The review finds that Emirati nationals benefit from state-supported pension schemes, whereas expatriate workers depend mainly on end-of-service benefits, creating unequal access to long-term social protection. Gender shapes labour market participation and retirement outcomes, with women facing earlier workforce exit, lower pension accumulation, and reduced financial security due to caregiving responsibilities and social norms. The review also identifies gaps in comparative research, gender analysis, and institutional perspectives. The findings highlight the need for inclusive labour and social protection policies that reduce gender disparities and strengthen retirement security for all workers.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了阿联酋的性别、劳动力市场与退休不平等问题。研究发现，阿联酋本国公民享有国家支持的养老金计划，而外籍劳工主要依赖离职补偿，导致社会保障不平等；性别因素进一步加剧了退休差异，女性因照护责任和社会规范面临更早退出劳动力市场、养老金积累不足等问题。
AI.research_question: 阿联酋的性别、劳动力市场与退休不平等之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 阿联酋作为快速发展的经济体，劳动力市场呈现本国公民与外籍劳工的分割特征，但现有研究对退休保障中的性别不平等关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: PRISMA 2020系统综述框架；性别与劳动力市场理论；社会保障与退休不平等理论。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020框架进行系统综述，系统识别和综合关于养老金、退休与性别不平等的研究文献。
AI.findings: 1) 阿联酋本国公民享有国家支持的养老金计划，外籍劳工主要依赖离职补偿，形成不平等的长期社会保障；2) 女性因照护责任和社会规范更早退出劳动力市场，养老金积累更少，财务安全感更低；3) 比较研究、性别分析和制度视角的研究存在空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在分割劳动力市场背景下，国籍与性别双重因素如何共同塑造退休不平等，丰富了社会保障与性别不平等交叉研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿联酋乃至类似移民依赖型经济体提供了政策建议，呼吁制定包容性的劳动与社会保护政策，以减少性别差距并加强所有劳动者的退休保障。

title: Estimating the Human Development Impacts and Economic Returns from an Adolescent Cash ‘Plus’ Programme in Kenya: An Economic Modelliing Study
affiliations: University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of the Witwatersrand, University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of Oxford, University of Oxford, Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of KwaZulu-Natal, University of Oxford, University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention, University of Cape Town (UCT), University of Oxford - Department of Social Policy and Intervention and University of Cape Town (UCT)

detail.title: Estimating the Human Development Impacts and Economic Returns from an Adolescent Cash ‘Plus’ Programme in Kenya: An Economic Modelliing Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used only secondary, de-identified data and did not involve human participants. Approvals were obtained for the KDHS from The DHS Program (ICF/USAID) and for the VACSs from the Centers for Disease Control and Together for Girls. County-level administrative data were obtained from the Government of Kenya. No ethical approval was required for this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was funded by the UK Research and Innovation Global Challenges Research Fund (UKRI GCRF) Accelerate Hub [ES/S008101/1 to LC], and the Wellspring Philanthropic Fund [Grant no. 18757 to WR, LC, & ET]. The funders had no role in study design, data collection, analysis, decision to publish, or preparation of the manuscript.

detail.abstract: The Government of Kenya plans to scale-up an adolescent-focused cash ‘plus’ programme to improve educational attainment and delay adolescent pregnancy. We aimed to estimate the programme’s impacts, economic returns, and cost-effectiveness using model-based economic evaluation. We modelled the delivery of conditional cash transfers ‘plus’ adolescent clubs, community conversations, parenting support and psychosocial support to poor adolescents in nine selected counties from 2026 to 2029. Two scenarios were compared: a baseline in which intervention variables remained constant at 2025 levels, and an immediate scale-up sustained throughout 2026-2029. Human development impacts were simulated using an integrated modelling framework. Gains in years of schooling were projected with an education transition model, while reductions in adolescent pregnancy, child marriage, and experiences of violence were estimated with a deterministic age–cohort transition model. Economic returns to schooling were calculated with Mincerian earnings functions. Model parameters were derived from rigorous impact evaluations, nationally representative surveys, and Kenya’s national social registry. The four-year intervention, costing US$46.1 million, is projected to reach 140,000 adolescents, and compared with the baseline, generate an additional 74,900 (+7%) years of schooling; and avert 1,420 (-8%) adolescent pregnancies, 1,500 (-11%) child marriages, 2,970 (-3%) experiences of sexual violence, and 21,800 (-8%) experiences of emotional/physical violence. Furthermore, the intervention is projected to generate US$318 million in discounted lifetime labour earnings, representing a seven-fold return on investment. The estimated cost was US$567 per additional year of schooling, and US$109 when benefits across multiple outcomes were considered, comparing favourably with other adolescent education interventions. Findings were robust to sensitivity analyses, with a >98% probability that returns exceeded programme costs. These findings suggest that scaling up an adolescent focused cash ‘plus’ programme could substantially improve adolescent human development, while delivering strong economic returns and good value for money.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了肯尼亚青少年现金"附加"项目（现金转移+青少年俱乐部、社区对话、育儿支持、心理支持）大规模推广的效果，发现四年内投入4610万美元可惠及14万青少年，增加7%受教育年限，减少8%青少年怀孕、11%童婚等，并带来3.18亿美元终生劳动收入回报，经济回报率高达7倍。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚政府计划推广的青少年现金"附加"项目（面向贫困青少年的有条件现金转移+青少年俱乐部、社区对话、育儿支持和心理支持）在改善教育成就和减少青少年怀孕方面，其影响、经济回报和成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚政府计划大规模推广该青少年聚焦的现金"附加"项目以改善教育成就和延迟青少年怀孕，但需要基于模型的量化经济评价来估算其影响、经济回报和成本效益，为政策决策提供证据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 明瑟收入函数（Mincerian earnings functions）、教育过渡模型、确定性年龄-队列转换模型、综合建模框架
AI.method: 基于模型的经济评价。使用教育过渡模型预测受教育年限增长，使用确定性年龄-队列转换模型估计青少年怀孕、童婚、暴力经历减少情况，使用明瑟收入函数计算教育经济回报。模型参数源自严格的影响评估、全国代表性调查和肯尼亚国家社会登记册。进行敏感性分析验证结果的稳健性。
AI.findings: 四年干预成本4610万美元，惠及14万青少年。相比基线，额外增加74,900年（+7%）受教育年限；避免1,420例（-8%）青少年怀孕、1,500例（-11%）童婚、2,970例（-3%）性暴力经历、21,800例（-8%）情感/身体暴力经历。产生3.18亿美元折现终生劳动收入，投资回报率7倍。每增加一年教育成本567美元，综合考虑多成果后成本降至109美元。敏感性分析显示超过98%概率回报超过成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将明瑟收入函数、教育过渡模型和年龄-队列转换模型整合到统一框架中，提供了对综合性青少年干预项目多维度人力资本影响（教育、健康、暴力预防）进行联合经济评价的方法论示范。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚政府推广青少年现金"附加"项目提供了强有力的经济依据：该项目不仅显著改善青少年人力资本发展（教育、减少怀孕、童婚和暴力），而且具有7倍的高投资回报率和良好的成本效益（每增加一年教育567美元，多成果综合成本仅109美元），政策可行性超过98%。

title: Robust Revelation in Competing Mechanisms with Endogenous Exclusive Agency
affiliations: McMaster University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Robust Revelation in Competing Mechanisms with Endogenous Exclusive Agency
detail.abstract: This paper studies competing mechanism games with endogenous exclusive agency, where principals announce mechanisms and agents select and communicate with at most one principal. The standard revelation-principle argument is hard to apply because agents may need to report information about rival mechanisms, creating an infinite-regress problem. The analysis focuses on equilibria in which communication with non-deviating principals is ex-post optimal, and it imposes robustness with respect to continuation equilibria after unilateral deviations. Within this disciplined class, market-information communication can be reduced to the identity of the deviating principal. A Weak Revelation Principle represents robust quasi ex-post equilibrium allocations by truthful equilibria in EPIC extended direct mechanisms. A Strong Revelation Principle gives an operational test: it suffices to check BIC direct deviations against the EPIC direct mechanisms used by non-deviators, allowing the continuation selection most favorable to the deviator. The results turn revelation into a tractable robustness criterion for exclusiveagency environments in which ex-post or dominant-strategy communication with non-deviators is economically natural.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了内生排他性代理下的竞争机制博弈，提出了弱和强显示原理，将市场信息沟通简化为偏离委托人身份，为排他性代理环境提供了可操作的稳健性标准。
AI.research_question: 在排他性代理的竞争机制博弈中，如何解决无限回归问题并建立可操作的显示原理？
AI.motivation: 标准显示原理在排他性代理环境中失效，因为代理人需要报告竞争对手机制的信息，产生无限回归问题。需要一种稳健的均衡概念来简化分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 竞争机制博弈、显示原理、排他性代理、事后最优沟通、稳健均衡、EPIC（事后激励相容）、BIC（贝叶斯激励相容）
AI.method: 理论建模，定义"类"均衡（与非偏离委托人的沟通事后最优），施加对单边偏离后延续博弈的稳健性要求，提出弱显示原理和强显示原理。
AI.findings: (1) 在该稳健均衡类中，市场信息沟通可简化为偏离委托人身份；(2) 弱显示原理：稳健准事后均衡分配可由EPIC扩展直接机制的真实均衡表征；(3) 强显示原理：只需检查BIC直接偏离是否优于非偏离者的EPIC直接机制，且允许最优延续选择。
AI.theory_contributions: 将显示原理转化为排他性代理环境中可操作的稳健性标准，解决了无限回归问题，为竞争机制设计提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为涉及排他性代理的市场（如平台经济、劳动力市场、金融中介）提供了可行的事后或占优策略沟通分析工具，简化了均衡检验。

title: The Broken Energy Ladder: Household Drudgery, Fragmented Transition, and Rural Structural Barriers in India
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Kanpur and Shiv Nadar University

detail.title: The Broken Energy Ladder: Household Drudgery, Fragmented Transition, and Rural Structural Barriers in India
detail.abstract: The Energy Ladder Hypothesis proposes that rising household income drives a progressive shift from traditional energy sources to cleaner modern energy. Building on this hypothesis, this paper reconceptualises energy deprivation as energy-based domestic drudgery-a household production constraint grounded in Becker's (1965) theory of time allocation. It also introduces two novel empirical constructs. The Broken Ladder Hypothesis posits that the consumption-drudgery gradient diverges across the rural-urban divide. The Fragmented Transition Hypothesis posits that cooking-energy and electricity drudgery respond asymmetrically to rising consumption. Using pooled data from India's Time Use Surveys of 2019 and 2024, and covering 278,284 nationally representative households, we deploy surveyweighted probit models and a Fairlie nonlinear decomposition technique. Results confirm the energy ladder in the Indian context but reveal it to be simultaneously broken and fragmented. The consumption gradient for cooking-energy drudgery is more than eight times that for electricity drudgery. The Fairlie decomposition reveals that over half of the rural-urban cooking drudgery gap is structurally unexplained by observable household endowments, while the electricity gap is fully explained. The results call for enhanced supply-side infrastructure investment, sustained refill subsidies for marginalised households, and a gender-responsive clean energy policy in India.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Becker时间分配理论，将能源匮乏重新概念化为"家庭生产苦役"，提出"断裂阶梯假说"和"碎片化转型假说"，利用印度2019和2024年时间使用调查数据，发现能源消费阶梯在城乡间断裂，烹饪能源苦役的消费弹性是电力苦役的8倍以上，城乡苦役差距存在结构性不可解释成分。
AI.research_question: 家庭消费水平提升是否以及如何影响不同类型能源（烹饪能源 vs. 电力）的家庭苦役负担？城乡差距对这种影响有何调节作用？
AI.motivation: 传统能源阶梯假说过于简化，未考虑能源类型差异和城乡结构性断裂，需要更精细的理论框架和实证工具来理解发展中国家的能源转型困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: Becker（1965）时间分配理论；能源阶梯假说；重新概念化的"能源型家庭苦役"框架。
AI.method: 印度2019和2024年时间使用调查数据（278,284个全国代表性家庭）；调查加权probit模型；Fairlie非线性分解技术。
AI.findings: 能源阶梯在印度存在但"断裂且碎片化"：烹饪能源苦役的消费梯度是电力苦役的8倍以上；城乡烹饪苦役差距中超过一半无法由可观测的家庭禀赋解释，而电力差距可完全解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"断裂阶梯假说"和"碎片化转型假说"两个新的实证概念；拓展Becker时间分配理论到能源贫困领域；重新概念化能源匮乏为"家庭生产苦役"。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似发展中国家提供差异化能源政策建议：加强供给侧基础设施投资、持续为边缘化家庭提供燃料补贴、制定性别敏感的清洁能源政策。

title: Adaptive Sovereign Balance Framework (ASBF): Functional Configuration as an Independent Object of Macrofinancial Diagnosis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Adaptive Sovereign Balance Framework (ASBF): Functional Configuration as an Independent Object of Macrofinancial Diagnosis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses only publicly available macroeconomic and institutional data; no human subjects or participant data were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract:
Existing instruments for sovereign vulnerability assessment — reserve adequacy metrics, debt sustainability analysis, balance-sheet mapping, early warning systems — operate at the level of individual components or sectors of the sovereign balance. This paper proposes that macrofinancial stability is a relational, not additive, property: it resides in the joint functional configuration of the sovereign balance rather than in any component considered separately. The Adaptive Sovereign Balance Framework (ASBF) operationalises this configuration through a four-step sequence — function, obligation, resource margin, adequacy — applied to five functional contours of the sovereign balance: international reserves, the sovereign wealth fund, the fiscal system, monetary coordination, and economic diversification. Two indices summarise the resulting diagnosis: SVI^S, measuring the overall adequacy deficit across contours weighted by systemic importance, and SVI^P, measuring the rate at which that configuration is deteriorating or improving.

The framework is tested on Kazakhstan, 2005–2023, a small open commodity-dependent economy with a managed exchange rate and a sovereign wealth fund. Three independent non-parametric tests — Mann-Whitney U (p = 0.0017), Fisher's exact test (p = 0.028), and a permutation test (p = 0.014) — show that SVI^P is significantly elevated in years preceding identified crisis episodes relative to calm years. A structured comparison against IMF Article IV consultation reports across three crisis episodes (2008–2009, 2014–2016, 2020) documents a recurring diagnostic gap: in each case, SVI^P registered rising systemic pressure in the year preceding crisis onset, while component-level surveillance instruments — ARA, DSA — reported individually adequate conditions or did not translate observed sectoral risks into a system-level reading. In 2007, SVI^P reached +1.020, the highest value in the sample, while reserves and external debt were both assessed as comfortable; the banking crisis materialised within two years. An illustrative out-of-sample check for 2016–2023 shows internally consistent quadrant transitions with no false positive signals.

The paper argues that this gap is architectural rather than a surveillance failure: existing instruments are well-calibrated to their own diagnostic objects — the reserve buffer, the debt trajectory, a vector of leading indicators — but none is designed to estimate the functional adequacy of the sovereign balance as an integrated system. The contribution of ASBF is accordingly not the construction of another composite index, but the operationalisation of sovereign balance configuration as an independent diagnostic object; SVI is one implementation of that broader framework. Limitations of the pilot specification — a single-country sample of 19 annual observations, theory-derived rather than statistically estimated thresholds and weights — are discussed alongside the conditions for falsifiability and the research programme required for cross-country generalisation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出主权脆弱性评估应从"组件加总"转向"系统配置"视角，构建适应性主权平衡框架（ASBF），通过五项功能轮廓和两个综合指数（SVI^S、SVI^P）评估主权平衡的整体功能充足性。在哈萨克斯坦2005-2023年的测试显示，SVI^P能提前识别危机信号，而传统组件级工具（如ARA、DSA）存在系统性诊断盲区。
AI.research_question: 主权脆弱性评估中，传统组件级工具（储备充足性、债务可持续性等）为何难以捕捉系统性风险？如何从主权平衡的整体功能配置角度构建新的诊断框架？
AI.motivation: 现有主权脆弱性评估工具（储备充足性指标、债务可持续性分析、资产负债表映射、预警系统）均作用于主权平衡的单个组件或部门层面，缺乏从系统整体功能配置角度评估主权脆弱性的方法。本文旨在填补这一"诊断空白"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观金融稳定性是关系性（relational）而非加总性（additive）属性，存在于主权平衡的联合功能配置（joint functional configuration）中，而非任何单独组件。ASBF框架包含功能、义务、资源边际、充足性四步序列，应用于五个功能轮廓：国际储备、主权财富基金、财政体系、货币协调、经济多元化。
AI.method: 构建ASBF框架并衍生出两个综合指数（SVI^S和SVI^P）；以哈萨克斯坦2005-2023年为单一国家样本进行实证检验；使用三种非参数检验（Mann-Whitney U检验p=0.0017、Fisher精确检验p=0.028、置换检验p=0.014）验证SVI^P在危机前年份显著升高；与IMF第四条磋商报告进行结构化比较，对三次危机（2008-2009、2014-2016、2020）进行案例回溯；2016-2023年样本外检验。
AI.findings: （1）三种非参数检验均显著支持SVI^P在危机前年份显著高于平稳年份；（2）三次危机回溯均发现诊断空白：SVI^P在危机前一年已显示系统性压力上升，而传统组件级工具（ARA、DSA）报告的是组件级充足状态；（3）2007年SVI^P达样本最高值+1.020，而储备和外部债务均被评估为舒适，两年内银行业危机爆发；（4）2016-2023年样本外检验显示象限转换内部一致，无虚警信号。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出宏观金融稳定性是关系性而非加总性属性，将主权平衡的"功能配置"确立为独立的诊断对象；（2）构建ASBF框架，将主权脆弱性评估从组件级提升至系统级；（3）揭示传统工具的诊断空白本质上是架构性的，而非监督失误——各工具对自身诊断对象校准良好，但无工具设计用于评估主权平衡作为集成系统的功能充足性。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供SVI^S（衡量整体充足性赤字）和SVI^P（衡量配置变化速率）两个可操作指数，可服务于主权风险评估实践；（2）通过哈萨克斯坦案例验证框架有效性，为小型开放大宗商品依赖型经济体提供预警工具；（3）指出未来研究方向：跨国家推广所需的研究计划、统计估计阈值和权重的条件、可证伪性条件。

title: Tax Transparency as an Anti-corruption Mechanism: The Case of Uzbekistan

detail.title: Tax Transparency as an Anti-corruption Mechanism: The Case of Uzbekistan

declarations.funderStatement: This article is based on the MOCCA project (Multilevel Orders of Corruption in Central Asia) that has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No. 101085855

detail.abstract: This article examines the interaction between anti-corruption law and tax law by analyzing tax transparency mechanisms within Uzbekistan's recent legal and institutional reforms. The study adopts a theoretical and policy-oriented legal analysis rather than an empirical approach, focusing on newly developing legal frameworks and institutional structures. It argues that tax transparency mechanisms can function as effective anticorruption instruments only when supported by coherent legal rules, procedural consistency, and sufficient institutional capacity. The analysis evaluates reforms in four key areas: asset declaration, beneficial ownership transparency, whistleblower protection, and information exchange. The findings demonstrate that despite important recent reforms, significant legal and institutional deficiencies remain. Asset declaration lacks comprehensive legislative regulation and practical implementation; beneficial ownership transparency remains limited in scope; whistleblower protection is narrowly focused; and information exchange mechanisms face both domestic and international shortcomings. The article concludes that legal reform alone is insufficient to ensure effective anti-corruption outcomes. Sustainable progress requires stronger institutional capacity and gradual, proportionate implementation that balances transparency objectives with the protection of individual rights, particularly privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨乌兹别克斯坦税收透明机制作为反腐败工具的成效，发现法律改革虽推进但制度能力不足，需平衡透明度与隐私权保护。
AI.research_question: 反腐败法律与税法如何通过税收透明机制相互作用？乌兹别克斯坦的法律与制度改革是否有效实现了这一目标？
AI.motivation: 乌兹别克斯坦近年来推行了反腐败与税收领域的重大改革，但税收透明机制在反腐败中的实际效果缺乏系统评估，特别是法律与制度缺陷的交互影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 反腐败法与税法的交叉理论；制度能力理论；透明度与隐私权平衡理论。
AI.method: 理论与政策导向的法律分析（非实证研究），聚焦法律框架与制度结构的规范性评估。
AI.findings: 1）资产申报缺乏全面立法与实施；2）受益所有权透明度范围有限；3）举报人保护覆盖狭窄；4）信息交换机制存在国内外短板；5）单纯法律改革不足以实现反腐败效果，需强化制度能力与分步实施。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了税收透明机制有效发挥反腐败功能所需的法律与制度前提条件；提出法律改革与制度能力必须协同发展的理论观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为乌兹别克斯坦及类似转型经济体提供了反腐败与税收改革的具体政策建议：需系统性完善资产申报、受益所有权、举报人保护及信息交换，并注重分步实施与权利平衡。

title: Graph Neural Networks and Knowledge Graphs for Clinical Reasoning: A Review of Architectures, Applications, and Open Challenges

detail.title: Graph Neural Networks and Knowledge Graphs for Clinical Reasoning: A Review of Architectures, Applications, and Open Challenges

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Clinical decision-making increasingly draws on structured relational knowledge that links symptoms, laboratory findings, diagnoses, medications and outcomes across heterogeneous data sources. Graph neural networks (GNNs) offer a natural computational substrate for reasoning over such relational structures, while knowledge graphs (KGs) provide the curated or data-derived schema that encodes clinical semantics. This review synthesises recent progress at the intersection of these two paradigms, focusing on their combined application to clinical reasoning tasks such as diagnosis prediction, risk stratification, treatment recommendation and pharmacovigilance. We examine the principal GNN architectures adopted in the clinical domain, including graph convolutional networks, graph attention networks, relational graph convolutional networks and heterogeneous graph transformers, and describe how they are coupled with electronic health record data, medical ontologies and biomedical literature to construct task-specific knowledge graphs. Representative studies spanning 2013 to 2025 are compared according to data source, architecture, task and reported finding. The review further considers interpretability mechanisms that expose evidentiary subgraphs to clinicians, and discusses persistent challenges relating to data heterogeneity, missingness, temporal dynamics, fairness and clinical validation. We identify emerging directions, including the fusion of GNNs with large language models, federated and privacy-preserving graph learning, and dynamic knowledge graphs that evolve with longitudinal patient trajectories. The review concludes that while GNN-KG integration demonstrably improves predictive accuracy and offers a pathway toward explainable clinical artificial intelligence, translation into routine practice requires closer attention to prospective validation, regulatory scrutiny and clinician trust.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了图神经网络（GNN）与知识图谱（KG）在临床决策中的整合应用，涵盖诊断预测、风险分层、治疗推荐和药物警戒等任务。文章评估了多种GNN架构与电子健康记录、医学本体等数据源的结合方式，并讨论了可解释性、数据异质性、时序动态、公平性等挑战，最后指出融合大语言模型、联邦学习及动态知识图谱等未来方向。
AI.research_question: 图神经网络与知识图谱如何整合应用于临床推理任务，以及该整合方法在预测准确性、可解释性和临床转化方面面临哪些挑战与机遇？
AI.motivation: 临床决策日益依赖结构化的关系知识，而GNN擅长处理关系结构、KG编码临床语义，两者的结合具有自然优势。然而，该领域的进展散见于不同研究，缺乏系统性的综述来总结架构选择、数据耦合方式、挑战与未来方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 图神经网络（GCN、GAT、R-GCN、异构图Transformer等）与知识图谱（基于EHR、医学本体、生物医学文献构建的任务特定KG）的整合范式。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，涵盖2013–2025年的代表性研究，按数据来源、架构、任务和报告发现进行横向比较。
AI.findings: GNN-KG整合在诊断预测、风险分层、治疗推荐和药物警戒等任务上显著提升了预测准确性；可解释性子图机制为临床AI提供了一定透明度；但数据异质性、缺失值、时序动态、公平性和临床验证仍然是主要瓶颈。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统归纳了GNN与KG在临床领域整合的架构分类与应用范式，为后续研究提供了理论框架和比较基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为临床AI系统的设计者提供了架构选择与数据耦合的实践指南；指出了向常规临床转化需要的前瞻性验证、监管审查和建立临床医生信任等关键路径。

title: Severe Cognitive Impairments and Long-term Care in Germany
affiliations: Paris Dauphine University, Max Planck Society for the Advancement of the Sciences - Munich Center for the Economics of Aging (MEA), German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin), DIW Berlin, German Institute for Economic Research and Paris Dauphine University

detail.title: Severe Cognitive Impairments and Long-term Care in Germany
detail.abstract:
Germany experiences an increase in LTC recipients, due to population ageing but also to reforms which made LTC benefits easier accessible for individuals with cognitive impairments. Previous studies documented the cost of long-term care, and how it evolved. However, less is known about the specific case of elderly people suffering from cognitive impairment. Thus, we measure the economic costs of cognitive impairment, which include extensive medical, nursing care and at-home long-term care. We use the SHARE, the Survey on Health, Ageing and Retirement in Europe, Wave 9. We observe 4% of elderly people living at home with severe cognitive impairment (SCI) (Langa et al. (2017) definition). These individuals are 30% more likely to receive any care, and obtain on average 6 more hours of formal care and 6 more hours of informal care per week. The main driver is not the cognitive impairment per-se but the limitation in activities of daily living (ADLs) which SCI leads to. Thus, once controlling for ADLs, SCI does not explain any additional probability to use care. However, because people with SCI are more likely to have ADLs, the annual cost of their care is estimated to 10,000 euros per year per individual on average.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 德国认知障碍老年人的长期护理成本——主要由日常活动受限驱动，而非认知障碍本身——每人年均约1万欧元。
AI.research_question: 认知障碍（尤其是严重认知障碍）给老年人带来的经济成本是多少？其驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 德国长期护理受益人数因人口老龄化和改革而增加，但针对认知障碍老年人这一特殊群体的经济成本研究尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 长期护理经济学、认知障碍与日常活动受限（ADLs）的关系。
AI.method: 使用欧洲健康、老龄化与退休调查（SHARE）第9波数据，采用Langa等人（2017）定义识别严重认知障碍（SCI），通过对比分析测算护理使用概率及护理小时数。
AI.findings: 4%居家老年人有严重认知障碍；SCI患者接受护理的概率高30%，每周多接受6小时正式护理和6小时非正式护理；但控制ADLs后SCI本身不再显著增加护理使用概率；年均护理成本约1万欧元/人。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了认知障碍本身与由其导致的ADLs在驱动护理成本中的不同作用，揭示了护理成本的真实中介机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德国及类似国家的长期护理政策制定提供依据，提示政策应更多关注ADLs限制而非仅认知障碍诊断，有助于更精准地配置护理资源。

title: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania, Yale University, Boston University - Department of Global Health, University of Pennsylvania and University of Minnesota - Minneapolis

detail.title: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
detail.abstract:
U.S. life expectancy stagnated and declined in the 2010s despite continued growth in real per capita income. We use Preston curves to characterize this pattern as a change in the relationship between income and longevity. Using state-level data from 1980 to 2019 and county-level data from 2000 to 2019, we estimate population-weighted Preston curves relating life expectancy to logged real per capita income. From 1980 to 2010, U.S. states followed the classic Preston curve pattern: rising income was accompanied by rising life expectancy. Counties followed the same pattern from 2000 to 2010. From 2010 to 2019, however, states and counties continued to become richer while life expectancy stagnated or declined. The curves shifted right without shifting up and became steeper, indicating decoupling and divergence: increases in aggregate resources over time no longer produced broad longevity gains, and, in any given year, inequality in life expectancy by income grew. These patterns are robust to alternative temporal anchors around the Great Recession and to substituting education for income. They also appear across sex and racial groups.
